og:description: Say what needs doing. Foley turns it into a task with the project, date and reminder already set, and asks when it isn't sure instead of guessing. When plans change, say so and it moves the task. Ask it to plan your day, or what to work on first, and it answers from your list. Capture from your Apple Watch. The desktop app is free with no account, using your own OpenRouter key. Foley Pro runs the AI for you and syncs every device. On iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows and the web.

title: Formalini: Turn Any Document Into Structured Data | Product Hunt
og:title: Formalini: Turn Any Document Into Structured Data | Product Hunt
og:description: Formalini extracts clean JSON, Excel, and tables from any document, photo, or cursive note in seconds. Includes zero-setup templates, Case Folder analysis for legal discovery, enterprise connectors (UiPath, SAP, Salesforce), and an open MCP agent server.

title: FoundrRadio: Pick a frequency, launch your radio station and go on air | Product Hunt
og:title: FoundrRadio: Pick a frequency, launch your radio station and go on air | Product Hunt
og:description: FoundrRadio is an internet radio platform where founders could own their own radio stations and go on air. Visitors could listen to their favourite founders, their talks or music they love. An opportunity to own a small corner on the internet. An attempt to combine nostalgia and community.

title: Framefields: Open-source code-first video for AGI era | Product Hunt
og:title: Framefields: Open-source code-first video for AGI era | Product Hunt
og:description: Framefields is a high-performance, code-first video engine powered by native WebGPU in Node.js. Built for AI agents and engineers, it replaces bulky creative suites with a single npm package: motion graphics, Photoshop-grade VFX, 3D scenes, and audio DSP. Zero Chromium or browser overhead—render deterministic, frame-accurate video and export hardware-accelerated MP4s directly from TypeScript.

title: Fraud Blocker: AI ad fraud protection for Google and Meta ads | Product Hunt
og:title: Fraud Blocker: AI ad fraud protection for Google and Meta ads | Product Hunt
og:description: Fraud Blocker is an AI-powered platform that blocks invalid ad traffic from bots, click farms, and AI agents, ensuring enterprises, marketers, and agencies pay only for real clicks and genuine leads. It uses AI agents trained on billions of clicks and IPs to identify sophisticated invalid traffic that traditional filters miss, then explains why each click or IP was blocked. This helps protect budgets, improve conversion quality, and reduce wasted ad spend.

title: fswitcher: cmd+tab, the way it should work | Product Hunt
og:title: fswitcher: cmd+tab, the way it should work | Product Hunt
og:description: cmd+tab replacement for macOS built for multiple displays. It looks and feels like the original, with proper handling of app switching, window switching, and multiple displays. One-time purchase, and no subscriptions.

title: Fuse AI: The Agentic Sales Platform | Product Hunt
og:title: Fuse AI: The Agentic Sales Platform | Product Hunt
og:description: Sales was broken. We fixed it. The average team currently uses 5-10 tools to run outbound. Fuse is the AI-native platform where teams can truly run outbound end-to-end with every product you will ever need to close deals. Get access to real-time signals, verified contact data, waterfall enrichment, LinkedIn automation, Email automation, deliverability infrastructure, parallel dialing, and AI-powered workflows - all in one platform designed to replace tool sprawl and simplify pipeline generation.

title: FutureMail: Email on your domain, built for people and their AI agents | Product Hunt
og:title: FutureMail: Email on your domain, built for people and their AI agents | Product Hunt
og:description: Email hosting for your own domain, built for people and their AI agents: unlimited addresses, a fast keyboard-first inbox, agent inboxes, a REST API, CLI and remote MCP server (Resend-compatible). $20/month.

title: Gauth : The all-in-one AI study platform for students | Product Hunt
og:title: Gauth : The all-in-one AI study platform for students | Product Hunt
og:description: Gauth is an all-in-one AI study platform, purpose-built for education. It combines step-by-step problem solving, interactive AI tutoring, and personalized study tools into one experience, so students can solve problems, understand concepts, and prepare more effectively. Since 2020, Gauth has surpassed 200 million downloads and supports a global community of students and lifelong learners.

title: GBrain: Garry Tan's AI memory, tools, & skills for any harness | Product Hunt
og:title: GBrain: Garry Tan's AI memory, tools, & skills for any harness | Product Hunt
og:description: GBrain gives you a memory and a set of connected accounts that every AI can reach. Write a note in Claude Code and ChatGPT knows it. Connect Gmail once and Cursor can search it with no key in a config file. The memory is a folder of markdown files you can read, correct and take with you. Run it on your own inference or ours, in a workspace your whole team shares. $100 off the first month for a team workspace at https://gbrain.io/gratis/product-hunt

title: GeckIt: Kanban board for your Claude Code chats | Product Hunt
og:title: GeckIt: Kanban board for your Claude Code chats | Product Hunt
og:description: Working with several Claude Code chats at once? GeckIt puts them on a Kanban board, so you see which one is working, which one waits for you and which one is done. It runs your own Claude Code on your Claude subscription, no API key. Free and open source, Mac, Windows, Linux.

title: SIMA 2: Google's most capable AI agent for virtual 3D worlds | Product Hunt
og:title: SIMA 2: Google's most capable AI agent for virtual 3D worlds | Product Hunt
og:description: An Agent that Plays, Reasons, and Learns With You in Virtual 3D Worlds. Powered by Gemini, it goes beyond following basic instructions to think, understand, and take actions in interactive environments – meaning you can talk to it through text, voice, or even images.

title: Gemini 4 Argon: Google's frontier model for careful reasoning & complex work | Product Hunt
og:title: Gemini 4 Argon: Google's frontier model for careful reasoning & complex work | Product Hunt
og:description: Gemini 4 Argon is Google’s frontier AI model for complex, long-horizon professional work. It combines advanced reasoning, coding, multimodal understanding, and cybersecurity-defense capabilities, with support for up to 1 million output tokens. Designed for software engineering, finance, legal work, and enterprise research, it helps solve multi-step problems while Google gradually expands access through trusted testing and safety safeguards.

title: Gemini 4 Argon: Google's frontier model for long, complex agentic work | Product Hunt
og:title: Gemini 4 Argon: Google's frontier model for long, complex agentic work | Product Hunt
og:description: Gemini 4 Argon is Google's frontier model for long horizon work in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work and cybersecurity defense. As of Oct 13 it is available globally in the Gemini API paid tier, AI Studio, Google Antigravity (Ultra), the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search (Pro and Ultra), with a 1M unified input and output token limit.

title: Genchi: Project delivery predictions, from the people doing the work | Product Hunt
og:title: Genchi: Project delivery predictions, from the people doing the work | Product Hunt
og:description: Genchi shows engineering leaders a prediction of which projects are heading for a missed deadline and which aren't, from the people doing the work. This prediction comes from their anonymous, one-click confidence vote in response to a regular, automated Slack prompt. Those votes are combined by project into a single score, tracked over time, so leaders can spot projects in trouble sooner and step in where needed, and, more importantly, know which teams to leave alone.

title: GenPage: Build, personalize, and optimize landing pages with AI | Product Hunt
og:title: GenPage: Build, personalize, and optimize landing pages with AI | Product Hunt
og:description:
Your marketing campaigns are personalized. Your landing pages should be too.

GenPage learns your brand, builds dedicated pages for every ad, keyword, or target account, then continuously A-Z tests them on Autopilot - turning more traffic into pipeline and revenue.

title: Gerty: Private ChatGPT alternative that sets itself up on your Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: Gerty: Private ChatGPT alternative that sets itself up on your Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: Gerty is a private AI assistant that runs entirely on your Mac. It measures your Mac, picks the best open models for each job (chat, writing, code, understanding and making pictures), downloads them and sets them up as one assistant. No terminal, no setup. It works with your documents, mail and calendar, you can ask it out loud, and it shows you every change before it makes it. No account, no cloud, works offline. CHF 49 once for 3 Macs, 7-day free trial.

title: Ghost Core: A personal AI computer that runs entirely on-device | Product Hunt
og:title: Ghost Core: A personal AI computer that runs entirely on-device | Product Hunt
og:description: Ghost Core is a personal AI computer that runs AI models on-device, connects to your apps, files, and devices, and builds continuous context to proactively help you.

title: Ghostifier: Companies have your data. Ghostifier gets them to delete it. | Product Hunt
og:title: Ghostifier: Companies have your data. Ghostifier gets them to delete it. | Product Hunt
og:description: Instead of one form per company, Ghostifier starts from your inbox. It finds who holds your data, unsubscribes you and opts you out of sale and sharing on day one, waits out the return window, then sends deletion requests and tracks every reply. Banks, insurers and your employer are left alone. It also asks data brokers to delete you. Gmail access is headers only, so it never reads your email bodies, and there is no AI: every decision follows fixed rules.

title: GitGlow: Review your code and your agents' changes before you ship | Product Hunt
og:title: GitGlow: Review your code and your agents' changes before you ship | Product Hunt
og:description: GitGlow brings precise staging, clear history, and a checkout-aware terminal into one local Git workspace. Pro adds review marks and checks that become stale after edits, plus managed agent and release tools. Free for private local clones; no account needed.

title: GitSync: Sync branches between GitHub repos, right from Chrome | Product Hunt
og:title: GitSync: Sync branches between GitHub repos, right from Chrome | Product Hunt
og:description: GitSync is a Chrome extension that copies a branch from one GitHub repo to another you have access to — with full commit history or just the latest snapshot, into an existing or brand-new branch. Runs entirely in your browser; no GitSync server sees your code.

title: Glance for Mac: Your MacBook notch, now a live, cinematic island | Product Hunt
og:title: Glance for Mac: Your MacBook notch, now a live, cinematic island | Product Hunt
og:description: Glance turns the notch into a live island. Hover for music with lyrics, weather, calendar, a focus timer and football scores. Cinema mode makes your screen and Touch Bar glow with the video you watch. Claude Code approvals appear right in the notch. Free and open source.

title: Gleap: AI-native customer support for software teams. | Product Hunt
og:title: Gleap: AI-native customer support for software teams. | Product Hunt
og:description: Support, feedback and coding agents, finally on the same team. Customer reports turn into fixes your team reviews and ships, and customers hear back on the ticket they opened. Inbox, live chat, email, bug reports, roadmaps and AI agents in one place.

title: Globestudio: Open-source dotted maps and 3D globes for designers | Product Hunt
og:title: Globestudio: Open-source dotted maps and 3D globes for designers | Product Hunt
og:description: A free, open-source studio for dotted maps and 3D globes. Pick the world or any country, choose one of 21 shader looks, tweak the dots, gradients and density, then export a PNG, SVG, WebM, MP4 or GIF, or embed it live. It's MIT licensed, with no account.

title: Google: Organizing the world's information | Product Hunt
og:title: Google: Organizing the world's information | Product Hunt
og:description: Search the world's information, including webpages, images, videos and more. Google has many special features to help you find exactly what you're looking for.

title: Google Fitbit Edge: Google’s smartest fitness tracker ever with 7-day battery | Product Hunt
og:title: Google Fitbit Edge: Google’s smartest fitness tracker ever with 7-day battery  | Product Hunt
og:description: Fitbit Edge is Google’s slim, screen-based fitness tracker for active lifestyles and everyday wear. It has built-in GPS, over 50 workout modes, ECG, skin temperature, and up to seven days of battery per Google. It’s Fitbit’s first repairable tracker, with a replaceable battery. $179.99, pre-order now, on shelves Oct 27. Includes 3 months of Google Health Premium, which is needed for the Health Coach and Health Guardian.

title: Google Labs: Google's AI and product experiments | Product Hunt
og:title: Google Labs: Google's AI and product experiments | Product Hunt
og:description: Google Labs is an experimental hub where Google publicly tests early-stage AI products and features. It includes projects like AI-powered search enhancements, Workspace integrations (e.g. Gmail and Docs assistants), and generative tools such as NotebookLM.

title: GotEmail: A fast, native Mac mail app for all your inboxes | Product Hunt
og:title: GotEmail:  A fast, native Mac mail app for all your inboxes | Product Hunt
og:description: Every inbox in one native Mac app. Sign-in codes and magic links one click away, AI drafts, summaries and replies, Translate, notes and templates, Cmd+K search. Your mail never touches our servers. Pay once, every Mac.

title: Grablo Spot: Free AI NVR that finds any person or vehicle in seconds | Product Hunt
og:title: Grablo Spot: Free AI NVR that finds any person or vehicle in seconds | Product Hunt
og:description: Grablo Spot is free AI NVR software for the cameras you already have. It records straight to your own machine and sorts every person and vehicle it sees into cards. Find anyone by face, appearance, plain text ("a person in a yellow shirt"), or a partial license plate, then follow them across every camera. Works with IP cameras, NVRs (RTSP/ONVIF), and USB webcams on Windows, macOS, Linux, and Raspberry Pi. Video is stored only on your device. No credit card, no camera limit, every feature free.

title: Gravity Notes: One list of notes, for you and your AI agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Gravity Notes: One list of notes, for you and your AI agents | Product Hunt
og:description: Gravity is a notes app built on Andrej Karpathy's append-and-review note. Everything goes into one list, newest at the top. Old notes sink, and a swipe brings one back. It has live Markdown and checklists, full Markdown export, and a gravity CLI on the Mac for your scripts and AI agents. You pay once, and your notes stay on your devices. For iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android.

title: Griffin by Tavus: World's First Human Interaction Model | Product Hunt
og:title: Griffin by Tavus: World's First Human Interaction Model | Product Hunt
og:description: Griffin is Tavus’s Human Interaction Model for face-to-face, real-time conversation. It sees, hears, and talks at the same time, responding to pauses, expressions, gestures, and what’s happening on camera. In a live one-minute video call, 48% of participants believed they were talking to a real person. Griffin-Lite is available as a research preview to select early testers, with full-duplex video-to-video interaction and 720p generation.

title: guilds.run: The open-source Grok Bot alternative | Product Hunt
og:title: guilds.run: The open-source Grok Bot alternative | Product Hunt
og:description: Open-source AI agent teams you can actually inspect. Debug every prompt, tool call, memory change, and agent interaction. Control permissions, edit context, and choose the model for each agent. Self-host for free. Stop guessing what your agents are doing.

title: Hallmonitor: See and answer every coding agent from your notch | Product Hunt
og:title: Hallmonitor: See and answer every coding agent from your notch | Product Hunt
og:description: See every Claude Code and Codex session on your Mac and your servers, live: in the notch, menu bar, a native app and the terminal. Know who's done, who's stuck, and answer their questions right from the notch. Free and open source

title: Halo: Dynamic Island for Mac, plus external monitor control | Product Hunt
og:title: Halo: Dynamic Island for Mac, plus external monitor control | Product Hunt
og:description: Halo is a Dynamic Island for any Mac, notch or not, on the top, left or right edge. New in 1.4: your Claude Code and Codex usage limits in the notch, a Focus/Break timer with a minute ruler, every device's battery, and a System Settings-style window. On Apple silicon, brightness keys set an external monitor's real backlight over DDC/CI, plus contrast and input. Now Playing, file shelf, clipboard. No account. 3-day free trial.

title: Halvsy for iPhone: Scan any receipt, tap who had what, and everyone's square | Product Hunt
og:title: Halvsy for iPhone: Scan any receipt, tap who had what, and everyone's square | Product Hunt
og:description: Halvsy turns a photo of the bill into a group balance, now on iPhone. It reads every line, tax and tip, and checks them against the printed total. You tap who had what, tax and tip are split in proportion to each person's order, and every share lands in the group. Friends join with a QR code, each group keeps its own currency, and settling up goes through the payment app you already use. No ads and no daily limit on expenses.

title: Haptiker: Volume, brightness and keyboard light on your trackpad edges | Product Hunt
og:title: Haptiker: Volume, brightness and keyboard light on your trackpad edges | Product Hunt
og:description: Haptiker turns the edges of your Mac trackpad into sliders. Right edge: volume. Left: display brightness, external monitors too on Apple Silicon. Top: keyboard light. Haptic ticks, and scrolling works as before. 7-day free trial, then one payment.

title: Hark: The personal AI that handles life before you have to | Product Hunt
og:title: Hark: The personal AI that handles life before you have to | Product Hunt
og:description: Hark Pro is a personal AI designed to take things off your plate, not add another chatbot to your day. It remembers what matters, thinks ahead about what you might need, and uses its own cloud computer to get things done across the web — from managing calendars and email to shopping, travel, bills, and everyday errands. Your sensitive credentials stay encrypted, Hark never sells your data or shares it with advertisers, and you can watch it work.

title: Harness²: Harness the agent. Then harness its self-improvement. | Product Hunt
og:title: Harness²: Harness the agent. Then harness its self-improvement. | Product Hunt
og:description: Harness² from Google Research is a plug-and-play recursive agent harnessing framework that lets LLM agents automatically evolve their execution harnesses (prompts, tools, memory) for open-world tasks—without ground-truth verifiers. Dual recursion: task-level Propose-Probe-Compose refinement + harnessing-level accumulation of reusable experience. Up to +11.5 points on professional benchmarks like WorkBuddy-Bench.

title: Harness by Autonomous: Every coding agent, every machine, one command center. | Product Hunt
og:title: Harness by Autonomous: Every coding agent, every machine, one command center. | Product Hunt
og:description: Harness is the open-source command center for coding agents. Claude Code at work, Codex at home, Hermes in the cloud: every agent on every machine, side by side. Use the native desktop app, hn in your terminal, or the iOS and Android app to answer agents by voice. End-to-end encrypted. Then go beyond code with 49 harnesses for CAD, circuits, robots, games and music. Free on Mac and Linux.

title: HarnessHive: AI-Native, Simple & Collaborative Wire Harness Design | Product Hunt
og:title: HarnessHive: AI-Native, Simple & Collaborative Wire Harness Design | Product Hunt
og:description: HarnessHive is the AI-native design ecosystem for wiring harness engineers. Schematic, layout, BOM and a to/scale formboard, all in one live document. With an AI assistant that helps you at every step.

title: Headroom: Your Mac on iPhone Duo: fold it, and the keyboard appears | Product Hunt
og:title: Headroom: Your Mac on iPhone Duo: fold it, and the keyboard appears | Product Hunt
og:description: Headroom is a Screen Sharing client for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Nothing to install on the Mac, no account, no server in between. On iPhone Duo it changes layout with every pose: half open, your Mac is on the upper screen and the keyboard on the lower one.

title: heal.dev: Find bugs and vulnerabilities code review misses | Product Hunt
og:title: heal.dev: Find bugs and vulnerabilities code review misses | Product Hunt
og:description: Code review catches what’s wrong in a diff. Heal catches what breaks when the app runs. Heal learns how to run your application, builds a production-like sandbox with external services stubbed, then hunts for bugs, performance regressions, and runtime vulnerabilities users would hit. It reproduces every defect before reporting it, so you get real bugs to fix, not a backlog of AI-generated suspicions.

title: Helicon: Open-source desktop app and VS Code panel for Muse Code | Product Hunt
og:title: Helicon: Open-source desktop app and VS Code panel for Muse Code | Product Hunt
og:description: Helicon gives Muse Code, Meta's coding agent CLI, a proper home: projects and sessions in one sidebar, readable approvals, inline diffs and your plan meter. Free, MIT, no API key. Windows (no WSL), macOS, Linux, VS Code. Unofficial, not affiliated with Meta.

title: Helio: Know exactly what your rooftop solar made today | Product Hunt
og:title: Helio: Know exactly what your rooftop solar made today | Product Hunt
og:description: Rooftop solar apps make you dig for the one number you want: units made today. Helio opens straight on it, read from your inverter's own energy counter via ShineMonitor / SmartClient. Also: live power, any past day as a 5-minute curve, 30-day, yearly and lifetime history, and savings in your own currency and tariff. Deploy your own copy to Vercel in 5 minutes. Free, MIT licensed, no database, no tracking. Your login never reaches the browser.

title: Helo: An independent email API from former Postmark folks | Product Hunt
og:title: Helo: An independent email API from former Postmark folks | Product Hunt
og:description: Helo is an email API built for developers and platforms that send on behalf of their customers. Contain bad senders before they drag down deliverability, let customers send from their own domains, and keep stats, unsubscribes, and credentials separate per tenant. It also covers the fundamentals: REST API and SMTP, SDKs in popular languages, separate transactional and broadcast infrastructure, and usage-based pricing starting at just $0.00035 per email—all features included.

title: HeyGen: Turn your ideas into videos in minutes. | Product Hunt
og:title: HeyGen: Turn your ideas into videos in minutes. | Product Hunt
og:description: HeyGen is a message-first AI video platform that helps people and AI agents turn ideas into professional video in minutes. The platform enables video creation from scripts, images, presentations, and conversational prompts, powered by its AI Video Agent. Used by a community of over 30 million users and 85% of the Fortune 100, HeyGen combines the most realistic AI avatars in the industry, rated #1 on G2, with support for 175+ languages to help anyone communicate at scale.

title: HeyPi: Build and ship anything live, in-meetings | Product Hunt
og:title: HeyPi: Build and ship anything live, in-meetings | Product Hunt
og:description: Most AI meeting tools capture what happened and send you notes. HeyPi follows the conversation in real time, remembers what was said across current and past meetings, privately surfaces key information when useful, and starts handling follow-up work across your tools before the meeting ends. Pi can also bring your boldest product and marketing ideas to life — landing pages, apps, social media content, ad campaigns and more live in the meeting. Less AI notes. More AI execution.

title: hibi: an open-source obsidian alternative | Product Hunt
og:title: hibi: an open-source obsidian alternative | Product Hunt
og:description: Hibi is a free, open-source desktop writing and note-taking app designed for individuals seeking more control over their document organization and creation. It is an alternative to apps like Obsidian and Joplin, combining standard knowledge management features with a flexible editing experience that surpasses markdown.

title: Hintly for Google Meet™: Real-time hints for every term you miss on Google Meet | Product Hunt
og:title: Hintly for Google Meet™: Real-time hints for every term you miss on Google Meet | Product Hunt
og:description: Hintly explains the terms, names and things people mention on your Google Meet calls, a moment after they come up.

title: Kai: Autonomous assistant designed to handle meetings and email | Product Hunt
og:title: Kai: Autonomous assistant designed to handle meetings and email | Product Hunt
og:description: Kai is an AI executive assistant for solopreneurs, freelancers and startup founders. It works across your email, calendar and tasks: it triages your inbox and drafts replies, schedules around your real availability, records and transcribes your meetings, then turns them into summaries and action items. Workflows run in the background, and Kai hands tasks to Claude or ChatGPT with the context of the meeting or email they came from. Available on Web, desktop and mobile app. Free trial available.

title: HireKey: Your recruiter-informed AI copilot for tech job search | Product Hunt
og:title: HireKey: Your recruiter-informed AI copilot for tech job search | Product Hunt
og:description: HireKey is a recruiter-informed AI job-search co-pilot for tech job seekers who want to apply strategically & interview with confidence. It helps you assess your role fit, tailor resumes, communicate experience & track applications. Unlike basic ATS tools, HireKey combines AI with 10 years of recruiting experience at Microsoft, Amazon & Stripe, plus practice out loud with an interactive AI voice coach that responds to your answers & provides real-time interview feedback.

title: History Monk: Fast History Search, Export & Bulk Delete | Product Hunt
og:title: History Monk: Fast History Search, Export & Bulk Delete | Product Hunt
og:description: History Monk replaces your browser's history page. Type a few letters and the page you want shows up. Filter by site, day or hour, see where your time goes, and clear out the clutter. 100% local and private.

title: Hob: Open-source, on device alternative to Claude and ChatGPT | Product Hunt
og:title: Hob: Open-source, on device alternative to Claude and ChatGPT | Product Hunt
og:description: Hob is a free, open-source AI app for Mac, Windows and Linux that works with your files the way ChatGPT and Claude do, except the AI runs on your own computer. It picks the best open model your computer can run and sets it up for you. Hob can read and edit files in folders you choose, turn spreadsheets into charts, fill in PDFs, look at photos and search the web. Your chats and files stay on your computer, and it works offline.

title: Hoistbay: Open-source desktop app for Amazon S3 and CloudFront | Product Hunt
og:title: Hoistbay: Open-source desktop app for Amazon S3 and CloudFront | Product Hunt
og:description: Hoistbay is a free desktop app for macOS and Windows that takes the repetitive work out of S3 and CloudFront. Set header rules once (Cache-Control, Content-Type, Content-Encoding by file pattern) and they apply on every upload. Download whole folders, clear CloudFront cache in one click, and switch AWS accounts instantly. Keys stay in your OS keychain, no backend, no telemetry. MIT licensed.

title: Holm: A self hosted home page for everyone in the house | Product Hunt
og:title: Holm: A self hosted home page for everyone in the house | Product Hunt
og:description: Holm is a self hosted dashboard for the people who use your server, not just you. Everyone signs in with your existing SSO and gets their own apps, layout and wallpaper. One search box reaches inside Immich, Jellyfin, Plex, Paperless, your calendar and many more integrations.

title: Hotly: Get paid to answer your DMs. Open source. | Product Hunt
og:title: Hotly: Get paid to answer your DMs. Open source. | Product Hunt
og:description: Your inbox, with a price on it. People pay to send yu a note or subscribe weekly. You reply from one inbx, when it suits you, and Stripe pays you. Run it fr on your own server, or let us host it: 30 days fre.

title: How It Spread: See how anything went viral, from the first post | Product Hunt
og:title: How It Spread: See how anything went viral, from the first post | Product Hunt
og:description: A library of 1,000+ viral films, products, memes and campaigns. Each case embeds the original, dates every step from first post to peak, sources every number and scores the spread from data. New breakouts get traced as they spread. Free to browse.

title: How It Went: Your route, photos and clips as a short film | Product Hunt
og:title: How It Went: Your route, photos and clips as a short film | Product Hunt
og:description: Turns one ride or a whole trip into a short film from the GPS track, photos and clips you already have. Your track draws itself across a tilted map, each photo appears where you took it, and clips play where they were shot. Pick rides from Strava or bring Garmin FIT and GPX files. Several days merge into one film, rest days included. Fix a wrong camera clock once and every shot from it moves. Out comes an MP4, 9:16 or 16:9, assembled and encoded on your iPhone, Android phone or Mac.

title: Hypervibe: Run your AI coding agents on one infinite board | Product Hunt
og:title: Hypervibe: Run your AI coding agents on one infinite board | Product Hunt
og:description: Run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and other CLI agents side by side on an infinite board. Hypervibe brings real terminals, agent status, teams, voice control and live previews into one native Mac app. Use the agent accounts you already have. macOS 14+, Apple Silicon.

title: iglass: Liquid Glass for your iTerm2 & Ghostty | Product Hunt
og:title: iglass: Liquid Glass for your iTerm2 & Ghostty | Product Hunt
og:description: A free, open-source theme for iTerm2 and Ghostty on macOS and Linux. Real Liquid Glass in Ghostty on macOS 26, four glass levels, eight accents, light & dark. Every color is contrast-checked, and every change is reversible with one command.

title: iKnowMyMac: See why your Mac is slow, with the evidence and the fix | Product Hunt
og:title: iKnowMyMac: See why your Mac is slow, with the evidence and the fix | Product Hunt
og:description: iKnowMyMac is a native Mac app that tells you why your Mac is slow, what's filling your disk and what's draining your battery, with the evidence and one action for each. It also updates your other apps from one tab. One-time purchase, no subscription.

title: iLand: Turn your Mac's notch into an everyday workspace | Product Hunt
og:title: iLand: Turn your Mac's notch into an everyday workspace | Product Hunt
og:description: iLand turns your Mac's notch into a home for everyday tools. Control music, keep files in a drag-and-drop tray, convert files, capture screenshots, and record your screen. Switch between widgets for your calendar, weather, timers, and more, with gesture controls and a customizable layout that keeps everything within reach.

title: ilha: Your Claude Code and Codex limits, live in the notch | Product Hunt
og:title: ilha: Your Claude Code and Codex limits, live in the notch | Product Hunt
og:description: ilha is a native Mac app that lives in the notch (a small pill on other displays) and shows how much of your Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build limits you've used: the 5-hour and weekly windows, when they reset, and whether you're on pace to run out. If you pay for several accounts, it switches the CLI to one with room before the limit, without logging anything out. Insights prices each week at API rates, by project.

title: ImageFlow: Free Photoshop-grade image editor with AI features | Product Hunt
og:title: ImageFlow: Free Photoshop-grade image editor with AI features | Product Hunt
og:description: A free, full-featured image editor that runs entirely in your browser. Layers, masks, blend modes, adjustment layers, smart objects, text and filters — with PSD import and export, and on-device AI selection. Nothing is uploaded; your files never leave your device.

title: Inbox Zero: Clean up your inbox in minutes. Open source. | Product Hunt
og:title: Inbox Zero: Clean up your inbox in minutes. Open source. | Product Hunt
og:description: Open source AI email assistant and email client.

title: Incredible: The AI that does the clicking and typing for you | Product Hunt
og:title: Incredible: The AI that does the clicking and typing for you | Product Hunt
og:description: Incredible is a desktop AI for Mac and Windows that does your busywork for you. Hold fn and say what you need. It clicks and types in your browser, files and apps exactly like you do, and it asks you before anything gets sent.

title: Inferock: An independent receipt for every LLM API call | Product Hunt
og:title: Inferock: An independent receipt for every LLM API call | Product Hunt
og:description: Inferock-bench is a local proxy that sits between your app and OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or OpenRouter shaped calls. It captures per-call token usage, failures, and retries, then generates an independent receipt showing what you were billed and how much you're actually overpaying for.

title: Inflight: Capture design feedback directly inside your prototypes | Product Hunt
og:title: Inflight: Capture design feedback directly inside your prototypes | Product Hunt
og:description: Inflight puts a feedback toolkit on your preview links and HTML prototypes. Reviewers comment directly on the live running app, with comments pinned to real elements, and feedback becomes next steps a coding agent can implement over MCP.

title: Instant Search: The fastest, most precise local AI Search for your files. | Product Hunt
og:title: Instant Search: The fastest, most precise local AI Search for your files. | Product Hunt
og:description: Instant is the first accurate local AI file search that uses the latest embedding models to find the exact file (and page) with the content you’re looking for with a 95% hit rate.

title: Intel: Pushing possible forward. | Product Hunt
og:title: Intel: Pushing possible forward. | Product Hunt
og:description: We’re building on our unrivaled history of innovation to power the future of computing and communications. Our ambitions? A world that runs on Intel. We’re doing this by helping our customers find the technologies and solutions that allow them to transform their businesses and gain market advantage.

title: Intelli: Effortless customer support | Product Hunt
og:title: Intelli: Effortless customer support | Product Hunt
og:description: Intelli is a Customer Support Platform that streamlines conversations and interactions between businesses and their customers across multiple channels using AI.

title: Invited - AI Reminder Scanner: AI reminder scanner for bills, invites & documents | Product Hunt
og:title: Invited - AI Reminder Scanner: AI reminder scanner for bills, invites & documents | Product Hunt
og:description: Invited is an AI reminder scanner that turns bills, invitations, cheques, screenshots and PDFs into smart reminders. It extracts dates, times, places and amounts, supports 80+ languages and 9 calendars, and finds multiple reminders in one document.

title: Invofox: The Document Parsing API for developers | Product Hunt
og:title: Invofox: The Document Parsing API for developers | Product Hunt
og:description: Invofox is a document parsing API for software teams that turns complex, real-world documents into accurate, structured data. Built for high-variance workflows, Invofox goes beyond OCR with classification, validation, and extraction that scale reliably in production.

title: Inyon: Answer your coding agents from your phone | Product Hunt
og:title: Inyon: Answer your coding agents from your phone | Product Hunt
og:description: Inyon shows the coding agents already running in tmux on your machines (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot CLI, Antigravity) as chats on your phone or in a browser. When one asks something, you answer with a tap and it's typed into the same pane, so nothing changes when you sit back down. No account and nothing to host: pair the Android app by QR code and it reaches your computers over an end-to-end encrypted tunnel or your VPN. Free, open source, MIT.

title: iphone-use: Let AI agents drive a real iPhone, even apps with no API | Product Hunt
og:title: iphone-use: Let AI agents drive a real iPhone, even apps with no API | Product Hunt
og:description: iphone-use gives an AI agent a real iPhone: the screen as text, tap, type and scroll over WebDriverAgent, with an honest answer for every action (applied, not sent, or unknown). Payment apps that block screenshots come back as a wireframe. A task done once becomes a flow that replays with no model. HTTP API, a 21-tool MCP server for Claude Code, and remote control from a browser or iOS app. Open source, MIT.

title: IrisGo: AI operating system for workflow automation | Product Hunt
og:title: IrisGo: AI operating system for workflow automation | Product Hunt
og:description: IrisGo is an AI operating system for Windows and Mac that helps automate everyday work across applications. With Watch & Learn, demonstrate a task, turn it into a reusable workflow, and run it again with new inputs. Get daily briefs, surface important emails, and keep your next actions in view. Spend less time on repetitive work and more time on what matters.

title: Isle Notch: Lowweight minimal dynamic island for Windows | Product Hunt
og:title: Isle Notch: Lowweight minimal dynamic island for Windows | Product Hunt
og:description: Isle sits at the top of your screen. Closed, it's a small pill with a little face. It looks around, waves when you sign in, and hides in a game or a video. Hover or click and it opens. Music. Volume for each app. Clipboard. A timer, pomodoro, and today's calendar. Notes. Drop a file or a shortcut on it and open it later. Wi-Fi, brightness, night light. Battery, and a speed check. Stick it to the top or let it float. Change the color. If the face is too much, turn it off and keep the clock.

title: Isly: Your MacBook notch, brought to life. | Product Hunt
og:title: Isly: Your MacBook notch, brought to life. | Product Hunt
og:description: Isly turns the MacBook notch into a living control center: music from any app with cover art and scrubber, live timers and calendar events, clean volume/brightness readouts, and more - all without leaving your workflow. Light on resources (≈0.2% CPU idle, ~49 MB RAM), smooth animations, and a one-time €3.99 license with free updates. For macOS 14+ with a notch.

title: iwant: Find available GPUs and host open models in one command | Product Hunt
og:title: iwant: Find available GPUs and host open models in one command | Product Hunt
og:description: Host your own DeepSeek, Kimi, Minimax, MiMo, Step with with one command. iwant hunts across GCP regions for available GPUs, then handles provisioning, model downloads, and vLLM setup. One command gives you an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, an API key, and SSH access.

title: Jarq: Translate, shorten, fix or rewrite any text near your cursor | Product Hunt
og:title: Jarq: Translate, shorten, fix or rewrite any text near your cursor | Product Hunt
og:description: Translate, shorten, fix or rewrite any text right where your cursor is — in any app on Mac. Dictate there too. No tabs, no copy-paste. Select text, hit a hotkey, and it's replaced in place. Or press ⌥` and speak in one language, get clean text in another. 13 languages. Privacy: Jarq uses cloud AI models to process your text and voice. Jarq itself doesn't keep your text on its servers, and your history stays on your Mac. Free: 5 actions a day. Pro: $4.99/mo or $39/yr. 14-day Pro trial, no card.

title: JarvisCore: Build agents as peers in a mesh network with zero-trust | Product Hunt
og:title: JarvisCore: Build agents as peers in a mesh network with zero-trust | Product Hunt
og:description: JarvisCore is a runtime where AI agents operate as a fleet of equal peers. Agents discover one another by capability, execute tasks from a shared ledger, and authenticate to every external service through a zero-trust broker, never with their own keys.

title: JevGPT: A chatbot built on a model that can't write | Product Hunt
og:title: JevGPT: A chatbot built on a model that can't write | Product Hunt
og:description: For years we've used LLMs built to write text to make choices. JevGPT returns the favor: a chat app where TypeSafe's Jev, a model built to make choices, writes every reply one multiple-choice word at a time. Does it work? Sort of. Open source.

title: Jobmate AI: The humanized AI Copilot | Product Hunt
og:title: Jobmate AI: The humanized AI Copilot  | Product Hunt
og:description: Jobmate is the AI copilot for your whole job search.

title: JOGAK: Make everyday vlogs with less editing | Product Hunt
og:title: JOGAK: Make everyday vlogs with less editing | Product Hunt
og:description: JOGAK is a vlog camera that joins the clips you record in shooting order. Capture everyday moments, review your timeline, adjust what you need, and save a finished video diary. Available for iPhone and Android. Free to download, with an ad option to export without the JOGAK logo.

title: Jotform: Easy-to-use online form builder for every business | Product Hunt
og:title: Jotform: Easy-to-use online form builder for every business | Product Hunt
og:description: Jotform is a full-featured online form builder that allows you to create powerful forms and securely gather data from any device. With our intuitive drag-and-drop builder, you can create and share custom online forms to generate leads, distribute surveys, collect online payments, and much more — all without any coding.

title: judged.systems: The judgment API platform for support systems. | Product Hunt
og:title: judged.systems: The judgment API platform for support systems. | Product Hunt
og:description: Support systems call judged.systems when a ticket needs a judgment. The helpdesk stays the system of record. You send the ticket. A pack defines the questions: queue, urgency, refund request, policy risk. Back comes a choice and its probabilities, a score on a rubric, or the probability a statement is true. Your thresholds return accept or review. A failed call stays in review. The ticket is redacted first. The evaluation is stored as it happened. A label on a miss leaves it untouched.

title: Kalender Sync: Sync your calendars & connect them to ChatGPT, Claude & Co. | Product Hunt
og:title: Kalender Sync: Sync your calendars & connect them to ChatGPT, Claude & Co. | Product Hunt
og:description: Keep Google, Outlook, iCloud and supported CalDAV calendars in sync, one-way or two-way. Choose what gets copied: busy only, title and time, or full details. Connect the same calendars to ChatGPT and Claude to check availability, find events and create new ones. Built for people juggling work, personal and client calendars, including GMX, WEB.DE, mailbox.org and kSuite. Set it up in minutes or by simply asking your agent.

title: Kalesh Judge: Turn petty fights into a public trial | Product Hunt
og:title: Kalesh Judge: Turn petty fights into a public trial | Product Hunt
og:description: An anonymous entertainment courtroom for everyday disagreements. Turn petty fights into a public trial. Vote, pitch your funniest fix, climb the leaderboard, and summon your WhatsApp panchayat. Kalesh Judge is live!

title: KarmaBoard: A vintage split-flap message board for any TV | Product Hunt
og:title: KarmaBoard: A vintage split-flap message board for any TV | Product Hunt
og:description: A vintage split-flap message board for any TV. Display your own custom text, plus live feeds like weather, sports scores, stock prices and transit schedules... and watch every letter clack into place.

title: KernelAI: Private, offline AI for iPhone and Android | Product Hunt
og:title: KernelAI: Private, offline AI for iPhone and Android | Product Hunt
og:description: Run 50+ AI models locally on iPhone and Android. Chat, read PDFs and documents with on-device RAG, understand images with vision models, and write code offline. Dictate prompts, customize responses and import GGUF models (experimental). On iPhone, use Siri, Shortcuts and Apple's built-in AI on supported devices. Add optional web search with your own API key. Free, with no account, ads or subscription. Download a model once, then use it offline. Your local chats and documents stay on your device.

title: Keysi: See every shortcut of the app you're in | Product Hunt
og:title: Keysi: See every shortcut of the app you're in | Product Hunt
og:description: Hold ⌘ in any Mac app to see every keyboard shortcut, read live from its menus. Click a row to run it. Free, no time limit. Keysi Pro ($14.99 once) teaches the ones you keep missing: a quiet reminder, spaced-repetition drills, and "New" marks after updates.

title: Kholo: Take a car, a rocket, even your body apart in 3D | Product Hunt
og:title: Kholo: Take a car, a rocket, even your body apart in 3D | Product Hunt
og:description: School tells children what happens. Kholo lets them open it. Pull a car, a rocket or the human body apart in 3D. Read real Python line by line before running it. Work through English stories at your own level. Build something from parts your local shop sells. Ages 6–14, mapped to the NCERT syllabus.

title: Kilo: Your agentic fitness coach in iMessage | Product Hunt
og:title: Kilo: Your agentic fitness coach in iMessage | Product Hunt
og:description: Kilo builds your training program, texts you your workouts, and uses your logs and check-ins to recommend what comes next. Coaching in iMessage, with workout tracking built in. Join the free private beta.

title: Kindle 2026: A smaller, faster Kindle with a flush-front display | Product Hunt
og:title: Kindle 2026: A smaller, faster Kindle with a flush-front display | Product Hunt
og:description: Kindle 2026 is Amazon’s redesigned 6-inch e-reader, now smaller and lighter with 30% faster book opening and a flush-front display. It also comes in a new 32GB aluminum version for the first time.

title: Kishi Notch: Your MacBook notch, brought to life | Product Hunt
og:title: Kishi Notch: Your MacBook notch, brought to life | Product Hunt
og:description: Kishi Notch turns your MacBook notch into an interactive island: reply to WhatsApp, Messages and Mail notifications, join your next meeting in one click, control music, run timers and see AirPods battery. Plus a detailed menu bar battery.

title: Kitbar: Your dev tools, in one bar. | Product Hunt
og:title: Kitbar: Your dev tools, in one bar. | Product Hunt
og:description: Dev tool status bar for Mac and Windows: Vercel and Cloudflare deploys, GitHub and GitLab checks, Stripe and Polar payments, Claude Code and Codex limits, at a glance.

title: Kiwi: A proactive AI assistant that texts you before you ask | Product Hunt
og:title: Kiwi: A proactive AI assistant that texts you before you ask | Product Hunt
og:description: Kiwi is your proactive assistant. It keeps track of what's coming up, your trips, plans, bills and the people in them, and texts you at the right moment. When something needs doing, it does it on any app or website when you say yes. Your Saturday is free: want a plan with the kids? Your flight is delayed: want a car for when you land? Your parcel needs a signature while you're at work: move it to Saturday? It all happens in iMessage or WhatsApp. Free during the pilot.

title: Kling 4.0: Fast and affordable AI video for high-frequency creators | Product Hunt
og:title: Kling 4.0: Fast and affordable AI video for high-frequency creators | Product Hunt
og:description: Kling 4.0 is an AI video model for creators, marketers and studios who need control, not lucky rerolls. Unlike prompt-and-pray generators, you lock the story first: up to 10 keyframes, 15 reference assets and 8,000-token prompts drive 30-second clips in a single pass. Stereo audio and lip sync in 10+ languages are built in. Creative Recreation swaps products or characters in existing videos. Kling 4.0 Flash handles fast, cheaper drafts, and MCP + CLI access plugs it into agent workflows.

title: Knock: Secret button to control your Macbook! | Product Hunt
og:title: Knock: Secret button to control your Macbook! | Product Hunt
og:description: Knock is a shortcut app that lets you control your Mac by simply knocking on it. Tap the sides of your laptop and it runs any shortcut you want — screenshot, open apps, mute sound, and more. It uses your Mac's built-in accelerometer to actually feel the vibration of your knock and react in real time, no extra hardware needed - just knock and go.

title: Knocket: Chat with visitors from your website or link | Product Hunt
og:title: Knocket: Chat with visitors from your website or link | Product Hunt
og:description: Makers need a way for visitors to reach them, and to reply without opening another dashboard. Paste one script tag and a chat bubble appears on any site, or publish a contact page for your bio. Visitors start typing with no account needed. Messages go to Telegram. Quote-reply and it appears on their screen, and the thread stays in your inbox. If you're away, they leave an email. An AI agent answers from your docs and hands off to you when it matters. Free, no credit card, live in minutes.

title: Knuff App: Family check-in app to know your people are okay | Product Hunt
og:title: Knuff App: Family check-in app to know your people are okay | Product Hunt
og:description: Knuff is a family check-in app that makes it easy to see how your loved ones are doing, even when life gets busy. Create a bubble with your most important people and share quick check-ins to stay connected wherever life takes you. For families and friend groups of all ages. Core features free, optional paid add-ons available. For iOS and Android.

title: kōdlo: End-to-end sales workspace with unified context | Product Hunt
og:title: kōdlo: End-to-end sales workspace with unified context | Product Hunt
og:description: kōdlo finds prospects that fit your ICP and tells you how to warm each one up. Upload product catalogues and other docs to the Knowledge Hub, and its agent turns them into personalized messages, offers, deep searches and decks. Track client data, collaborate with your team, and manage tasks, all in one place. Connect Claude Desktop/ChatGPT Work or your code agent with kōdlo MCP to scale and orchestrate contexts.

title: Koi: Mac assistant that is a dictation app + meeting notetaker | Product Hunt
og:title: Koi: Mac assistant that is a dictation app + meeting notetaker | Product Hunt
og:description: Most people pay for three tools: a dictation app, a meeting notetaker and an AI assistant. Koi is all three in one Mac app. Tap Fn + ⌥ and your words type into any app, offline and unlimited. Tap Fn + ⌘ and talk to an AI that sees your screen, points at things and does them for you. Tap Fn + ⌃ to record any call with no bot joining, then get notes and to-dos. It all lands as pages on your Mac. Try it free for 3 days.

title: Kooler: Find cocktails you can make with what's in your bar | Product Hunt
og:title: Kooler: Find cocktails you can make with what's in your bar | Product Hunt
og:description: Kooler is a free cocktail recipe app for people who like making drinks at home. - My Bar: add the bottles and ingredients you have and see every drink you can make right now - 100+ curated recipes: classics, modern cocktails and Brazilian drinks like Caipirinha, Rabo de Galo and Macunaíma - Clear measurements, step-by-step methods and consistent photos - Check-ins: rate a drink you had at a bar and share it No ads, no paywall. Web + iOS.

title: Korinotch: Your MacBook notch, turned into a command center | Product Hunt
og:title: Korinotch: Your MacBook notch, turned into a command center | Product Hunt
og:description: Media HUD, notifications, file tray, clipboard, keep awake, keyboard lock and widgets, all in the notch. Native SwiftUI for macOS 14+. Free for 14 days, then $11.50 lifetime. Eleven of the utilities are free standalone menu-bar apps.

title: Krea: Design tool with AI inside | Product Hunt
og:title: Krea: Design tool with AI inside | Product Hunt
og:description: KREA is a website where you can use AI to make images and videos.

title: Kudos: AI that makes and saves you money, automatically | Product Hunt
og:title: Kudos: AI that makes and saves you money, automatically | Product Hunt
og:description: AI that picks the best card for every purchase. Calls your provider and negotiates lower bills in minutes. Cancels subscriptions you forgot about. You keep 100% of your savings — we never take a cut.

title: KugelAudio: Real-time text-to-speech model you can self-host | Product Hunt
og:title: KugelAudio: Real-time text-to-speech model you can self-host | Product Hunt
og:description: Most natural real-time TTS with voice cloning and sub-60ms latency, on-prem or via API. Grammar-aware normalization reads phone numbers, IBANs, addresses, and medications naturally across 25+ languages, with word-level timestamps and IPA support. Adapters for LiveKit, Pipecat, and Vapi. Built by 4 in Berlin.

title: Lancetta: Know when to push your coding agents, and when to ease off | Product Hunt
og:title: Lancetta: Know when to push your coding agents, and when to ease off | Product Hunt
og:description: Lancetta is a native macOS menu-bar app that tells you when and how to use Claude Code and Codex. From every quota reading it says what to do next: spend a window about to reset unused, slow down before an agent stops, move to the other agent while it has room. It checks what your agents load at every start, frees the background processes they leave behind, and keeps every session on one wall, the ones waiting on you first. Reading quota spends zero tokens. Free, signed, macOS 15+.

title: Latch: The app blocker you unlock by walking to your key | Product Hunt
og:title: Latch: The app blocker you unlock by walking to your key | Product Hunt
og:description: Latch locks distracting apps until you scan your key, and the key lives where you have to walk: an NFC sticker on the fridge, a printed QR code, or a number of steps. No account, no ads, no analytics. iPhone and Android; Pro is $9.99 once.

title: LaunchReel: claude design but for editing professional videos faster. | Product Hunt
og:title: LaunchReel: claude design but for editing professional videos faster. | Product Hunt
og:description: LaunchReel is a Claude Code plugin that makes your videos: launch films and demos for your real product, written as code from your repo, and talking-head reels cut from your raw recordings. Claude does the work; LaunchReel adds a director's playbook, original music, voiceover and a studio to edit it yourself. Export 16:9 or 9:16, up to 4K.

title: Lazy AWS: A keyboard-driven home for your AWS resources | Product Hunt
og:title: Lazy AWS: A keyboard-driven home for your AWS resources | Product Hunt
og:description: Your AWS resources. One terminal. Browse, inspect, and run confirmed AWS CLI actions without leaving your keyboard.

title: Lea by LeanAIOS: Autonomous AI team for construction management & pre-con | Product Hunt
og:title: Lea by LeanAIOS: Autonomous AI team for construction management & pre-con | Product Hunt
og:description: Meet Lea, the autonomous AI platform built specifically for construction GCs and PMs. With 18 specialized roles, Lea automates quantities takeoff, manages FIDIC contract notice deadlines, tracks 6-week lookahead schedules, and runs 3D site rehearsals.

title: Leanback: The First Manager Ai Assistance | Product Hunt
og:title: Leanback: The First Manager Ai Assistance | Product Hunt
og:description: Leanback is your personal AI assistant for managing engineering teams. It checks in with your team, reads every ticket and calendar, and delivers a clear action plan inside Slack, before your first coffee.

title: LearnExcel: Learn Excel by typing real formulas, graded instantly | Product Hunt
og:title: LearnExcel: Learn Excel by typing real formulas, graded instantly | Product Hunt
og:description: LearnExcel teaches Excel by doing, not watching. Each exercise is a small spreadsheet and a task: you type the formula in your browser and it's graded instantly, and any formula that really works is accepted. 280+ exercises from SUM and IF to INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, pivot tables and NPV/IRR, 40+ free function guides, and a 7-day plan plus a timed mock test for Excel job-interview tests. Free to start, no signup, in 6 languages.

title: Lecta: Turn your class notes into games with friends | Product Hunt
og:title: Lecta: Turn your class notes into games with friends | Product Hunt
og:description: Upload a PDF, snap a handout, or add a lecture recording. Lecta turns your material into quiz matches and races you can play with friends. In Formula Race, correct answers make your car faster. Study solo with notes, quizzes, flashcards, and an AI tutor. Available on iPhone in English and Japanese, with a free plan. Web version coming soon.

title: LegacyFixer: Python dependency security scans with optional fix PRs | Product Hunt
og:title: LegacyFixer: Python dependency security scans with optional fix PRs | Product Hunt
og:description: Compared with Dependabot and Renovate, LegacyFixer focuses on security-first scanning of Python dependencies. It reports vulnerability findings even when an automated fix is not appropriate, and creates a fix pull request only when its policy and validation checks allow it. Each scan produces an explicit outcome, including detect-only (NO_ACTION) when no fix PR is created. LegacyFixer runs as a GitHub App on Google Cloud Run.

title: Letra: Copy the text your Mac won’t let you select | Product Hunt
og:title: Letra: Copy the text your Mac won’t let you select | Product Hunt
og:description: A link in a screen share. Code in a video. Text in a scanned PDF. Press ⇧⌘2, drag, and paste. Letra turns on-screen text into clipboard text, entirely on your Mac. Includes QR scanning, multilingual OCR, and searchable history. $5.99 once. No subscription.

title: Moli by Lexmount: The fastest headless browser for agents and harnesses | Product Hunt
og:title: Moli by Lexmount: The fastest headless browser for agents and harnesses | Product Hunt
og:description: Moli by Lexmount is our browser engine built from scratch for AI agents. It starts faster and uses less memory than Chrome. Use Moli through Lexmount Browser, our cloud browser platform. Run multiple isolated browser sessions with proxy support while we handle the infrastructure. Let your agents browse, fill out forms, and extract data. Try it in our Playground or connect through our SDK.

title: Liquid AI: Device-native foundation models. | Product Hunt
og:title: Liquid AI: Device-native foundation models. | Product Hunt
og:description:
Advanced intelligence for processors outside of data centers.
Built for the latency, privacy, and hardware constraints of the physical world.

title: licenseal: Catch incompatible dependency licenses before release | Product Hunt
og:title: licenseal: Catch incompatible dependency licenses before release | Product Hunt
og:description: A free, open-source CLI that checks every dependency license, transitive ones included, against your project's license, in 10 ecosystems. It reads lockfiles and registry metadata, installs nothing, and gives CI a verdict, not a list.

title: Linda: Your private AI coworker for the Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: Linda: Your private AI coworker for the Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: Linda is a free, private AI coworker for your Mac. Say or type what you need and it does the work in its own browser and your folders: research, price checks, pages, sheets, renamed files, replies. Set up specialists, like a Researcher or a Bookkeeper, with their own instructions and skills. Watch every step in the Computer column and take over any time. It runs local AI on Apple Silicon or uses your own key, and asks before it sends, buys, deletes or posts. No account.

title: LinkIntel: Your AI writes your posts. Now it knows what worked. | Product Hunt
og:title: LinkIntel: Your AI writes your posts. Now it knows what worked. | Product Hunt
og:description: Your AI already drafts your X posts, but it has never seen how they performed. LinkIntel fixes that. Connect X once and it records how your recent posts do, every day. It also reads X's open-source ranking weights daily and links every change to its GitHub commit. Add one URL to Claude, ChatGPT, or your favorite agent harness and ask for a brief: your next draft starts from what actually worked for you

title: Liquid Inference: LLM router where providers compete for every prompt | Product Hunt
og:title: Liquid Inference: LLM router where providers compete for every prompt | Product Hunt
og:description: * Fully compatible with agentic coding tools: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Pi, Cline, and many more. Full multi-modal support. * Hundreds of open- and closed-weight models. Create routing rule presets or use our Auto routing algorithms. * Providers compete dynamically on price for every prompt, offering the lowest marginal cost. * Sign up for free with email, first 500 users get $20 of free inference. Receive 20% of referred fees as free inference, 10% for second-level referrals.

title: Llama Windows: One local AI server for all your Windows apps | Product Hunt
og:title: Llama Windows: One local AI server for all your Windows apps | Product Hunt
og:description: Llama Windows brings llama.cpp to the Windows 11 system tray. Download open models from Hugging Face in one click, chat via Alt+Space, and let coding agents, editors and scripts share a local OpenAI-compatible API and model cache. Free and open source.

title: Lloyal: Turn open-weight models into AI apps people can download | Product Hunt
og:title: Lloyal: Turn open-weight models into AI apps people can download | Product Hunt
og:description: Start with a working TypeScript AI app with built-in inference and a multi-agent runtime. In-app agents can research, read local files, understand documents and compose specialist models. Works offline, no API keys or complicated setup for your users. Customize and ship it to desktop, web or terminal in minutes 🚀

title: Lofi Desk: Dynamic room & companion that changes based on your music | Product Hunt
og:title: Lofi Desk: Dynamic room & companion that changes based on your music  | Product Hunt
og:description: Struggling to focus? Lofi Desk creates the perfect deep work environment. 🎧 Dynamic Atmosphere: The room and character react to the music (Cafe, Rain, Retro), keeping you engaged. 🍅 Pomodoro Timer: Built-in customizable timer. Never work alone again.

title: LooGo: Find public restrooms fast | Product Hunt
og:title: LooGo: Find public restrooms fast | Product Hunt
og:description: LooGo helps you find public restrooms instantly when you're out in the city. Built natively for Android and Wear OS using OpenStreetMap data, it gives you quick access to door codes, pricing, opening hours, and accessibility details. No ads, no tracking, and no bloat just fast offline maps and a companion Wear OS app so you can find a spot directly from your wrist.

title: Lookout (for Slack): Urgent Slack messages, handled instantly. Powered by Jev. | Product Hunt
og:title: Lookout (for Slack): Urgent Slack messages, handled instantly. Powered by Jev. | Product Hunt
og:description: Using Jev, Lookout watches Slack for time-sensitive messages and takes the action you choose instantly.

title: Loom: Easily record and share videos | Product Hunt
og:title: Loom: Easily record and share videos | Product Hunt
og:description: Record your screen and camera across desktop, Chrome, or mobile, and share instantly with a click. Loom transforms video messages and meetings into clear context and next steps for your teammates and AI tools.

title: Loqui: Turns your voice into ready-to-send text in any Mac app | Product Hunt
og:title: Loqui: Turns your voice into ready-to-send text in any Mac app | Product Hunt
og:description: Loqui turns your voice into clean, ready-to-send text in any app on your Mac. Hold a shortcut, speak, and the text lands at your cursor in the tone you pick. It also transcribes meetings and writes the minutes. 90+ languages. Free plan, no card needed.

title: Lovable: The world's first AI Fullstack Engineer | Product Hunt
og:title: Lovable: The world's first AI Fullstack Engineer | Product Hunt
og:description: The AI Fullstack Engineer that works. Ship lovable full-stack applications 20x faster than by writing code ❤

title: Lugh Xtudio: The video studio where AI agents edit with you | Product Hunt
og:title: Lugh Xtudio: The video studio where AI agents edit with you | Product Hunt
og:description: Lugh Xtudio is a video editor where AI agents edit with you on a real timeline. Give each channel a workspace with its own style, run several agents on one video or many, and create 3D, maps and custom effects by asking. Free on Mac, Windows and Linux (beta).

title: Lume – Floating Notes for Windows: Notes that appear with a mouse shake | Product Hunt
og:title: Lume – Floating Notes for Windows: Notes that appear with a mouse shake | Product Hunt
og:description: Lume is a native Windows notes app (WinUI 3, no Electron) that stays hidden until you need it. Shake your mouse or press a shortcut, write, and press Esc — it’s gone. Beyond quick notes: a scratchpad that does maths as you type, freehand drawing on notes, and local-first storage with optional OneDrive sync. Free for up to 20 notes. Reading, search and export always stay free.

title: Lune: The search engine built for scientific AI agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Lune: The search engine built for scientific AI agents | Product Hunt
og:description: Lune is Exa.ai for scientific research. It connects AI agents to research knowledge and tools built for scientific workflows, and provides high-quality knowledge grounding based on papers from top-tier academic conferences. 10x the efficiency and trustworthiness of literature review, experimental design, writing and peer review. From early ideas to publication, it helps researchers and technical teams move faster with traceable sources, deeper grounding, and rigorous, evidence-backed decisions.

title: MacCam: The camera app Apple never shipped for the Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: MacCam: The camera app Apple never shipped for the Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: MacCam is a free, native camera app for macOS. Take photos and videos with your Mac's camera, iPhone or any webcam - straight into Apple Photos. Classic Photo Booth effects plus Portrait, Studio Light and Edge Light built in. Coming to Pro: a teleprompter, eye contact and knock to shoot - free for life for the first 100,000.

title: Maildun for Mac: Design on-brand emails by hand, with AI, or over MCP | Product Hunt
og:title: Maildun for Mac: Design on-brand emails by hand, with AI, or over MCP | Product Hunt
og:description: Maildun for Mac is an agentic email builder for macOS. Design by hand in the drag-and-drop editor, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok with your own API key: the assistant edits your design live, as a proposal you accept or reject. Turn on the built-in MCP server and Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can create and edit emails too. Plus workspaces per client, brand kits with shadcn-style component styles, saved sections, media on your own R2 or S3 bucket, and publishing to maildun.com.

title: Mailwell: Native Mac mail for IMAP, JMAP and Microsoft 365 | Product Hunt
og:title: Mailwell: Native Mac mail for IMAP, JMAP and Microsoft 365 | Product Hunt
og:description: Mailwell is a native Mac mail app for people with more than one account. Gmail, iCloud, Fastmail, Kagi Mail, Microsoft 365 and any IMAP or JMAP server share one unified inbox. Mail is stored on your Mac and syncs straight to your provider: no Mailwell servers, no tracking, no ads. Inbox tabs, rules, snooze, send later, and undo for everything. AI is optional and off by default. Turn on MCP and Claude can search your mail, read only.

title: Make0 Brain: A memory store that works across all of your AI agents. | Product Hunt
og:title: Make0 Brain: A memory store that works across all of your AI agents. | Product Hunt
og:description: Make0 Brain is a personal memory store that works across ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible AI tools. AI agents can read and write to this memory and be in sync with your personal context. It is like dropbox but for memories - specifically built for agents to use. You can easily build your brain in just 2 minutes by importing your conversations from Claude, ChatGPT and even dropping your markdown files and documents.

title: Manifold MCP: SEO, AI answers, social, ads and leads data for your agent | Product Hunt
og:title: Manifold MCP: SEO, AI answers, social, ads and leads data for your agent | Product Hunt
og:description: Manifold gives your agent live data from every marketing channel, in one hosted MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Claude Code. Find keywords one push from page one. See if ChatGPT and Gemini recommend you. Watch the TikToks winning your niche. Read your competitors’ live ads. Catch Reddit threads asking for what you make. Get verified emails for buyers looking right now. Ask in plain words and your agent does the work. No pile of tabs. Free to start.

title: Manus: General agent that turns your thoughts into actions | Product Hunt
og:title: Manus: General agent that turns your thoughts into actions | Product Hunt
og:description: Manus is a general AI agent that turns your thoughts into actions. It excels at various tasks in work and life, getting everything done while you rest.

title: Many Displays: Zero clicks: windows back after sleep, unlock or replugging | Product Hunt
og:title: Many Displays: Zero clicks: windows back after sleep, unlock or replugging | Product Hunt
og:description: Nothing to save, no layouts to name, nothing to click. Many Displays quietly remembers where every window lives (display, position, size) and puts everything back on its own when your Mac wakes, unlocks or reconnects its monitors. Grant Accessibility once and forget it's there. Built for identical monitors that macOS keeps swapping: it tells them apart, even by the port they're plugged into. No cloud, no account. $19 one-time, 14-day free trial.

title: ManyAgents: Run a team of AI coding agents from one Mac window | Product Hunt
og:title: ManyAgents: Run a team of AI coding agents from one Mac window | Product Hunt
og:description: An orchestrator splits your work across Claude Code and Codex agents, each in its own git worktree. A reviewer checks the result, a built-in browser lets agents test their own work, and every question lands in one place. Uses the plans you already have. Free for 14 days.

title: Markdoc: A shared Markdown editor for people and their agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Markdoc: A shared Markdown editor for people and their agents | Product Hunt
og:description: Write Markdown with the source and an editable preview side by side, live for everyone in the document. Review with comments and suggestions, bring your own agent over MCP, and publish straight to a gist or a repository file.

title: Marv: An AI cursor companion that shows you what to click | Product Hunt
og:title: Marv: An AI cursor companion that shows you what to click | Product Hunt
og:description: Meet Marv, your cursor’s new plus-one. Hold a hotkey and ask about anything on your screen. Marv answers out loud while drawing arrows, circling buttons and writing notes directly on your screen to walk you through it. Debug some code, work out a spreadsheet formula or find the right control in your video editor, all without leaving the app you’re using.

title: MausBot: Open source Grok Bot: Free, Local | Product Hunt
og:title: MausBot: Open source Grok Bot: Free, Local | Product Hunt
og:description: Give each bot a job and work with it in a familiar chat interface. MausBot brings your supported AI agents together on your computer, with tools and routines for getting work done. Free and open source under Apache 2.0. Bring your own provider account or API key; provider fees and limits apply.

title: Maybloc: new SOTA for speech-to-text for multi-speaker audio | Product Hunt
og:title: Maybloc: new SOTA for speech-to-text for multi-speaker audio | Product Hunt
og:description: Speech-to-text built for conversations with more than one voice with highest accuracy than any in the industry. Lowest diarization error on several benchmarks. 45 languages, up to 25 speakers. Add-ons: subtitles, PII redaction, summaries, speaker names, translation. Better than Pyannote, Deepgram and Assembly AI

title: mcpgawk: Catch MCP servers that change after you approved them | Product Hunt
og:title: mcpgawk: Catch MCP servers that change after you approved them | Product Hunt
og:description: An MCP server can change what its tools do after you approved it. Your agent will call the new one and never notice. mcpgawk records a baseline of every MCP server your agents use, checks behaviour in a sandbox, and sits in the path: once a tool's description or power changes, the call is refused until you decide. The agent cannot approve its own way past it. Everything runs on your machine. Nothing is uploaded. Free CLI, VS Code extension and MCP server. The gateway tier has a 7-day trial.

title: MeetNote: AI meeting notes for Google Meet, no bot joins your call | Product Hunt
og:title: MeetNote: AI meeting notes for Google Meet, no bot joins your call | Product Hunt
og:description: MeetNote writes a live transcript of your Google Meet calls in Chrome's side panel, then gives you a summary, decisions and action items when the call ends. No bot, no sign-up. Notes stay in your browser, and you pick the AI or run it on-device.

title: MeetPaw: Instant meetings from your mac menu bar | Product Hunt
og:title: MeetPaw: Instant meetings from your mac menu bar  | Product Hunt
og:description: MeetPaw is a lightweight macOS menu-bar app that puts your meetings one click away. Spin up an instant Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams link the moment you need it. The link is created, copied to your clipboard, and ready to share before you've switched windows. No tabs, no digging, no friction.

title: Melete: An Always On Personal Agent With a Team Workspace | Product Hunt
og:title: Melete: An Always On Personal Agent With a Team Workspace | Product Hunt
og:description: Meet Melete, Your Personal Agent, on your hardware. The more you use AI, the more you have to teach it. Every new chat means explaining the project again. Melete is a personal AI agent with its own computer. It remembers what you're working on, keeps unfinished jobs moving while you're away, and picks a project back up weeks later without starting over. Melete Cloud is open for waitlist signups. For companies, we're taking a small number of pilot teams.

title: Memory Chess: Train your chess memory: study a position, rebuild it | Product Hunt
og:title: Memory Chess: Train your chess memory: study a position, rebuild it | Product Hunt
og:description: Memory Chess is a free chess memory trainer. Study a position for a few seconds, rebuild it from memory, and see every square scored. Track your skill rating, memory span and speed as you improve, play the same daily board as everyone else, and share a card that replays your round. No account needed, in 24 languages. Join other players on Telegram: t.me/TheMemoryChess

title: MentionBird: Ahrefs for AI Search | Product Hunt
og:title: MentionBird: Ahrefs for AI Search | Product Hunt
og:description: We took the top 3 Product Hunt launches and asked ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude the exact questions their buyers ask: “Best browser for Claude Code?” “How do I track agent run costs?” “Best open-source Grok alternative?” Nine answers. Zero mentions. AI sent their buyers elsewhere. That’s how AI search works. It pulls from pages it trusts—listicles, Reddit, comparisons, YouTube. If you’re not there, you’re not in the answer. MentionBird helps you fix that.

title: MePersona: Answer every fan comment in your voice | Product Hunt
og:title: MePersona: Answer every fan comment in your voice | Product Hunt
og:description: MePersona is the unified social media inbox for content creators, but the inbox is only where it starts. Your Persona learns how you talk and improves with every reply you approve. It drafts replies to comments and DMs from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X and more, scores how much each sounds like you, and remembers what each fan said last time. Nothing posts until you hit Send. It works in English and Spanish, so bilingual creators stop choosing which half of their audience gets a real answer.

title: Mercury: The First Commercial-Scale Diffusion LLM | Product Hunt
og:title: Mercury: The First Commercial-Scale Diffusion LLM | Product Hunt
og:description: Mercury,from Inception Labs, is the first commercial diffusion LLM. Up to 10x faster than autoregressive models, with comparable or better quality on coding tasks.

title: Mermaid: Tell your Mac what to do. From literally anywhere | Product Hunt
og:title: Mermaid: Tell your Mac what to do. From literally anywhere | Product Hunt
og:description: You know when you’re out and remember the one thing that’s sitting on your Mac at home? That’s why we made Mermaid. You just text your Mac from your iPhone, like you’d text a friend, and it actually does the thing. It opens your apps, finds the file, writes the email, almost do anything and you can watch it happen on your phone.It’s not a chatbot and it’s not remote desktop. It just gets stuff done.

title: Meta AI: Ask Meta AI anything | Product Hunt
og:title: Meta AI: Ask Meta AI anything | Product Hunt
og:description: Use Meta AI assistant to get things done, create AI-generated images for free, and get answers to any of your questions. Meta AI is built on Meta's latest Llama large language model and uses Emu.

title: Mi Speaks: Voice communication made easy | Product Hunt
og:title: Mi Speaks: Voice communication made easy | Product Hunt
og:description: Mi Speaks empowers communication through innovative voice technology, making it easier than ever to express yourself.

title: Microsoft-Decision-1: Microsoft’s decision model for agents and workflows | Product Hunt
