og:title: Microsoft-Decision-1: Microsoft’s decision model for agents and workflows | Product Hunt
og:description: Microsoft-Decision-1 is a decision-scoring model for routing, classification, verification and agent control. Give it fixed options and it returns a calibrated probability for each in a single pass, as structured output software can act on directly. Post-trained from Qwen3.5-9B, it is about 35x faster than GPT-6 Sol at median latency, per Microsoft. Available now in Microsoft Foundry at $0.042 per million input tokens, with free output.

title: Microsoft Maia 300: Microsoft’s own AI chip, headed to multi-gigawatts | Product Hunt
og:title: Microsoft Maia 300: Microsoft’s own AI chip, headed to multi-gigawatts | Product Hunt
og:description: Maia 300 is Microsoft’s next-generation AI inference platform, announced Oct 12, 2026. Per Microsoft, it’s built for long-context reasoning, low-latency conversation, and agents, with 8 HBM4 stacks, TSMC N2P compute chiplets, and 96-accelerator racks. Microsoft claims 40% more tokens per megawatt. Production starts in 2027, and Azure Maia scales to multi-gigawatt deployments, becoming the main inference system for Microsoft’s products.

title: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra: Run 120B AI models locally on Microsoft's new Surface | Product Hunt
og:title: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra: Run 120B AI models locally on Microsoft's new Surface | Product Hunt
og:description: Surface Laptop Ultra is Microsoft's most powerful Surface yet, powered by NVIDIA's RTX Spark Superchip. With Blackwell RTX graphics, up to 128GB of unified memory, and support for running AI models up to 120B parameters locally, it's built for developers, creators, and AI enthusiasts who want serious computing power without relying on the cloud. All packed into a 15-inch touchscreen laptop weighing under 4.5 lbs.

title: Microsoft Xbox Series S: Next-gen Performance in the smallest Xbox ever | Product Hunt
og:title: Microsoft Xbox Series S: Next-gen Performance in the smallest Xbox ever | Product Hunt
og:description: The next generation of gaming brings our largest digital library yet to our smallest Xbox ever. With more dynamic worlds, faster load times, and the addition of Xbox Game Pass (sold separately), the all-digital Xbox Series S is the best value in gaming.

title: Milepost: An iOS driving journal for your car, with an MCP server | Product Hunt
og:title: Milepost: An iOS driving journal for your car, with an MCP server | Product Hunt
og:description: Milepost is a driving journal for your car on iOS, with an MCP server for ChatGPT, Claude, and other compatible AI agents. Record routes, photos, notes, music, and moments in Roadbooks. Share with friends for reactions and comments, or send a public web link. Build your garage, collect city and state stamps in each car’s Stampbook, relive routes in 3D, and make animated shares and monthly recaps. Record for free; Pro unlocks older history, exports, and deeper insights.

title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash: MiniMax’s Flash model, 3x faster and 70% cheaper for agents | Product Hunt
og:title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash: MiniMax’s Flash model, 3x faster and 70% cheaper for agents | Product Hunt
og:description: MiniMax M3.1 Flash is MiniMax’s new Flash model for agentic tasks, coding, computer use and cybersecurity. MiniMax says it is about 3x faster online and 70% cheaper for agentic tasks than its predecessor, with output at 200+ tokens per second. Pricing is $0.15 input and $0.60 output per 1M tokens. It’s on the MiniMax API, M Plan and MiniMax Code, and weights are promised later.

title: Mintlify: The intelligent knowledge platform | Product Hunt
og:title: Mintlify: The intelligent knowledge platform | Product Hunt
og:description: The next generation of documentation. AI-native, beautiful out-of-the-box, and built for collaboration.

title: Mira Tours: AI Walking Tour Guide | Product Hunt
og:title: Mira Tours: AI Walking Tour Guide | Product Hunt
og:description: Mira is your AI tour guide. Walking audio tours, anywhere in the world: chat to build your own, or just start walking and hear the story of the places around you.

title: miso.com: Book flights and hotels through iMessage | Product Hunt
og:title: miso.com: Book flights and hotels through iMessage | Product Hunt
og:description: Stop opening 20 tabs to book a trip. Miso is an AI travel agent in iMessage that finds, books, and manages flights and hotels for you. Just text where you want to go and Miso searches live options, learns your travel preferences, and handles the booking in the same conversation. With direct airline access and 24/7 support, you can go from “I need to be in London Tuesday” to booked without leaving Messages.

title: Mistral AI: Open and portable generative AI for devs and businesses | Product Hunt
og:title: Mistral AI: Open and portable generative AI for devs and businesses | Product Hunt
og:description:
- We’re committed to empower the AI community with open technology. Our open models sets the bar for efficiency, and are available for free, with fully permissive license. 
- Our optimized commercial models are designed for performance and are available via our flexible deployment options.

title: Agent Hunt: Live rankings of the tools AI agents use most | Product Hunt
og:title: Agent Hunt: Live rankings of the tools AI agents use most | Product Hunt
og:description: We connect your AI agent to 2,700+ APIs without any subscriptions, 0% markup. Your agent can now discover, run, and pay for tools at runtime. Agent Hunt is a live leaderboard of the tools AI agents actually use. Every place is earned by real calls agents make through Monid

title: Monish: Your AI agents, live on your iPhone lock screen | Product Hunt
og:title: Monish: Your AI agents, live on your iPhone lock screen | Product Hunt
og:description: Paste one line into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, n8n or any script. Your agent can then put live progress on your lock screen, ping you when it's done, and ask before it deploys, sends or spends: Approve or Deny from the notification. Free, no account.

title: Moonwalkers Dusk: Strap-on motorized wheels that let you walk twice as fast | Product Hunt
og:title: Moonwalkers Dusk: Strap-on motorized wheels that let you walk twice as fast | Product Hunt
og:description: Discover Moonwalkers Dusk electric shoes by Shift Robotics. Our lightest robotic shoes yet, with three sizes, three finishes, and speeds up to 7 mph.

title: Mouse-1: A decision model for your agent harness. | Product Hunt
og:title: Mouse-1: A decision model for your agent harness.  | Product Hunt
og:description: An agent makes hundreds of small decisions during a task. We built Mouse-1 to handle these decisions, saving you time and money. Its 163x cheaper, and 65x faster than GPT-6 Sol. It works by adding the model directly into your agent harness alongside your current stack. Mouse-1 takes the agent's state and options and returns a probability. This lets the harness handle all the small decisions while the main frontier model takes care of the reasoning or code.

title: Moxie: Use any AI with Claude Code, switch accounts mid-task | Product Hunt
og:title: Moxie: Use any AI with Claude Code, switch accounts mid-task | Product Hunt
og:description: Moxie is a Mac menu bar app for Claude Code. Use your ChatGPT plan, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter or local models in Ollama, all from the Claude Code you already use. Hit a usage limit? Pick another account in one click and keep the same session going. Every account's 5-hour and weekly limits sit in the menu bar.

title: Mozilla: A non-profit with one mission defend the free and open web. | Product Hunt
og:title: Mozilla: A non-profit with one mission defend the free and open web. | Product Hunt
og:description: At Mozilla, we’re a global community of technologists, thinkers and builders working together to keep the Internet alive and accessible, so people worldwide can be informed contributors and creators of the Web. We believe this act of human collaboration across an open platform is essential to individual growth and our collective future.

title: Mozy: Walk to Unlock Apps: 🌱 Walk More. Scroll Less. Unlock Apps with Movement. | Product Hunt
og:title: Mozy: Walk to Unlock Apps:  🌱 Walk More. Scroll Less. Unlock Apps with Movement. | Product Hunt
og:description: Mozy helps you break the scrolling habit by turning your physical activity into screen time. Walk. Earn screen time. Unlock apps. No walking? No scrolling. Mozy is a unique app blocker and step counter that rewards movement instead of punishing phone use. Every step you take earns screen time minutes that can be used on your favorite apps. Once your earned time runs out, Mozy blocks access until you get moving again.

title: MRRaudit: Understand why your MRR differs and get a number you trust | Product Hunt
og:title: MRRaudit: Understand why your MRR differs and get a number you trust | Product Hunt
og:description: MRRaudit explains why your MRR numbers differ so you can get to a figure you trust. Compare Stripe and ChartMogul customer by customer, trace discrepancies to invoices and subscription events, and choose how billing events affect MRR. Built by the ChartMogul team, who've obsessed over SaaS metrics since 2014 and helped thousands of SaaS businesses investigate these differences by hand through calls and support tickets. Read-only access. No ChartMogul account required.

title: Mudroom: Run coding agents in a VM, review changes like a PR | Product Hunt
og:title: Mudroom: Run coding agents in a VM, review changes like a PR | Product Hunt
og:description: Mudroom runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and other agents in a Linux sandbox on a copy of your project, behind a network allowlist. Review the diff like a PR and apply only what you want, with undo. Mac app, plus a CLI for Linux and Windows. Free, MIT.

title: Murmur: A private voice-first notepad for your thoughts | Product Hunt
og:title: Murmur: A private voice-first notepad for your thoughts | Product Hunt
og:description: Murmur is a private, voice-first memory for your thoughts. Speak instead of typing, and Murmur turns your fleeting thoughts into searchable memories. Later, ask what you were thinking about, rediscover forgotten ideas, or send a thought to your future self with Future Capsules. No feeds. No followers. Just your thoughts, remembered.

title: Muse by Meta: Your personal AI agent that gets things done | Product Hunt
og:title: Muse by Meta: Your personal AI agent that gets things done | Product Hunt
og:description: Try Muse, your personal AI agent that gets things done. Give Muse a goal or an everyday task and it handles the rest, from finances and health to shopping and the people you care about.

og:title: Muse Spark Open: The most capable US open weights model to date | Product Hunt
og:description: Meta's open weights model built for coding and agentic work. 816B total parameters with 42B active, a 1M token context window and native multimodal input. Download the weights on Hugging Face or run it on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios with MLX.

title: Museum of Models: Every answer 371 AI models gave to the same questions | Product Hunt
og:title: Museum of Models: Every answer 371 AI models gave to the same questions | Product Hunt

title: Music Dawn: A recorder for musicians. Every idea sounds finished. | Product Hunt
og:title: Music Dawn: A recorder for musicians. Every idea sounds finished. | Product Hunt
og:description: Music Dawn is a recorder made for musicians. Record an idea in one tap, hear it with a finished sound right away, and keep every take in one library on all your devices. iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Free, with optional Pro.

title: MyLens AI: 1-1 Presentations at Scale with AI. | Product Hunt
og:title: MyLens AI: 1-1 Presentations at Scale with AI. | Product Hunt
og:description: MyLens is AI for live 1-1 presentations at scale. You add your raw sources, say what matters, and invite your audience. MyLens AI gives every person a live, private presentation, answers their questions using your sources, and can create new slides and layers in real time during the presentation. Then it tells you how each session went, so you can see who’s doing well, who’s stuck, and what to do next.

title: myPip: Vibe code, publish, and monetize games with AI | Product Hunt
og:title: myPip: Vibe code, publish, and monetize games with AI | Product Hunt
og:description: MyPip turns your game ideas into playable games you can publish and monetize. Describe what you want to build, and AI brings it to life directly in your browser, no coding required. Create multiplayer experiences, add in-app purchases and ads, and take your games beyond the browser to reach more players. From your first idea to publishing and monetization, MyPip gives anyone the tools to become a game creator.

title: N8N Chat UI: Beautiful, no-code, on-brand AI chat widgets for n8n | Product Hunt
og:title: N8N Chat UI: Beautiful, no-code, on-brand AI chat widgets for n8n | Product Hunt
og:description: N8N Chat UI is a no-code builder for branded AI chat widgets, built for n8n users, agencies, SaaS teams, and businesses. Design a mobile-friendly chat experience with live preview, then connect it to any n8n workflow and embed it anywhere. Unlike default n8n chat, it adds deep customization, streaming, voice and file uploads, flexible layouts, and a JavaScript API for advanced integrations.

title: Naarchy: A little island for everything on your Linux desktop | Product Hunt
og:title: Naarchy: A little island for everything on your Linux desktop | Product Hunt
og:description: Naarchy brings a file shelf, searchable clipboard history, music controls, a focus timer, and your calendar to the top of your Linux desktop. Native Rust and GTK4. Built for Omarchy and Hyprland, with or without a physical notch. Free, MIT licensed, and open source. Clipboard and shelf content stay on your machine. No account. No telemetry.

title: NANI???: Your interpreter and your boss doesn't even know. | Product Hunt
og:title: NANI???: Your interpreter and your boss doesn't even know. | Product Hunt
og:description: NANI??? Ever sat through a call understanding nothing, then realised someone just asked you a question? Nani? learns who’s speaking by voice, right on your Mac, and floats live translated subtitles over any call. No bot joins, so nobody sees a thing. When your boss asks you something, it chimes and suggests replies you can say back, even in a language you don’t speak. Add context and a glossary before the call, and get a summary with action items after. Next time, you won’t have to say NANI???

title: NativeShip: The easy way to launch your n8n native integration | Product Hunt
og:title: NativeShip: The easy way to launch your n8n native integration | Product Hunt
og:description: NativeShip helps SaaS teams launch and maintain an n8n integration from their existing API. Nodes follow n8n's official guidelines and are ready for verification, with standard publishing and maintenance built in. Shape the node with a live preview, publish from your own GitHub and npm in one click, and track every release. No technical skills needed.

title: Needle: The agent-native outbound engine | Product Hunt
og:title: Needle: The agent-native outbound engine | Product Hunt
og:description:
Find, enrich, and reach out to your perfect leads with one prompt in Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok — on whichever channel they're on.

Needle is everything you need to run outbound like a pro.

title: Neophyte: Watch an AI agent sign up and onboard to any product | Product Hunt
og:title: Neophyte:  Watch an AI agent sign up and onboard to any product | Product Hunt
og:description: Give Neophyte any product URL and watch an AI agent onboard from scratch. It creates an identity, signs up, verifies its email, navigates setup, and attempts activation. Use the captured product flow and friction report to find drop-off risks, audit launches, test onboarding changes, research competitors, and improve experiences for humans and agents.

title: Netra: A watchful notch with tools to keep you focused | Product Hunt
og:title: Netra: A watchful notch with tools to keep you focused | Product Hunt
og:description: Your Mac notch is empty black space. This puts a pair of cute eyes there. They follow your cursor, blink, and look sleepy when you step away. Click them and you get the useful stuff: a focus timer, a clipboard, a shelf to hold files you are working on, music controls for Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube, and a simple view of which apps you used.It stays in the notch. No extra window. The eyes are the fun part. The tools are why you might keep it.

title: Never Boring AI: The AI agent that writes your LinkedIn posts in your voice | Product Hunt
og:title: Never Boring AI: The AI agent that writes your LinkedIn posts in your voice | Product Hunt
og:description: Never Boring AI is an AI agent for LinkedIn. It interviews you about your work, keeps your stories in memory and turns them into posts written in your voice. It plans your content weeks ahead, learns from every edit you make, then schedules and publishes on LinkedIn for you. Built for freelancers, consultants and founders who know what they do but never know what to post this week. Works in English and French.

title: New Windows Search: Windows Search now takes action, not just finds files | Product Hunt
og:title: New Windows Search: Windows Search now takes action, not just finds files | Product Hunt
og:description: Microsoft is rebuilding Windows Search to help you do things, not just find them. The new experience is faster, cleaner, and lets you take action directly from the search box. Switch to dark mode, toggle Bluetooth, adjust brightness, mute your PC, or arrange windows simply by typing what you need. Built on WinUI 3 with improved search relevance, it's rolling out to Windows Insiders first, with richer previews and more actions on the way.

title: NewMinecraftServers: Minecraft server discovery, analytics, & spoof detection. | Product Hunt
og:title: NewMinecraftServers: Minecraft server discovery, analytics, & spoof detection. | Product Hunt
og:description: NewMinecraftServers helps players find their next Minecraft community and gives server owners tools to grow theirs. Discover Java and Bedrock servers, explore player statistics, and follow activity trends before choosing where to play. Owners can claim and promote their server listing, showcase their community, and access detailed analytics on player counts, uptime, peak activity, and busiest hours -- making it easier to understand their audience and attract new players.

title: ngram: Video agent for product and marketing teams | Product Hunt
og:title: ngram: Video agent for product and marketing teams | Product Hunt
og:description: Product updates deserve better than text-only changelogs, expensive agency cycles, or generic AI slop. ngram’s AI video agent turns release notes, specs, screenshots, docs, URLs, and product recordings into polished, on-brand videos for launches, demos, onboarding, support, sales, and social. It plans the message, writes the script, builds the storyboard, creates visual variants, and helps teams communicate every product story clearly.

title: Nimbalyst Wiki: Wiki your agents write for you to think, organize, direct | Product Hunt
og:title: Nimbalyst Wiki: Wiki your agents write for you to think, organize, direct | Product Hunt
og:description: Overwhelmed and disorganized by Codex and Claude Code? Nimbalyst wiki is a local wiki your agents write for you so you can think, organize, and set direction Your agents organize decisions, open questions, and the big picture into a wiki you can edit visually. It is a free plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Cowork, Cursor, VS Code or any MCP agent. No app or account needed. Pages are plain markdown, drawing, csv, clickable html files in your repo, and Claude opens them in your browser for editing.

title: Nimble: SOTA Decision Model | Product Hunt
og:title: Nimble: SOTA Decision Model | Product Hunt
og:description: Today, we are announcing Nimble-v4 and Nimble-v4-max which are pushing the frontier of decision models, outperforming Jev and other variants. On Decision Index public scores, our nimble-v4-max model and nimble-v4 models score +10.5 and +5.74 against Jev 1.13, making nimble-v4-max a top performing model. Beyond benchmarks, we have done a lot of internal evals, and see big improvements: 43% fewer mistakes than Jev, +50pp on model routing decisions, and so on. Try for free: console.bespokelabs.ai

title: NitroStack: Build, test, and deploy MCP servers in one place | Product Hunt
og:title: NitroStack: Build, test, and deploy MCP servers in one place | Product Hunt
og:description: NitroStack is the full-stack platform for building production-ready MCP servers and AI apps. Build with open-source TypeScript & Python SDKs, test and debug visually in NitroStack Studio, orchestrate agent workflows with NitroStack Workflow, deploy on NitroStack Cloud, and ship branded experiences with NitroStack Chat. Auth, testing, deployment and frontend stay in one workflow. Connect to ChatGPT, Claude and other AI clients. Powering 80,000+ MCP servers.

title: Notch Radio: Internet radio that lives in your MacBook's notch | Product Hunt
og:title: Notch Radio: Internet radio that lives in your MacBook's notch | Product Hunt
og:description: Notch Radio turns your MacBook's notch into a live radio. Hover it and it morphs into a full player with album art, real track titles and transport controls. Move away and it folds back into the hardware. Thousands of stations from the Radio Browser directory. Free for ever with five stations. One payment unlocks the rest: $9.99 at launch until 19 October, then $19.99. Nothing renews. No account, no analytics, no server. A notch is not required.

title: NotchMate: Makes your Notch more fun, interactive and useful. | Product Hunt
og:title: NotchMate: Makes your Notch more fun, interactive and useful. | Product Hunt

og:title: NotchMind: Put your MacBook notch to work: music, files, timers & more | Product Hunt

og:title: NotchPit: Your Mac's notch, rearranged into a control center | Product Hunt

Drag, resize and swipe them into your own layout. Try it free for 14 days, then buy once and keep it for life.

title: Notchware: Music and AI agent alerts in your MacBook notch | Product Hunt
og:title: Notchware: Music and AI agent alerts in your MacBook notch | Product Hunt

Notchware Pro ($3.99 one-time) adds Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor alerts, so you know the moment an agent needs approval or finishes, without watching the terminal. Native SwiftUI. No account, no analytics, no cloud. macOS 14.6+.

title: Notchzy: Interactive dynamic island for windows | Product Hunt
og:title: Notchzy: Interactive dynamic island for windows | Product Hunt
og:description: Notchzy is a dynamic island which is highly interactive and useful specifically for windows PC and unlike other alternatives in the market its a very lightweight app hardly using any extra power on your PC.

title: NoteHouse: Private lending, without the paperwork headache. | Product Hunt
og:title: NoteHouse: Private lending, without the paperwork headache. | Product Hunt

Create loan agreements, set repayment terms, track interest and payments, and see exactly what’s owed. Both borrowers and lenders stay on the same page, with all their documents and payment history in one place.

title: NoteWorthy: Notes supercharged with AI, all on-device | Product Hunt
og:title: NoteWorthy: Notes supercharged with AI, all on-device | Product Hunt
og:description: Yet another notes app with AI? Nah. This one is supercharged, and the AI never leaves your device. Jot anything down and NoteWorthy titles it and files it under Tasks, Ideas, Info, Personal or your own labels. One tap turns a messy brain-dump into clean headings and checklists. Long note? Summed up in a line. It all runs on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Works offline, no account, no subscription, and not a single note sent to a server. Free. ⚡️

title: Notif: AI for your Apple Reminders | Product Hunt
og:title: Notif: AI for your Apple Reminders | Product Hunt
og:description: Notif turns your Apple Reminders into actions. Write a note the way you normally would, and Notif adds two things: an Insight (a useful fact or tip for that note) and an Action Button for the next step, like opening a map, a store, a booking page, or the app you already use. Every note is a real Apple Reminder, so it syncs across your devices and works with Siri and widgets. Private notes are encrypted on your iPhone and open with Face ID. Free, no account needed. Pro unlocks unlimited Insights.

title: NotiKeep: Notification history for iPhone, on your device | Product Hunt
og:title: NotiKeep: Notification history for iPhone, on your device | Product Hunt
og:description: NotiKeep saves the notifications you get on iPhone using the new iOS 27 Shortcuts automation. See messages that were deleted or edited, search everything by app and conversation, and get alerts for words that matter. On-device, no account.

og:title: Notion: The all-in-one workspace | Product Hunt

og:title: Notion Auto: Notion’s rebuilt Agents run for hours and cost far less | Product Hunt

og:title: Notra: Notra is a GEO tool that helps you rank in AI Search. | Product Hunt

title: NOVA: AI coding that goes beyond suggestions | Product Hunt
og:title: NOVA: AI coding that goes beyond suggestions | Product Hunt

title: Nudgebox: Send push notifications without building an app | Product Hunt
og:title: Nudgebox: Send push notifications without building an app | Product Hunt
og:description: Put a QR code on your site, receipt or status page. People scan it with the free Nudgebox iPhone app and choose what to hear about. No account, email or phone number. Your backend reaches them with one HTTPS call. No SDK, no device tokens.

title: NuPlay: AI transformation, run on one self-improving platform | Product Hunt
og:title: NuPlay: AI transformation, run on one self-improving platform | Product Hunt
og:description: Most AI agents stay the same after go-live, while the business keeps changing around them. NuPlay runs enterprise workflows in production and improves them after every run. Deploy agents for retail, customer service, consumer goods etc., across voice, chat, email and messaging, connected to your systems. Two built-in layers keep them improving: NuPulse tracks every run in real time, and NuLoop reviews those runs, diagnoses failures, tests a fix against past runs and ships the improvements.

title: Nuvio: The AI-Powered Financial Superhero Your Startup Deserves | Product Hunt
og:title: Nuvio: The AI-Powered Financial Superhero Your Startup Deserves | Product Hunt
og:description: Nuvio automates financial management with AI-powered tools for startups. Track income, expenses, and cash flow effortlessly, get real-time insights, and predict trends. Save time, reduce errors, and make smarter decisions with automated financial tracking.

title: NVIDIA: The official handle for NVIDIA. | Product Hunt
og:title: NVIDIA: The official handle for NVIDIA. | Product Hunt
og:description: NVIDIA, inventor of the GPU, which creates interactive graphics on laptops, workstations, mobile devices, notebooks, PCs, and more. We created the world’s largest gaming platform and the world’s fastest supercomputer. We are the brains of self-driving cars, intelligent machines, and IoT.

title: Octri.dev: Generate customizable Docs, SDKs, MCP server, and monitoring | Product Hunt
og:title: Octri.dev: Generate customizable Docs, SDKs, MCP server, and monitoring | Product Hunt
og:description: Upload an OpenAPI spec and Octri generates a fully customizable documentation site, high-quality client SDKs in ten languages (TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Dart) and an MCP server so AI agents can call your API. The new part: every SDK reports its own production errors back, so you see integration failures before your users file tickets. GitHub sync regenerates everything on every merge.

title: Odyssey 3: A world model that simulates physics in real time | Product Hunt
og:title: Odyssey 3: A world model that simulates physics in real time | Product Hunt
og:description: Odyssey-3 is a foundation world model that generates interactive environments from a prompt and predicts in real time how they change as you or an agent act in them. Its Pro version posts the highest reported Physics-IQ Verified video-to-video score (66.1, best-of-8). The same model has been adapted to control robot arms and humanoids, drive a car, and train agents. Try the research preview, or get in touch for API access.x`

title: Off Grid AI: Private AI on your phone and computer. | Product Hunt
og:title: Off Grid AI: Private AI on your phone and computer.  | Product Hunt
og:description: Off Grid AI runs AI models on the phone and computer you already own. Chat, read documents, ask about photos, talk out loud and make images, with the Wi-Fi off and no account. On your computer it remembers your day: meetings transcribed with no bot in the call, answers that cite their source, and replies it drafts but only sends after your yes. Your phone can use your Mac's bigger models, device to device. Free and open source on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux.

title: Off the Record: Block AI from transcribing your meetings. | Product Hunt
og:title: Off the Record: Block AI from transcribing your meetings. | Product Hunt
og:description: Off the Record reshapes your voice in real time so people can understand you while AI notetakers and hidden interview copilots struggle to transcribe it.

title: offstage: Your computer-use agent gets a Mac account, not your screen | Product Hunt
og:title: offstage: Your computer-use agent gets a Mac account, not your screen | Product Hunt
og:description: offstage gives Claude Code, Codex and opencode a second, logged-in macOS account to work in. Simulators, Xcode UI tests and the app your agent just built open on that account's desktop, so your screen, keyboard and mouse stay yours. Free and open source: https://github.com/viraatdas/offstage

title: omerta: Catch .env secrets leaking into git | Product Hunt
og:title: omerta: Catch .env secrets leaking into git | Product Hunt
og:description: Catchenv secrets leaking into git: a pre-commit hook and CLI that fails when an API key or any value of your env files is staged, tracked or anywhere in the history. Your real values, not patterns.

title: Omnia: Become the brand AI recommends | Product Hunt
og:title: Omnia: Become the brand AI recommends | Product Hunt
og:description: Omnia is an AI visibility tool that shows how AI sees your brand and helps you take action. Discover real AI prompts, monitor brand presence, benchmark competitors, and create content that boosts visibility and citations in AI search.

title: OneDeploy: Open-source apps on your own server, with no per-seat fees | Product Hunt
og:title: OneDeploy: Open-source apps on your own server, with no per-seat fees | Product Hunt
og:description: Run open-source apps on a server that's only yours, without per-seat fees. Pick one of 105 apps and a region, see the exact price, and a few minutes later it runs on its own server with a web address, TLS certificate and nightly encrypted off-site backups. Add your own domain, update, resize or move region from the dashboard. You pay for the server by the hour, capped monthly. The price follows the server, not your headcount.

title: Onepin: AI voiceover with every name, price and date said right | Product Hunt
og:title: Onepin: AI voiceover with every name, price and date said right | Product Hunt
og:description: AI voices sound human now. But they still guess names from the spelling, and nobody has time to listen to every line. Onepin runs on the voices you already use (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Google, 30+ more), spells out prices and dates, checks names against a 4M-word pronunciation dictionary, scores every line, and fixes the wrong word without re-rendering the take. Built for teams shipping AI voiceover in several languages: product videos, dubbing, courses. Free to start, no credit card required.

title: Oogwai Beacon: Answer Engine Optimization Audit | Product Hunt
og:title: Oogwai Beacon: Answer Engine Optimization Audit | Product Hunt
og:description: Most AEO tools score your HTML and call it AI visibility. Beacon actually asks the engines. We put unbranded buyer questions about your category to ChatGPT and Gemini (Claude on the full audit), then show how often you're named, who gets named instead, and which sources the engines trust. Two separate answers: can AI crawlers read your site (instant, no sign-up), and do the engines recommend you? Every gap comes with the fix.

title: Open For sales : Your next sales campaign is one prompt away | Product Hunt
og:title: Open For sales : Your next sales campaign is one prompt away | Product Hunt
og:description: Open for Sales turns one prompt into a full sales campaign. Give Companion your products and a CSV of contacts. It checks every persona, scores fit, writes an editable sequence across calls, email and WhatsApp, then builds a live dashboard to track it. It's the outbound side of Open, the customer communications engine already running AI support across voice, chat, email and more. One engine now answers the customers you have and reaches the ones you want next.

title: Open Inspector: Hover any website, get its design system. No permissions. | Product Hunt
og:title: Open Inspector: Hover any website, get its design system. No permissions. | Product Hunt
og:description: A free, open-source browser extension for inspecting layout, styles, colour, type and assets on any page, and exporting its design tokens. Unlike the popular alternatives, it requests no site access and makes zero network requests. MIT, no account.

title: OpenAI: APIs and tools for building AI products | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenAI: APIs and tools for building AI products | Product Hunt
og:description:
The most powerful platform for building AI products.

Build and scale AI experiences powered by industry-leading models and tools.

title: OpenBot: Grok Bot alternative: free, local, open-source, multiplayer | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenBot: Grok Bot alternative: free, local, open-source, multiplayer | Product Hunt
og:description: OpenBot is an open-source workspace for AI teammates. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, OpenCode, or custom agents on Mac, Windows, and iOS. Give agents clear roles, let them delegate work, and invite your team to collaborate live with the same agents.

title: Openbroca: Lightweight AI dictation for Mac that sounds like you | Product Hunt
og:title: Openbroca: Lightweight AI dictation for Mac that sounds like you | Product Hunt
og:description: Openbroca is a native Swift AI dictation app for Mac, with a ~6.5 MB download. Press a shortcut, speak naturally, and get clean text right where you're typing. It removes fillers and repetition while keeping your meaning and tone, with no prompt tweaking. Includes a personal dictionary that learns from corrections, Typeless dictionary import, and translation into 28 languages. All features are free to try.

title: OpenCharm: Open-source body for the AI agent you already run | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenCharm: Open-source body for the AI agent you already run | Product Hunt
og:description: OpenCharm is an open-source body for the AI agent you already run, right by your Mac's notch. Hold one key to talk and Claude Code, Codex or any agent gets to work, answers out loud and asks when it needs you. Next, it hangs from your keychain.

title: opencode: Your terminal's AI agent, with any model you want | Product Hunt
og:title: opencode: Your terminal's AI agent, with any model you want | Product Hunt
og:description: opencode is an open-source AI coding agent built for the terminal. It features a native TUI, multi-session support, and is model-agnostic, letting you use Claude, OpenAI, Google, or even local models.

title: OpenCompanion: Start, watch and answer AI coding CLIs from one desktop app | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenCompanion: Start, watch and answer AI coding CLIs from one desktop app | Product Hunt
og:description: When you run Claude Code, Codex CLI or OpenCode in several folders at once, each session stops now and then to ask for permission, and you only find out when you look at its terminal. OpenCompanion starts those sessions, lists them on one screen, tells you when one is waiting, and lets you answer from the desktop or from your phone on the same Wi-Fi. No account, no cloud server, no telemetry. Open source (MIT), for Windows, Linux and macOS.

title: OpenCouncil: Voice rooms where your team and AIs debate together | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenCouncil: Voice rooms where your team and AIs debate together | Product Hunt
og:description: Put GPT, Gemini, Grok and your own agents in one live voice room with your team. They answer, push back on each other and never talk over you. A Scribe writes the decisions. Make the room public and anyone can listen, chat or take the stage. Works in your browser and Google Meet. Free to start: 2,000 credits, no card.

title: OpenFlowKit: Free, open-source diagrams you and your AI edit together | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenFlowKit: Free, open-source diagrams you and your AI edit together | Product Hunt
og:description: A free, open-source diagram canvas: MIT, local-first, no account, in your browser. One canvas, five ways in. Draw it. Write it as code, or paste Mermaid, D2 or Structurizr. Ask any of 10 AI providers, or a local model. Hand it to your coding agent: Claude Code edits the canvas you have open, live, over MCP. Or pull it from a GitHub repo, every arrow citing its file and line. The CLI checks drift in CI, so diagrams keep up with your code.

title: Opengeni: Ship AI agents within minutes. Infrastructure for Agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Opengeni: Ship AI agents within minutes. Infrastructure for Agents | Product Hunt
og:description: Everything your AI agents need in production, out of the box: sessions that survive errors, sandboxes, 100+ integrations, human approvals and insights into every step and dollar. Go live in hours. Self-host it free, or start on our cloud.

title: OpenLLM: Take your AI tokens anywhere | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenLLM: Take your AI tokens anywhere | Product Hunt
og:description: Take your tokens anywhere. Use your subscriptions, API keys and local models in Codex and any coding agent, or inside the ChatGPT app on your Mac. Hit a limit and it keeps going. Start a coding session on your home machine from anywhere.

title: OpenPilot: Open-source desktop AI agent for any model you choose | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenPilot: Open-source desktop AI agent for any model you choose | Product Hunt
og:description: OpenPilot is a free, MIT-licensed desktop AI agent. Connect any OpenAI-compatible model (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio), pick a folder, and it reads and edits files and runs commands there. You approve sensitive actions. Windows now, macOS early beta.

title: OpenRadView: Free, open-source viewer for your own CT, MRI and X-rays | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenRadView: Free, open-source viewer for your own CT, MRI and X-rays | Product Hunt
og:description: OpenRadView opens the DICOM and NIfTI files from your scan CD or zip on your own computer: linked axial, coronal and sagittal views, experimental 3D and measurements. Optional MCP access for your own AI agent. It is a personal research project for education and has not been clinically validated. Ask a qualified clinician to interpret your scans; do not use the app for decisions about care.

title: OpenScreen 2: Record your demo and let your AI agent do the edits | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenScreen 2: Record your demo and let your AI agent do the edits | Product Hunt
og:description: Record your screen and the demo looks great on the first take: zooms planned from your clicks, smooth cursor, 3D camera moves, cursor themes, backgrounds and webcam layouts. Then let your AI agent do the edit over MCP, or cut the video yourself by deleting words in the transcript. Windows, macOS and Linux. Free, MIT, no account, no watermark.

title: opensend.cc: The open source email platform that runs on your server | Product Hunt
og:title: opensend.cc: The open source email platform that runs on your server | Product Hunt
og:description: opensend.cc is an open source email platform that runs on your server. It sends through your own AWS account, so your domain, your data and your sender reputation stay yours. You get a REST API and SDK, SMTP, templates, broadcasts, automations, audiences, webhooks and logs. One command installs it. No per-email pricing, no feature gates. Already on Resend? Change two lines and keep your code.

title: OpenSEO: The open source Ahrefs alternative | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenSEO: The open source Ahrefs alternative | Product Hunt
og:description: Without good data, your agent gives generic advice. Keyword research, competitor research, backlinks and site audits, starting at $10/month instead of a $100-plus monthly subscription. Connect with MCP so that you can work with your agent to build an SEO strategy and write content tailored to your company.

title: OpenShip: Open source PaaS on your server or in the cloud. No lock in. | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenShip: Open source PaaS on your server or in the cloud. No lock in. | Product Hunt
og:description: OpenShip is an open source PaaS that runs on our cloud or your infrastructure. Push your code and OpenShip handles builds, deployments, domains, SSL, monitoring, backups, secrets, and the services your apps depend on. Start fully managed on OpenShip Cloud or self host on your own cloud or on prem. Move between them without changing how you deploy. No proprietary runtime. No vendor lock in. Remove OpenShip and your apps keep running. Deploy anything. Own everything.

title: openstatus: Status page with global uptime monitoring | Product Hunt
og:title: openstatus: Status page with global uptime monitoring | Product Hunt
og:description: Stop wasting time manual-coding status pages or overpaying for legacy tools. Openstatus  gives you beautiful, branded status pages and 28-region uptime monitoring out of the box. Be completely SOC 2-ready in under 2 minutes with automated, timestamped incident logs that auditors love. Open-source, developer-friendly (CLI, API, Terraform), and trusted by fast-shipping teams like Cal.com. Ship transparency, eliminate customer blind spots, and start for free.

title: OpenSwarm: A swarm of agents, in the same place you work | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenSwarm: A swarm of agents, in the same place you work | Product Hunt
og:description: Stop bolting AI onto your computer. OpenSwarm is an AI-first operating system where agents run the whole machine: apps create themselves, browsers control themselves, and swarms of agents work together. Your OS just became an infinite canvas, and your work just transformed from you doing one task at a time, to orchestrating dozens in parallel. Tell it what you want and a swarm of agents does the work with you at the helm.

title: OpenVids: Open-source video editor you run by chatting with AI agents | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenVids: Open-source video editor you run by chatting with AI agents | Product Hunt
og:description: Open-source, agent-first AI video editor for macOS and Windows. Describe the film — agents cut the timeline, add motion and sound, and review the render.

title: OpenWhispr: 100% local open source AI speech-to-text model | Product Hunt
og:title: OpenWhispr: 100% local open source AI speech-to-text model | Product Hunt
og:description: Turn your voice into formatted text. It's open source and runs 100% locally. 3-5x faster than typing, and especially helpful when prompting LLMs, writing emails and sending texts. Pick your preferred model, and even edit the system prompt. Take full control.

title: Opera: Opera isn't just a browser. It's an awesome browser. | Product Hunt
og:title:
Opera: Opera isn't just a browser. It's an awesome browser.

 | Product Hunt
og:description: Meet Opera One - the entirely redesigned Opera browser in early access.

title: Opposable: Computer use for phones to give your AI thumbs | Product Hunt
og:title: Opposable: Computer use for phones to give your AI thumbs | Product Hunt
og:description: Opposable lets Claude Code, Codex or any MCP agent see, tap and type on a real iPhone or Android phone, in every app you're signed into. Common tasks run on the phone with no model at all, payments wait for your tap, and iPhones work through Bluetooth or a tiny USB stick.

title: Orbit: Stop doomscrolling. Earn every app unlock. | Product Hunt
og:title: Orbit: Stop doomscrolling. Earn every app unlock. | Product Hunt
og:description: Doomscrolling is free. Orbit makes it cost something. Pick a schedule and your apps lock themselves. Want back in early? Earn it: hold the orb, do squats, ask a friend, pay a little more each time, or win a shift at The Gate. Most times, you’ll stay out.

title: Orbora: Create personalized guided audio: meditation, breath, ASMR | Product Hunt
og:title: Orbora: Create personalized guided audio: meditation, breath, ASMR | Product Hunt
og:description: Orbora generates audio talks tailored to you: guided meditations, breathwork, ASMR and short wisdom talks. Follow a guided path that walks you through what you need. Then shape the result: voice, length, tone, background sound and themes. AI writes and voices each talk from your choices. Save favorites, build your own library, and listen offline.

title: OrgComputers: Workspace for your AI Agents | Product Hunt
og:title: OrgComputers: Workspace for your AI Agents | Product Hunt
og:description: OrgComputers is a shared workspace for your AI agents. Projects, context and tools in one place, so Claude Code, Cursor and Codex start with what your team already knows.

title: OTPfill: Autofill OTP codes from your email on Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: OTPfill: Autofill OTP codes from your email on Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: OTPfill is a Mac menu-bar app. When a site emails you a verification code, it appears under the code field. Click Fill.

title: Otter Vault: Catch API keys the moment they appear, encrypted locally | Product Hunt
og:title: Otter Vault: Catch API keys the moment they appear, encrypted locally | Product Hunt
og:description: Otter Vault catches API keys the moment they appear and keeps them encrypted on your own device. Watch the demo and leave a reply, no account needed.

title: Our Silly Games: Skills to build games with Claude. Free multiplayer hosting. | Product Hunt
og:title: Our Silly Games: Skills to build games with Claude. Free multiplayer hosting. | Product Hunt
og:description: Our Silly Games is a free home for browser games made with Claude Code or Codex. Install the plugin, say "make me a game about...", and publish. We build it, review it and host it, with multiplayer, leaderboards, saves and phone controllers built in.

title: Overmind: Open-source platform for continuous learning | Product Hunt
og:title: Overmind: Open-source platform for continuous learning | Product Hunt
og:description: Overmind is the model training platform for AI teams. Turn your production traces into specialised models you own, trained, benchmarked, and served.

title: Ovren: Your AI engineering department that ships your backlog | Product Hunt
og:title: Ovren: Your AI engineering department that ships your backlog | Product Hunt
og:description: Every team has a backlog full of tasks that never make it into a sprint. Ovren puts AI frontend and backend engineers on it - they work inside your real codebase, execute scoped tasks, and deliver reviewable code updates. You stay in control. Nothing ships without your approval.

title: Own 1: Own your data. Own your AI. A mind of your own. | Product Hunt
og:title: Own 1: Own your data. Own your AI. A mind of your own. | Product Hunt
og:description: Own 1 is a fanless personal AI computer that runs two local LLMs and eight agents on your desk, from $3,899 with no subscriptions or per-token costs. What’s different: OwnXOS is AI-native, so every agent gets identity, budgets and an audit receipt, plus a wallet for x402 USDC payments. It bursts to OwnXCloud only when you allow it. Nexy, your private AI co-worker, ships on it and orchestrates hundreds of agents. Your data and memory stay local.

title: Ownfeed: A social feed of people who need your product | Product Hunt
og:title: Ownfeed: A social feed of people who need your product | Product Hunt
og:description: Paste your product's URL. Every day, Ownfeed reads Reddit, X, Bluesky and Hacker News and keeps only the posts from people who need what you built. No keywords, no alert inbox, no auto-replies. You scroll for five minutes and reply yourself.

title: Paddock: Computers and sandboxes for your agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Paddock: Computers and sandboxes for your agents | Product Hunt
og:description: Paddock gives each AI agent its own Linux computer or a locked-down sandbox, on one VPS you own. Free and open source, MIT licensed.

title: Palomino: Ultrafast workspace for agents to run in parallel | Product Hunt
og:title: Palomino: Ultrafast workspace for agents to run in parallel | Product Hunt
og:description: Palomino is a fast, GPU-rendered agent workspace. Run agents side by side with your terminals, editor, and browser in one window.

title: Panza: One safe place for life's important documents. | Product Hunt
og:title: Panza: One safe place for life's important documents. | Product Hunt
og:description: Passports. Insurance. VINs. Expiry dates. Panza turns scattered documents into useful cards, with the original files right behind them. Find important details in seconds, ask AI when you need help, and share what matters. Unlike traditional cloud storage, Panza keeps new cards on your iPhone by default. You decide what goes online. Built for life's important stuff, not just storing files.

title: Papermark: Secure, open source data room built for modern dealmakers | Product Hunt
og:title: Papermark: Secure, open source data room built for modern dealmakers | Product Hunt
og:description: Papermark is the secure data room built for modern dealmakers. Share confidential documents on a platform that gives you control, visibility, and trust. Build and manage your data room for buy-side deals or raising funds. Papermark's data room can be fully whitelabeled with custom domains, built-in analytics and advanced security controls. Papermark is open-source with hosted and self-hosted options.

title: ParakeetAI: Your real-time AI interview help. | Product Hunt
og:title: ParakeetAI: Your real-time AI interview help. | Product Hunt
og:description: Your real-time AI interview help. Boost Your Interview Performance with AI.

title: Parallax: Every coding agent you run, in one place. | Product Hunt
og:title: Parallax: Every coding agent you run, in one place. | Product Hunt
og:description: Parallax runs your coding agents for you. Claude Code, Codex and 40+ more in one app, with 240+ models on your own subscriptions. Captain handles the busywork, fast merge ships your PRs in one click, and when a subscription runs out, auto fallback enables your work to move to the next.

title: Parrot: Smart Meeting Assistant for Mac that helps during the call | Product Hunt
og:title: Parrot: Smart Meeting Assistant for Mac that helps during the call  | Product Hunt
og:description: Parrot is a free, open-source meeting recorder for Mac that helps during the call, not after it. No bot joins: it records what your Mac hears and transcribes on device. When a client asks something your pricing sheet or FAQ covers, the answer appears with the file it came from. After the call you get a report of promises made and questions missed, and you can chat with all your meetings. Use Claude, a free local model with Ollama, or your own server. No account, no subscription.

title: PasteKit: Format JSON, YAML & SQL privately | Product Hunt
og:title: PasteKit: Format JSON, YAML & SQL privately | Product Hunt
og:description: Paste JSON, YAML, XML, SQL, CSV or code and get formatted, validated output instantly. 58 formats, 48 converters and JSON tools (diff, schema, repair, jq). Everything runs in your browser, enforced by a strict CSP, so nothing you paste leaves your machine.

title: Pastily: Your clipboard but better | Product Hunt
og:title: Pastily: Your clipboard but better | Product Hunt
og:description: Fast, private clipboard manager for macOS, Windows and Linux. Searchable copy history, paste queue, images and snippets. 100% offline, pay once.

title: Patchcord: Studio sound for your mic in every Mac meeting with EQ | Product Hunt
og:title: Patchcord: Studio sound for your mic in every Mac meeting with EQ | Product Hunt
og:description: Patchcord is a macOS menu bar app that runs any Audio Unit plugin on your mic and hands the result to Zoom, Teams, Meet or Discord as a virtual mic. Use free plugins like RNNoise or pro tools like Antinode Clear. Every mic gets its own EQ with a live spectrum, switching mics mid-call just works, and Patchcord Camera keeps you in lip sync. Free to use, 7-day Pro trial, Pro is a one-time purchase. No account, no subscription.

title: Paw-Paw: A tiny desktop pet for your Mac that types along with you | Product Hunt
og:title: Paw-Paw: A tiny desktop pet for your Mac that types along with you | Product Hunt
og:description: A small illustrated animal sits in the corner of your Mac's screen, reacts as you type and click, and naps when you pause. Choose which season earns XP and unlock dozens of Paw-Paws and 100+ items as you level up. Free and native; one optional $2.99 add-on.

title: pawl: a tiny mac focus timer you start by pulling a paw | Product Hunt
og:title: pawl: a tiny mac focus timer you start by pulling a paw | Product Hunt
og:description: start a focus timer by pulling a cat paw, it lives in your mac menu bar or you can pin it like a mini timer! it has adjustable focus and break sessions, eight cat paws, themes, and a quiet heads-up before your timer ends. made for macos 14+. $9.99 once, with no subscription.

title: Pawse: A cute 3D pet that reminds you to drink water & take breaks | Product Hunt
og:title: Pawse: A cute 3D pet that reminds you to drink water & take breaks | Product Hunt
og:description: Pawse is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app. A cute 3D pet walks onto your screen to remind you to drink water, keep habits like stretching every 30 minutes, and take screen-time breaks, with an optional hard block.

title: Payload Peek: Catch Webhooks. Inspect Payloads. Generate TypeScript. | Product Hunt
og:title: Payload Peek: Catch Webhooks. Inspect Payloads. Generate TypeScript. | Product Hunt
og:description: A live webhook inbox for developers. Inspect HTTP requests, explore JSON payloads, and turn real events into TypeScript interfaces or Zod schemas. All in your browser, with no setup or account required.

title: PDF Accessibility Checker by WebYes: Find PDF accessibility issues for free, with fix guidance | Product Hunt
og:title: PDF Accessibility Checker by WebYes: Find PDF accessibility issues for free, with fix guidance | Product Hunt
og:description: Find issues that can make your PDFs difficult for people with disabilities to read or use, including missing image descriptions and problems with headings. See affected content highlighted on the page, review issues by severity, and get instructions on how to fix them. The checker also flags what needs human review. Upload PDFs up to 50 MB or paste a public link. Completely free, with no sign-up, no email required, and no files stored. Checks against WCAG 2.1 AA and PDF/UA.

title: Penta: A ’90s 5-disc CD changer on iPhone Duo | Product Hunt
og:title: Penta: A ’90s 5-disc CD changer on iPhone Duo  | Product Hunt
og:description: Penta turns your iPhone, iPad or iPhone Duo into a ’90s 5-disc CD changer for your Apple Music library. Every click, whir and tray motor is recorded from a real CD changer. On iPhone Duo the phone is the jewel case: close it and you’re holding the album, open it and the case opens with it, then drop the disc into the carousel. Hold it upright for a CD wallet over the tray that animates open and closed. Free, with an optional one-time Pro unlock for the real printed CD art.

title: Peras: Pause Claude Code and Codex before they burn your week | Product Hunt
og:title: Peras: Pause Claude Code and Codex before they burn your week | Product Hunt
og:description: Peras puts a line in your Claude Code and Codex week. Set it (peras set weekly 85 pause) and once usage crosses it, the agent's next tool call is refused with a plain reason, so one long task can't burn the rest of your week. Resume whenever you want, from the terminal or the menu bar. Opt-in: your agents can be told their own usage. The CLI and hooks are free and MIT. The native Mac menu bar app is €4.99 once.

title: Perplexity: Where Knowledge Begins | Product Hunt
og:title: Perplexity: Where Knowledge Begins | Product Hunt
og:description: Your Research Assistant. Available wherever you are: 🤖 http://pplx.ai/android // 📱 http://pplx.ai/iphone

title: Phare C1®: A smoke alarm that detects fire, not toast. | Product Hunt
og:title: Phare C1®: A smoke alarm that detects fire, not toast.  | Product Hunt
og:description: Phare C1 is a smoke alarm that sounds for actual emergencies and nothing else. Its multi-sensor array spots fire and CO early and accurately, reduces false alarms, and is backed by detection algorithms that learn and improve to make your home even safer over time. It keeps much-loved features from the Nest Protect (RIP) like early warnings, a night light, and in-app alerts, and adds new ones like air quality monitoring and intruder detection.

title: Pheebs: Measure how engineers and teams actually work with AI | Product Hunt
og:title: Pheebs: Measure how engineers and teams actually work with AI | Product Hunt
og:description: Measure how you and your team actually work with AI coding agents. Pheebs is an open-source AI telemetry tool created by Eversynced. It sits quietly inside Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via hooks, capturing lightweight interaction signals: the shape of the session, not its contents.

title: Phonable: Missed calls, handled: callers get a text, you get the gist | Product Hunt
og:title: Phonable: Missed calls, handled: callers get a text, you get the gist | Product Hunt
og:description: Phonable replaces your carrier voicemail on iPhone and fixes both sides of a missed call. Your caller gets a text after a missed call, so they know why you couldn't pick up, even if they hang up without leaving a voicemail. You get the gist: voicemails arrive transcribed with a short AI summary. Switch modes like Workday, Driving or Gym in one tap or on a schedule, greet callers in your own voice or a natural AI voice, and keep your own number.

title: Pickle Sensei: AI pickleball coach for solo training, one swing at a time | Product Hunt
og:title: Pickle Sensei: AI pickleball coach for solo training, one swing at a time | Product Hunt
og:description: Pickle Sensei is an AI pickleball coach for solo training on iPhone. Step into the start zone alone, swing one stroke, and get an estimated player rating, a technique score, checkpoint scores, and the one thing to fix next. Covers serves, returns, drives, dinks, third-shot drops, volleys and overheads. Slow-motion form review with a skeleton overlay, 40+ drills, progress tracking and ranks. Video stays on your device. Free to try, one rating included, then Pro from $7.99 a month.

title: Pilot5.ai: Your question, deliberated by 5 frontier AI models | Product Hunt
og:title: Pilot5.ai: Your question, deliberated by 5 frontier AI models | Product Hunt
og:description: Pilot5.ai gives legal work an adversarial second opinion. Five frontier AI models analyze the same matter independently, challenge each other anonymously, and converge on a recommendation — while preserving the strongest objection. Research runs against primary legal sources, claims are tagged as sourced or inferred, and case citations are checked for existence. Built for lawyers who want AI analysis they can inspect, challenge, and defend.

title: Pine Computer: A cloud computer built for AI to get jobs done | Product Hunt
og:title: Pine Computer: A cloud computer built for AI to get jobs done | Product Hunt
og:description: Pine Computer is a cloud computer built for AI to use. Your product hands it a job: research, forms, spreadsheets, portals with no API. The finished work comes back. AI reads each app's structure instead of pixels, is told when something changes, and gets as many virtual screens as it needs. Spin up a computer per customer through one SDK, bring your own model or use ours, and let a person take over for sign-ins or approvals. Invite-only beta.

title: Pixel Soup: Dithered live wallpapers your Mac cooks up itself | Product Hunt
og:title: Pixel Soup: Dithered live wallpapers your Mac cooks up itself | Product Hunt
og:description: Pixel Soup makes your Mac's wallpaper for you. Pick a shape, a palette and a dither style, and it draws it live on your GPU, then keeps it gently moving behind your icons or freezes it as a still. Drop in a photo and it dithers that too. Hit one button for a random new wallpaper, or let it serve a fresh one every hour. No account, no tracking, no subscription. One payment and it is yours.

title: PixLate: Translate documents. Preserve artwork and layout. | Product Hunt
og:title: PixLate: Translate documents. Preserve artwork and layout. | Product Hunt
og:description: PixLate translates PDFs, scans, and illustrated pages while preserving their artwork and layout. It combines AI translation with side-by-side review, correction tools, background processing, and PDF export. Projects stay on your device with pay-as-you-go credits.

title: PixRater: Cull and rate your photos faster | Product Hunt
og:title: PixRater: Cull and rate your photos faster | Product Hunt
og:description: PixRater is a fast, 100% local photo culling tool. It groups RAW+JPEG pairs, auto-evaluates face sharpness, and uses private AI for keywording. Ratings save to EXIF/XMP metadata, and an integrated local MCP server lets you connect custom AI tools.

title: Planet-X: A living globe to explore and remember loved ones | Product Hunt
og:title: Planet-X: A living globe to explore and remember loved ones | Product Hunt
og:description: Spin a free 3D globe, play a country’s live radio, or dig to the other side of Earth. Leave a light for a friend, family member, pet or idol you’ve lost. Exploring is free and needs no account.

title: Plango: Use AI to defend against AI | Product Hunt
og:title: Plango: Use AI to defend against AI | Product Hunt
og:description: Secure your Mac while building with AI. Plango monitors AI coding agents, protects sensitive files and secrets, blocks suspicious network activity, scans projects for vulnerabilities, and gives you control over what your agents can access. Powered by an on-device AI security model. Private by default.

title: Playad: Hire your AI Marketing Team | Product Hunt
og:title: Playad: Hire your AI Marketing Team | Product Hunt
og:description: Playad is your AI marketing team. Paid ads on autopilot: it learns your brand, makes the ads, and gets smarter every time. From one chat, research competitors, create image and video ads, launch campaigns, and analyze performance. Schedule recurring checks, creative refreshes, and reports. Playad remembers your brand, experiments, and results to inform what to try next. You stay in control through review and approval. Stop creating. Start deciding.

title: Plugins Radar: Search rankings and competitor alerts for ChatGPT plugins | Product Hunt
og:title: Plugins Radar: Search rankings and competitor alerts for ChatGPT plugins | Product Hunt
og:description: Plugins Radar tracks the ChatGPT plugin directory. Look up any of 5,000+ plugins to see where it ranks in 192 common searches, which plugins compete with it and which searches it misses. Add your plugin and the rivals you watch, and get an email when one passes you or edits its listing. Topic leaderboards are free. Sign up free and track a plugin to see its full report.

title: pmtui: Autopilot for long-running AI sessions in terminal | Product Hunt
og:title: pmtui: Autopilot for long-running AI sessions in terminal | Product Hunt
og:description: pmtui focuses on managing multiple agents and solving long-horizon tasks. Autopilot does what an agent loop does, except loops drift once the work runs long. So pmtui keeps the loop outside the agent and rebuilds the prompt each time from your goal and the agent's own last status. You choose how often to check back, and it only surfaces what really needs your attention

title: PocketWebTools: AI tools that run on your device, in the browser and on Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: PocketWebTools: AI tools that run on your device, in the browser and on Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: PocketWebTools makes AI tools that run on your own device. In the browser: free tools for voice cloning, text to speech, transcription, video clips, image upscaling and background removal, with no signup. On the Mac: PocketWebTools for Mac, one paid app that runs open models up to 35B parameters on Apple Silicon. Chat with Wi-Fi off, transcribe files and calls with speaker labels, and cut long videos into captioned clips. Your files stay on your device.

title: Poddle: Swing your phone, play pickleball on any computer! | Product Hunt
og:title: Poddle: Swing your phone, play pickleball on any computer! | Product Hunt
og:description: Poddle is Wii Sports-style pickleball for your browser, played only with the devices you already own. Open poddleball.com on any computer, scan the QR code, and your phone becomes the paddle. On a Mac, one AirPod can be the paddle instead; a small open-source helper app streams its motion sensors to the game, and the other AirPod stays in the case. Play a friend online, take on Matt the bot at four difficulty levels, or run a tournament, and earn trophies as you go. 100% fun and free to play!

title: Point and Yap: Point at your screen and start yapping to your agent via MCP | Product Hunt
og:title: Point and Yap: Point at your screen and start yapping to your agent via MCP | Product Hunt
og:description: A small Mac tool I built for myself. Press Control twice and yap away while pointing at things on your screen, and it all goes to your coding agent via MCP, including what you pointed at and what you said. Free, open source, local.

title: Poke Finder: Catch Pokémon while you browse and complete your Pokédex. | Product Hunt
og:title: Poke Finder: Catch Pokémon while you browse and complete your Pokédex. | Product Hunt
og:description: Catch Pokémon while browsing. Discover Generations 1-9, Shiny Pokémon, Mega Evolution and companions with Poke Finder.

title: Polylane: AI agents that fix production before you wake up | Product Hunt
og:title: Polylane: AI agents that fix production before you wake up | Product Hunt
og:description: Nobody should be on call. Polylane connects your code, infra and observability data, investigates every incident and opens a pull request with the fix. If code can't fix it, you get the root cause and a recommendation.

title: Pomerado: Turn any website into an API / MCP in minutes | Product Hunt
og:title: Pomerado: Turn any website into an API / MCP in minutes | Product Hunt
og:description: Pomerado turns any website into a MCP / API in minutes. Automate everything by turning previously inaccessible websites (like Google Flights, Zillow, Instacart, legacy portals) into native tools for your agents. Our open-source tool builds, hosts, authenticates, and maintains your integrations, so you can focus on building.

title: Popcraft: Generate video, images & audio from any AI agent | Product Hunt
og:title: Popcraft: Generate video, images & audio from any AI agent | Product Hunt
og:description: Paste one URL into Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Claude Code and your agent can plan, cost-preview and generate video, images, music and SFX with Seedance 2.5, Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Nano Banana Pro and 20+ more. OAuth sign-in, no API key. 100 free credits.

title: Porch: ocal project summaries and cost tracking for AI coding | Product Hunt
og:title: Porch: ocal project summaries and cost tracking for AI coding | Product Hunt
og:description: Porch turns your Claude Code and Codex work into daily, weekly, and monthly summaries by project, with estimated task time and blockers. See sessions across terminals and editors, know which need your attention, track tokens and API-equivalent costs, and save summaries as Markdown to Obsidian or any folder. Open source, with no Porch account required. Session status and usage stay on your Mac; summaries use your installed, signed-in Claude Code or Codex.

title: Portlivo: Every local dev server on your Mac, in the menu bar | Product Hunt
og:title: Portlivo: Every local dev server on your Mac, in the menu bar | Product Hunt
og:description: Portlivo shows every dev server and port running on your Mac: which project it's from, the command, uptime and whether it's answering. Open, restart, kill, tail logs or share any of them in one click. Native, no account, one-time price.

title: PostNitro: AI-designed carousels, images and video for every platform | Product Hunt
og:title: PostNitro: AI-designed carousels, images and video for every platform | Product Hunt
og:description:
Turn a topic, article, or thread into a branded carousel, image post, or short video — then schedule it to LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, Facebook, and Pinterest.

100+ templates, brand kits, and team workspaces.

Now built for AI agents: connect PostNitro to Claude or ChatGPT in one click, or use our MCP server, CLI, or API, and your agent designs and schedules posts for you. Used by 82,000+ creators.

title: Postquel: Free native Postgres app for Mac with your own AI agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Postquel: Free native Postgres app for Mac with your own AI agents | Product Hunt
og:description: A fast, native PostgreSQL client for macOS. Its AI assistant runs on the Claude Code, Codex or Cursor account you already pay for, sees your real schema, and can only read: any change it suggests waits for you to dry-run and apply. Free and open source.

title: Praex: The coding agent that runs on its own AI models | Product Hunt
og:title: Praex: The coding agent that runs on its own AI models | Product Hunt
og:description: Praex is an AI coding agent that runs on its own model family: Velox II (free, fast), Faber II (Pro, deep reasoning) and Lucia II (frontier, coming soon), post-trained from the best open models. It reads your repo, edits with your approval, runs your tests and explains every change. Use it in the terminal, the desktop app or the browser, and continue any session from your phone with /rc. The terminal agent is open source (MIT). Free to start, Pro $20/month.

title: Prefer: The execution layer for AEO | Product Hunt
og:title: Prefer: The execution layer for AEO | Product Hunt
og:description: AEO should not be another dashboard. Prefer works at the execution layer, helping brands understand how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity talk about them, identify where they are missing, and take action to improve their visibility. Turn AI search insights into action with autonomous agents. Less reporting. More doing.

title: PrivOS: Chat, Docs, Kanban Tasks and Al agents that act, self-hosted | Product Hunt
og:title: PrivOS: Chat, Docs, Kanban Tasks and Al agents that act, self-hosted | Product Hunt
og:description: PrivOS is the all-in-one AI-native operating system for enterprise work. Chat, Docs, Kanban Tasks (lists with table and Kanban views) and tailored MCP apps live in one place, and AI agents act on them: @-mention a list, file, folder or app in a room and the agent works on it from its own sandboxed container. Self-host the Community Edition free for up to 10 users (beta) or use our Cloud, hosted in the EU. Bring any Anthropic- or OpenAI-compatible model, including local ones.

title: ProcBoss: Run, deploy, monitor, and manage your apps across servers | Product Hunt
og:title: ProcBoss: Run, deploy, monitor, and manage your apps across servers | Product Hunt
og:description: ProcBoss is a lightweight production process and infrastructure management platform for running, deploying, and monitoring applications across servers. Run Node.js, Bun, Deno, & other runtimes with clustering, automatic restarts, health checks, dependencies, cron jobs, logs, metrics, and GitHub auto-deployments. ProcBoss Cloud adds centralized server monitoring, deployment management, alerts, and hosted status pages; giving developers one place to keep production applications running reliably.

title: Product Hunt: The place to discover your next favorite thing | Product Hunt
og:title: Product Hunt: The place to discover your next favorite thing | Product Hunt
og:description: Founded in 2013 as a tiny side project, Product Hunt has become the place for makers and companies to launch their latest app, gadget, or physical products to the world. It's a global community of friendly folks sharing and discussing the latest in tech.

title: Proofsource: AI search visibility, with agents that fix the gaps | Product Hunt
og:title: Proofsource: AI search visibility, with agents that fix the gaps  | Product Hunt
og:description: When a buyer asks ChatGPT for the best tool in your category, it names five or six companies and stops. Proofsource shows whether you're one of them. It asks your buyers' questions on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews every day, shows who gets named instead and why, maps the pages AI trusts, and drafts the fixes. You approve; our agents publish, verify the answers changed, and learn from every change. Start free: 25 questions, 4 engines, no card.

title: PulseDev: Click any UI bug on localhost. Your AI agent fixes it. | Product Hunt
og:title: PulseDev: Click any UI bug on localhost. Your AI agent fixes it. | Product Hunt
og:description: Stop describing UI bugs to your AI. Click any element on your localhost site, say what's wrong, and Claude Code, Codex, Gemini or OpenCode edits the right file. Watch it work live, then approve the diff on the page. Nothing is written until you do.

title: put·here: A place to collect notes to organize them later | Product Hunt
og:title: put·here: A place to collect notes to organize them later | Product Hunt
og:description: Most note apps want an answer the moment you save something: a title, a folder, a tag. Ideas show up before they have a shape. put·here is a canvas for the Mac where text, links, pictures and files land wherever you drop them — paste, drag, or press ⌃⌥P from any app. Step back and the whole canvas reads at a glance. Every canvas is a real folder of plain files on your Mac, so your notes stay yours. Free to start.

title: qarunbook: A test plan your team and your AI can work through | Product Hunt
og:title: qarunbook: A test plan your team and your AI can work through | Product Hunt
og:description: qarunbook helps you write a clear test plan, work through it yourself, with your team or with your AI over MCP, and keep track of what needs fixing or checking again. A fixed issue waits for a retest before it counts as passed. Free plan, no card.

title: Quello: One place to ask, across everything you already use. | Product Hunt
og:title: Quello: One place to ask, across everything you already use. | Product Hunt
og:description: Other tools search your files. Quello understands your work. One workspace for your tools, docs, and knowledge, with every answer backed by citations and a voice agent you can simply talk to. Built on MCP, it carries your full work context into Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, and Perplexity. The context layer every AI has been missing.

title: Querri: Question Anything | Product Hunt
og:title: Querri: Question Anything | Product Hunt
og:description: Querri brings your company's data together across 100+ platforms, giving every department a shared foundation for reliable, repeatable answers. Connect, clean, and combine your data, then teach Querri the definitions and context that matter to your business. Ask questions in plain English, build dashboards and presentations, automate recurring analysis, or work with your data directly from Claude and ChatGPT.

title: Quven: The self-hosted media server that puts native playback first | Product Hunt
og:title: Quven: The self-hosted media server that puts native playback first | Product Hunt
og:description: A self-hosted media server for films, series and documentaries, with music and ebooks on desktop and web. Native apps for desktop, iPhone, iPad, Android, Android TV and Fire TV. Free for personal use, with hardware transcoding and no ads.

title: Radaric: AI feed reader that learns your editorial taste | Product Hunt
og:title: Radaric: AI feed reader that learns your editorial taste | Product Hunt
og:description: Bring RSS, Telegram, X and YouTube into a feed that learns from what you approve, reject and explain. Repeating coverage of the same event goes into one story with original links. Built by a newsletter editor. From $9/mo.

title: RageLayer: Let visitors smash your website, then sweep it back | Product Hunt
og:title: RageLayer: Let visitors smash your website, then sweep it back | Product Hunt
og:description: RageLayer is an Easter egg for your own site. Visitors pick a hammer, fire, chainsaw, or black hole and wreck the real page: text and cards break into physical debris, effects interact (water puts out fire), and a broom sweeps everything back. 15 tools. Works with React, Vue, Svelte, or plain HTML. Free, MIT, TypeScript, zero runtime dependencies, plus an SDK for custom tools. Play with the live demo first.

title: Rambox: Workspace manager for multiple apps, accounts and contexts | Product Hunt
og:title: Rambox: Workspace manager for multiple apps, accounts and contexts | Product Hunt
og:description: Rambox is a workspace manager for people and teams who work with multiple apps, accounts and work contexts. Create dedicated workspaces for different clients, projects, roles and personal activities, keep sessions separated, switch between setups easily and resume your work without constantly rebuilding your environment.

title: Rank Kiwi: Find top-performing content on Instagram & YouTube | Product Hunt
og:title: Rank Kiwi: Find top-performing content on Instagram & YouTube | Product Hunt
og:description: Free Chrome extension for Instagram & YouTube content research. Compare creators, analyse Reels and Shorts, track engagement, and discover outlier content worth studying.

title: Ranktune: Track AI visibility, citations, and referral traffic | Product Hunt
og:title: Ranktune: Track AI visibility, citations, and referral traffic | Product Hunt
og:description: Track how your brand appears across AI search, see which AI platforms are sending traffic to your website, and uncover opportunities to improve your visibility. Ranktune combines AI visibility monitoring, citation tracking, referral traffic analytics, and content optimization in one platform.

title: Rate.fm: Letterboxd for music, on iPhone | Product Hunt
og:title: Rate.fm: Letterboxd for music, on iPhone | Product Hunt
