og:description: - Rate songs and albums out of 10. - Write reviews. - Keep a listening diary. - Follow friends to see their ratings. - Follow critics and publications. - Reviews are also available in the app. - Native iOS 26+ with Liquid Glass, Apple Music and Spotify integrations, synced lyrics on the player with Genius annotations, widgets, and a live activity to see what friends thought. - Free, badge subscription to support the app

title: Razorpay: Power your finance, grow your business | Product Hunt
og:title: Razorpay: Power your finance, grow your business | Product Hunt
og:description: Accept payments from customers. Automate payouts to vendors & employees. Never run out of working capital.

title: Reactive Resume: A free and open-source resume builder | Product Hunt
og:title: Reactive Resume: A free and open-source resume builder | Product Hunt
og:description: Reactive Resume is a free and open-source resume builder that simplifies the process of creating, updating, and sharing your resume.

title: readywhen: The senior personal assistant that works inside WhatsApp | Product Hunt
og:title: readywhen: The senior personal assistant that works inside WhatsApp | Product Hunt
og:description: readywhen is the senior Personal Assistant that works inside WhatsApp. It has its own phone number, its own computer, and a project board that keeps track of everything on your plate. Call it. Message it. Voice-note it. And it gets real work done.

title: ElevenLabs Realtime: Realtime voice agent models with 570ms to first audio | Product Hunt
og:title: ElevenLabs Realtime: Realtime voice agent models with 570ms to first audio | Product Hunt
og:description: Eleven Realtime is ElevenLabs’ new family of speech-to-speech models for voice agents. Speech recognition, turn-taking, the LLM and the voice are tuned end-to-end. v1 Mini is built for natural conversation, v1 Max for complex tasks, with 620ms and 570ms to first audio. It supports 90+ languages and works in ElevenAgents or through an OpenAI-compatible Realtime API, so you only change the endpoint and model name.

title: Reassign: Your day, shaped into a story. The planner for makers | Product Hunt
og:title: Reassign: Your day, shaped into a story. The planner for makers | Product Hunt
og:description: Let the shape of your day tell the story. Reassign is a 24-hour circular planner for busy makers. Midnight up top, noon at the bottom. Drag to block time. Reshape it when plans fall apart. It speaks AI. Brain-dump or brainstorm into the command palette and watch AI rebuild your afternoon, live. It mirrors everything. Google Calendar, Outlook, Todoist, Linear, all in two-way sync. Plus focus mode and an energy curve from your sleep. One dial. Every source. Full control.

title: reception: Native iOS support chat for less churn | Product Hunt
og:title: reception: Native iOS support chat for less churn | Product Hunt
og:description: The native in-app support chat your iOS app is missing. 💰 Make more money: send offers and paywalls in the chat ⭐ Get more App Store reviews from happy users 🔧 Fix problems in real time before users churn 🤖 AI answers from your docs, hands off to you when unsure 📥 One inbox for your whole team ⚡ One prompt setup: paste it into your coding agent, done Fully native. Works with Swift, React Native and Expo.

title: Redlamp: Native, open-source RAW Lightroom alternative editor for Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: Redlamp: Native, open-source RAW Lightroom alternative editor for Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: Redlamp is a native, open-source RAW photo editor for Apple Silicon, built from scratch in Swift and Metal. Lightroom's workflow, with no subscription and no cloud.

title: Refs: Give Claude better references for your launch film | Product Hunt
og:title: Refs: Give Claude better references for your launch film | Product Hunt
og:description: Refs is a library of 2400+ films that moved people, each measured cut by cut and written up as a 15-plate blueprint with a recipe prompt. Add it to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor with one command, and Claude plans your launch film from the real thing.

title: Regunow: Turn regulatory research into actionable compliance audits | Product Hunt
og:title: Regunow: Turn regulatory research into actionable compliance audits | Product Hunt
og:description: Regunow helps you understand what regulations mean for your business before you launch, expand, or make a change. Describe your product, service, or target market in plain language and explore requirements with AI answers grounded in authoritative sources. Compare your documents with relevant rules, investigate possible gaps, translate regulatory material, and turn your findings into structured reports. Bring research across markets into one workspace, with sources you can check as you go.

title: Reika: A coding agent CLI designed around small local models first | Product Hunt
og:title: Reika: A coding agent CLI designed around small local models first | Product Hunt
og:description: Reika is a coding agent CLI for local and hosted models, designed around local models first. It doesn't make a small model more intelligent but it provides a better experience using them day to day. Even if you're not part of the absolute range that Reika is designed for, using larger local models or hosted ones will still provide a solid experience out of the box.

title: Remocn Studio: Ship a launch video without opening After Effects | Product Hunt
og:title: Remocn Studio:  Ship a launch video without opening After Effects | Product Hunt
og:description: A free, open-source macOS app where your own Claude Code, Codex, Copilot or Grok builds your video as a real Remotion project. Watch it change live, click any element to tune it, give notes in chat, export MP4 up to 4K. No timeline. No lock-in

title: Request Eagle: Fast and open-source Postman alternative | Product Hunt
og:title: Request Eagle: Fast and open-source Postman alternative | Product Hunt
og:description: Request Eagle is an open-source API client written in Rust and drawn on the GPU, with no web view. It answers your first keystroke 0.36 s after launch, keeps requests as TOML files you can commit, runs Postman-style pm.* scripts and has a CLI for AI agents.

title: Resend: Email for developers | Product Hunt
og:title: Resend: Email for developers | Product Hunt
og:description: Build, test, and send transactional emails at scale. Resend provides the best developer experience helping you reach users instead of spam folders.

title: ReSO AI: Get discovered & recommended when customers ask AI | Product Hunt
og:title: ReSO AI: Get discovered & recommended when customers ask AI | Product Hunt
og:description: ReSO is a generative engine optimization platform that helps brands show up in AI search results. It’s built for founders, CMOs, and growth teams who want to turn buyer intent in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AIO into visibility, citations, and traffic. What makes it different is that it doesn’t just track rankings, it analyzes intent, competitors, content gaps, and technical issues, then turns them into priority actions to improve AI recommendations.

title: Revela: A film camera for iPhone that makes you wait for the lab | Product Hunt
og:title: Revela: A film camera for iPhone that makes you wait for the lab | Product Hunt
og:description: Revela is a film camera that lives in your phone. Pick a roll from a fridge of twelve original stocks, shoot it with no preview, then mail it to the lab and wait: an hour, overnight, or days. When the envelope arrives, pull the seal and see your photos for the first time. Prints develop from RAW with per-stock curves, grain and halation, and save to Photos at full resolution. Casual mode skips the wait. One price, no subscription, no account.

title: Review: Code review on your own machine, with your own AI | Product Hunt
og:title: Review: Code review on your own machine, with your own AI | Product Hunt
og:description: Free desktop app for reviewing Git branches and GitHub PRs. Comment on any line and keep comments private until you publish. Add AI reviewers with your own models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter or local via Ollama. Split the review across a team of models, see exactly which rules each one checked, and retry only what was missed. Open source (MIT), no account, for Mac, Windows and Linux.

title: Reviu: The review app for code your agent writes | Product Hunt
og:title: Reviu: The review app for code your agent writes | Product Hunt
og:description: Reviu is a native desktop app for reviewing agent-written code before you push. Run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and other ACP agents in durable sessions, inspect every diff, send comments back to the agent, then stage, rebase, commit, open PRs and review GitHub pull requests without leaving the app.

title: Revix AI: AI code review that learns your repo's own rules | Product Hunt
og:title: Revix AI: AI code review that learns your repo's own rules | Product Hunt
og:description: Revix AI scans your repo, generates its own pattern and architecture rules, and reviews every pull request against them. It keeps learning as the repo changes. Each comment names its rule and is labeled by intent and severity. Free for public repos.

title: Rhem Labs: Health assistant robots for your parents’ | Product Hunt
og:title: Rhem Labs: Health assistant robots for your parents’ | Product Hunt
og:description: Aging at home has a visibility problem. Small changes in health and routine can go unnoticed for weeks or months, until the first obvious sign is something serious. Rhem is a tabletop robot that helps families see those changes earlier, while giving parents the everyday support they need to stay independent longer. Rhem was designed first for aging parents, but anyone can use it as an extra set of eyes and everyday help at home.

title: rhun: A small, fast code editor written in assembly | Product Hunt
og:title: rhun: A small, fast code editor written in assembly | Product Hunt
og:description: A small code editor for Windows, Linux and macOS. Written in assembly, with a built-in terminal, Git diffs, fuzzy search, Vim mode and a panel for Claude Code and Codex sessions. Free and open source.

title: Rill Browser: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you | Product Hunt
og:title: Rill Browser: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you | Product Hunt
og:description: Rill is an AI-native browser built around the Claude Code and Codex you already use. Browse normally, then press ⌘E on any page to turn what you're looking at into a task for your agent. Rill finds the right project, passes along the context, and the agent works while you keep browsing. It also sorts your tabs into themes, turns your history into days you can search, and brings every project your agents are working on into one place. Free, on the plan you already have.

title: Rival Workshop: A bookshelf app to manage every skill your agents read | Product Hunt
og:title: Rival Workshop: A bookshelf app to manage every skill your agents read | Product Hunt
og:description: The Workshop app shows every skill in your repo as a book on a shelf: the spine is what Claude Code, Codex or Cursor reads before every task, and a bookend marks where each one stops. Switch skills off, make them run only when asked, rewrite them with Claude Code, and add good ones from the web after a safety check. One node command, and it runs on your computer. Includes 150 editable skills and Brief. One payment: $79 until Oct 31, 2026 (11:59 pm Pacific), then $149.

title: River Writer: A quiet Mac app for screenplays, stage plays and novels | Product Hunt
og:title: River Writer: A quiet Mac app for screenplays, stage plays and novels | Product Hunt
og:description: River Writer is a free Mac app for screenplays, stage plays and novels. You write plain text (.fountain ormd) and a live preview shows the formatted, print-ready pages beside it: Screenplay, Multi-cam, Stage Play or Manuscript. Git versioning is built in, so you can commit drafts, restore files and try an alternate ending on a branch. Outline, scratchpad and todos live as plain files in your project. No accounts, cloud, telemetry or AI; it makes no network connections. Open source (MIT).

title: RoleFit: Tailor every job application without starting from scratch | Product Hunt
og:title: RoleFit: Tailor every job application without starting from scratch | Product Hunt
og:description: Hiring is slow, competition is tough, and tailoring every application takes time. RoleFit helps job seekers do more with less effort. Powered by Gemini AI, it analyzes job descriptions, identifies strengths and skill gaps, and creates personalized, ATS-friendly resumes, cover letters, and LinkedIn outreach messages. Refine documents with an AI copilot, export PDF/DOCX files, and track applications in one place. Built on Google Cloud Run.

title: Rool: Your private AI machine. Files, ideas, AI in one workspace. | Product Hunt
og:title: Rool: Your private AI machine. Files, ideas, AI in one workspace. | Product Hunt
og:description: Rool is your private AI workspace. Bring your files, ideas and AI together in one place, on your own machine in the cloud. Unlike mainstream AI, Rool never sells your data, shows no ads and never uses your content to train AI. Your data is stored in Finland, under EU law. It's AI that runs on your terms, with full control and privacy. Built for privacy-conscious individuals, teams and creators. Try Rool free and own your AI.

title: Rovalty: Pay TikTok and reels creators per view, not upfront post. | Product Hunt
og:title: Rovalty: Pay TikTok and reels creators per view, not upfront post. | Product Hunt
og:description: Stop gambling on expensive flat-rate UGC where creators get paid upfront and videos get low views. Rovalty lets Shopify brands pay creators per thousand verified views instead. Set your custom CPM rate and strict budget caps so a viral video never drains your spend. Creators submit clips through a branded portal on your store, and the app automatically tracks reach on TikTok and Instagram Reels while generating weekly payout statements. Launch your performance campaign today.

title: Retriever AI: Free AI browser agent: find leads, reach out, apply to jobs | Product Hunt
og:title: Retriever AI: Free AI browser agent: find leads, reach out, apply to jobs | Product Hunt
og:description:
Ask Retriever to find leads and send outreach, shortlist TikTok and Instagram creators, apply to jobs or even help with homework. It reads pages, clicks, fills forms, and extracts data across websites. 

Use it free (inference included) in Chrome or the cloud, entirely ads supported, no API key or subscription needed! Get a paid plan for scheduled automations and heavy usage.

title: Rune: Write it down on one Mac, find it on the other | Product Hunt
og:title: Rune: Write it down on one Mac, find it on the other | Product Hunt
og:description: Rune is a small, fast text editor for the Mac. One scratch file in iCloud Drive is shared by all your Macs: saved as you type, and edits from two Macs are merged, never overwritten. Plain-text paste, Sublime Text's colors and keys, and Find in History.

title: RunInfra: Fast open models for your coding agent | Product Hunt
og:title: RunInfra: Fast open models for your coding agent | Product Hunt
og:description: Plug Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cline, Droid or Grok Build into fast open models like GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Qwen3.8 27B. Plans from $10 a month, up to 99.5% cache hits so your plan goes further, and zero data retention.

title: ruOS: A cloud desktop where AI agents do the work for you | Product Hunt
og:title: ruOS: A cloud desktop where AI agents do the work for you | Product Hunt
og:description: ruOS is a private cloud desktop with an AI team built in. Ask for research, writing or code and the agents (Claude Code, Codex, ruflo swarms) do it while you watch or step away. Opens in any browser on Mac, iPad or Chromebook, nothing to install. Files and AI memory persist across devices. Power users get a real Linux box plus an MCP server, so ChatGPT or Claude can drive it. Try ruOS Lite free in seconds, no sign-up.

title: SalesRep.com: Your AI sales rep: live prices, quotes & follow-ups 24/7 | Product Hunt
og:title: SalesRep.com: Your AI sales rep: live prices, quotes & follow-ups 24/7 | Product Hunt
og:description: SalesRep is a virtual sales rep that sells for you 24/7. Pulls live prices & stock from Shopify, WooCommerce, PrestaShop, Meta Catalog or your own database/API • Answers on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, email, SMS and more • Sends product cards and quotes on the fly, in any channel • Follows up until the deal closes, with human takeover anytime • 30+ languages, auto-detected Full-featured from $39/mo. 21-day free trial, no credit card required.

title: Salience: See every request to your website and how it responds. | Product Hunt
og:title: Salience: See every request to your website and how it responds. | Product Hunt
og:description: Salience turns the server and CDN data you already generate into a live view of every request, response and issue, from people, search engines and AI bots.

title: Sayonic: A voice assistant in your Mac's notch that does the task | Product Hunt
og:title: Sayonic: A voice assistant in your Mac's notch that does the task | Product Hunt
og:description: Sayonic lives in your Mac's notch. Say what you want and it opens apps and tabs, finds files, adds notes and events, or hands the job to a coding agent you already use. From $3.99 a month per Mac with your own keys, or Pro and Max with Cloud credits included.

title: Scalebrowser: Human browser capabilities. Now for AI agents. | Product Hunt
og:title: Scalebrowser: Human browser capabilities. Now for AI agents. | Product Hunt
og:description: Scalebrowser is self-hosted browser infrastructure for AI agents. It gives each agent a persistent, isolated identity, keeps logins and passkeys intact, handles captchas and verification, and runs on hardware you control.

title: Scape: Build tools to automate your work & give them to your agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Scape: Build tools to automate your work & give them to your agents | Product Hunt
og:description: A macOS app that helps you build tools that can automate parts of your job. Give them to your agents to work like you. Build super-powered orchestrator agents to scale your output. Automate adversarial reviews between Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode.

title: SCMD : Manage what Claude Remembers and Keeps as Memory. | Product Hunt
og:title: SCMD : Manage what Claude Remembers and Keeps as Memory. | Product Hunt
og:description: Claude only! SCMD is an open-source, local review deck for the persistent memories Claude Code saves about you and your projects. Keep, delete, skip, undo, rewrite, and inspect why a memory was saved. Decisions stay staged until you confirm; deletes go to restorable trash. No telemetry, no cloud service, and zero npm dependencies. Run it with /scmd:run or npx. MIT-licensed and ready for contributors.

title: Screenwell.ai: An AI interviewer that runs your first-round screening | Product Hunt
og:title: Screenwell.ai: An AI interviewer that runs your first-round screening | Product Hunt
og:description: Screenwell screens every applicant for you: Luna holds a short screening call through a link in your job ad, on Google Meet or Teams, and hands you a ranked shortlist with scores and quotes. 14 days free, no card needed.

title: Scumble: The open-source editor for AI inpainting | Product Hunt
og:title: Scumble: The open-source editor for AI inpainting | Product Hunt
og:description: Scumble is a free, open-source desktop editor for AI inpainting. Select part of a picture, say what belongs there, and the result lands as its own colour-matched layer. Runs on your own ComfyUI or your own API keys: FLUX 3, GPT Image, Nano Banana and more.

title: Searchtok: Make TikTok and Instagram searchable for your AI agent | Product Hunt
og:title: Searchtok: Make TikTok and Instagram searchable for your AI agent | Product Hunt
og:description: SearchTok makes TikTok and Instagram searchable for your AI agent. Connect it to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Claude Code with one URL and ask what's working in your niche. It finds the outlier posts (ranked by how far they beat their account's usual views), quotes their hooks word for word, and shows the creators behind them. Built for founders, marketers, creators and small agencies.

title: Sellio: AI customer support in one shared inbox powered by AI agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Sellio: AI customer support in one shared inbox powered by AI agents | Product Hunt
og:description: AI customer support in one shared inbox: live chat, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, and email. AI agents trained on your docs, plus tickets and analytics.

title: Semitexa: The PHP framework your AI agent can actually inspect | Product Hunt
og:title: Semitexa: The PHP framework your AI agent can actually inspect | Product Hunt
og:description: Semitexa is an open-source PHP 8.4 framework for long-running Swoole servers and AI-assisted development. A project graph lets you (or your AI agent) query routes, dependencies and blast radius before editing. Pages render on the server and arrive in stages, with deferred blocks and live SSE updates and no second frontend. ORM, tenancy and queues are built in, and traces plus targeted tests verify every change. Explore 81 live demo routes, with the source next to each one.

title: Semwright: Give AI agents structured access to real software | Product Hunt
og:title: Semwright: Give AI agents structured access to real software | Product Hunt
og:description: Semwright is an open-source Rust runtime for AI agents working with desktop and professional software. Through structured drivers, agents can interact with application objects and project data, while a shared runtime handles permissions, execution, dependencies, artifact handoffs, and verification. It supports MCP without being limited to a single protocol, model, or agent. Build workflows across applications without rebuilding the same integration infrastructure for each one.

title: Sente: Talk to your coding agent | Product Hunt
og:title: Sente: Talk to your coding agent | Product Hunt
og:description: A coding agent you can talk to — in your terminal or on your phone. 1. Voice, both ways. Read one sentence (~10 sec) to enroll your voice. Consent-first; the delete key is yours. 2. 404 models on one account — Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and more. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible. 3. MIT open source: github.com/yukihamada/sente Japan-built: Tokyo region, JPY billing. Honest limits: metered, not unlimited. Monthly credits; top up if you go over. We never clone a voice that isn't yours.

title: Servor: One console to run and monitor all your servers | Product Hunt
og:title: Servor: One console to run and monitor all your servers | Product Hunt
og:description: One console for every server you run: web terminal, file editor, scheduled jobs, fleet-wide commands, 150+ install recipes, plus monitoring, phone alerts and status pages. No open port, and every command is signed in your browser.

title: ShareCube: Share what your agents make, get feedback on the exact line | Product Hunt
og:title: ShareCube: Share what your agents make, get feedback on the exact line | Product Hunt
og:description: ShareCube gives your AI agents a place to publish. From Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client, your agent posts an HTML or Markdown artifact to a project and hands you a link, not a wall of chat. Your team comments on the exact sentence, @mentions each other and resolves threads. The agent reads that feedback and ships the next version. Every save is versioned. Share privately, with your org, or publicly: anyone with the link can read it, no account needed.

title: Shedi: Get back the space Xcode, Docker and node_modules ate | Product Hunt
og:title: Shedi: Get back the space Xcode, Docker and node_modules ate | Product Hunt
og:description: The honest Mac cleaner. Shedi finds what Xcode, Docker, node_modules and 20+ package managers left on your Mac, says what each item is and whether it comes back, and cleans only what you pick. Everything goes to the Trash first. Pay once.

title: shim-cli: See what your coding agent sends. Mask what you can. | Product Hunt
og:title: shim-cli: See what your coding agent sends. Mask what you can. | Product Hunt
og:description: An open-source hook and local proxy for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and VS Code. In Claude Code it masks secrets and personal data in tool results before the model reads them, and shim watch shows what a session sent and cost. No account, no telemetry.

title: ShipHQ: Build your own app studio, powered by your real apps | Product Hunt
og:title: ShipHQ: Build your own app studio, powered by your real apps | Product Hunt
og:description: ShipHQ turns your app's real numbers into a living isometric startup office. Connect RevenueCat and every paying subscriber becomes a person at your desks. Each morning the Daily Brief replays last night: new subscribers walk in to applause, trials arrive in caps, churn gets a send-off. Milestones land as trophies on your wall — earned, never bought, never retroactive. AI managers bring a 09:00 standup on growth, reviews and competitors. Free on iPhone.

title: shippedit.me: Launch Platform with SEO, AEO & Growth Insights | Product Hunt
og:title: shippedit.me: Launch Platform with SEO, AEO & Growth Insights | Product Hunt
og:description: Weekly launch battles + a permanent page that keeps working: dofollow backlink, AEO & CRO audits, competitor monitoring, real analytics, and AI fix cards.

title: ShogunAI: Your personal AGI on your PC. Built to finish real work. | Product Hunt
og:title: ShogunAI: Your personal AGI on your PC. Built to finish real work. | Product Hunt
og:description: Personal AGI won't arrive as a better chatbot, rather it arrives as an agent that knows the full state of your work -very person, your every project, every promise - and acts on it That is ShogunAI: general across your work rather than narrow to one task, and living inside your PC rather than someone else's cloud it builds that state as you work, keeps the evidence behind every record, and spends it finishing real work. Reading is automatic. Sending always waits for your approval, macOS today.

title: Side: A little AI chat panel that lives beside your Mac's Dock | Product Hunt
og:title: Side: A little AI chat panel that lives beside your Mac's Dock | Product Hunt

title: sideOS.ai: Local AI for dictation, meetings, background tasks and more | Product Hunt
og:title: sideOS.ai: Local AI for dictation, meetings, background tasks and more | Product Hunt

title: SignWith: E-signatures without the subscription. Pay per doc. | Product Hunt
og:title: SignWith: E-signatures without the subscription. Pay per doc. | Product Hunt

title: Simo: The judgment layer for software that acts | Product Hunt
og:title: Simo: The judgment layer for software that acts | Product Hunt
og:description: Simo is the System 1.5 judgment model from Temprl Labs. Ask typed questions about text, screenshots, or video and get calibrated probabilities and the values needed to act, in milliseconds.

title: Simple Workout Log: The best minimalist workout tracker available | Product Hunt
og:title: Simple Workout Log: The best minimalist workout tracker available | Product Hunt
og:description: A clear record of your training, with room for what matters. Simple Workout Log is a minimalist workout journal designed to help you note what you did and find your starting point next time. Set up your account and training preferences on the web. Log strength and cardio workouts on mobile, follow your routines, and keep your training history in one place.

title: SimpleSpread: Native, open source Mac spreadsheet | Product Hunt
og:title: SimpleSpread: Native, open source Mac spreadsheet | Product Hunt
og:description: Ever double click a CSV or XLSX file on your mac and have to wait 30 seconds while Numbers loads? And when it loads it's filled with a ton of crap you don't need? Then I wrote this for you (well mostly me, but you might find it cool too). A small, fast spreadsheet for the Mac, written entirely in Swift. Free and MIT open source with XLSX as the native file format. 156 functions, incremental recalc, Excel-style keyboard editing.

title: SineFrame M3: Test MCP servers and the agents that call them in pytest | Product Hunt
og:title: SineFrame M3: Test MCP servers and the agents that call them in pytest | Product Hunt
og:description: Your MCP unit tests pass, but did the agent call the tool? M3 runs your server through real Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Pi and asserts on the calls they actually made, in plain pytest. Direct tests need no API key. m3 ui shows every trace and tool call; m3 ci test --upload gates PRs and keeps runs on app.m3.sineframe.com. Open source, Apache-2.0.

title: Singularity: Run AI coding agents in parallel, one ticket at a time | Product Hunt
og:title: Singularity: Run AI coding agents in parallel, one ticket at a time | Product Hunt
og:description: Chatting with AI coding agents burns context and time. Singularity replaces the chat with atomic tickets: one scope, one isolated Git worktree, minimal context. Run agents in parallel across repos, review the diff, merge. Free, local-first, bring your own key.

title: Siteprint: Measure any website's design, then hand it to your AI | Product Hunt
og:title: Siteprint: Measure any website's design, then hand it to your AI | Product Hunt
og:description: Siteprint is a Safari extension for Mac that measures the design of any page: colours with their roles, type scale, spacing, corners and layout. Extract it as one exact prompt for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Runs on your Mac. $9.99 once.

title: Skisso: Edit your live UI in your design system, hand off the diff | Product Hunt
og:title: Skisso: Edit your live UI in your design system, hand off the diff | Product Hunt
og:description: Skisso is a free Chrome extension for designers and developers who build with AI coding agents. Point at any element on your live product and edit it in your own design system: your tokens, your components, a shadcn/ui kit that matches your styles. Then hand your agent only the exact change, as a small diff or over MCP. No more describing pixels in prose or pasting the whole page: about 380 tokens instead of 25,700 in our test. Runs locally, no account.

title: Skreno: Record, edit and share videos, all in your browser | Product Hunt
og:title: Skreno: Record, edit and share videos, all in your browser | Product Hunt
og:description: Skreno is a video studio in your browser: record, edit and share in one place. Record your screen and camera as separate tracks, then edit in Studio: pick a layout, cut silences, and add animated captions and titles. Share one link with a transcript, AI summary and comments on the exact second. Send a request link and anyone can record for you, no account needed. Bug reports come with the console log attached.

title: Skymir: Google Drive sync for Linux | Product Hunt
og:title: Skymir: Google Drive sync for Linux | Product Hunt
og:description: Skymir mirrors your Google Drive folders to Linux with two-way sync, double-click Google Docs shortcuts, and a native GTK tray. Local saves upload within seconds; changes made in Drive arrive within about a minute. Deletes go to the trash on both sides, and a sync that would delete more than half your files is refused. $19 one-time, 14-day free trial, no subscription.

title: slash-editor: Notion-style block editor for React. MIT, UI you own | Product Hunt
og:title: slash-editor: Notion-style block editor for React. MIT, UI you own | Product Hunt

Tables, columns, Mermaid, AI via your own model, markdown import/export. MIT end to end, no paid tier, nothing hosted.

title: Smooth Recorder: Mac screen recordings that look edited when you hit stop | Product Hunt
og:title: Smooth Recorder:   Mac screen recordings that look edited when you hit stop | Product Hunt

og:title: Snapset: Save and restore your entire Mac workspace in an instant | Product Hunt

og:title: snyvi: All your passion projects, in one calm place | Product Hunt

Every plan or review an agent writes lands on that desk as a clean page, versioned. Home shows where each project was left. Local only, no account, MIT. Mac tester needed: the Mac build is signed and notarized, but we don't own a Mac. Try it and tell us.

og:title: Sorcerer: Simulate an AI agent community reacting to "what if" | Product Hunt

title: Sorcrr: Ai enabled bounty driven referral platform for hiring & gtm | Product Hunt
og:title: Sorcrr: Ai enabled bounty driven referral platform for hiring & gtm | Product Hunt
og:description: You hit pmf, pick up funding - now scaling fast... bottleneck - hiring. So you hire hr, and they tell you "its going to take 3 months!!!" This is where Sorcrr comes in. Sorcrr lets you create a video job description. Put a bounty on it. Share on your socials and have referrals come in. Need more speed up the bounty. Add your team, then vote, review, leverage ai assisted interviews, setup trials, send hiring offers, and you're done. One mobile first app with everything built in.

title: Sorted: Your private AI file organizer for Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: Sorted: Your private AI file organizer for Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: Sorted turns a messy Mac file system into a private, searchable library. Drop files or watch folders and it reads PDFs and images with OCR, detects duplicates, applies local AI tags, follows your custom rules, and routes high-confidence matches automatically. Search by meaning, chat with documents using cited answers, review uncertain changes, undo anything, and export a clean Tax Pack for your accountant. Everything runs on your Mac. One-time $9.99 purchase.

title: Spacesheep: Documents of the future, made by AI, read by your team | Product Hunt
og:title: Spacesheep: Documents of the future, made by AI, read by your team | Product Hunt
og:description: Spacesheep (YC F26) turns any agent's work into a space: an interactive doc, live dashboard, mockup or app. Share it with specific people, your team or publicly, and collaborate on it together.

og:title: Sparrow: Self-hosted webhook delivery. One binary, just Postgres. | Product Hunt

title: Specreel: Product demos that update themselves | Product Hunt
og:title: Specreel: Product demos that update themselves | Product Hunt

og:title: Specsight: Product observability for teams shipping fast with AI | Product Hunt
og:description: Shipping fast with AI? Specsight turns code changes into a living product map, feature knowledge, and clear release updates. Keep Product, Sales, and Support in sync with what your software actually does and what changed.

title: SpeechFast: Local Whisper for Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: SpeechFast: Local Whisper for Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: Hold fn and talk. SpeechFast types clean text at your cursor, in any app. Everything runs on your Mac. The speech model is downloaded once; after that, no audio and no text ever leaves your machine. It works offline, on a plane, behind a locked-down corporate network. Dictate in Mail, Slack, Notion, your code editor, anywhere you can type Filler words and false starts cleaned up with Apple Intelligence Your own vocabulary for names and jargon History of your recent dictations, stored locally

og:title: SpeechShield: Live interview & meeting copilot for Mac, from your resume | Product Hunt
og:description: SpeechShield listens to Zoom, Meet or Teams on your Mac and transcribes each question as it's asked. og:title: Spinachi AI: Your family's personal health manager on WhatsApp | Product Hunt

og:title: Spira AI: The #1 agent that runs your entire social | Product Hunt

og:title: Spiralens: Golden ratio camera that tells you where to move your phone | Product Hunt

Works offline; photos never leave your phone.

og:title: Sponkly: Live voice translation for chats, calls, meetings & YouTube | Product Hunt

Free to start on the web, Android and Chrome; iPhone coming soon.

og:title: Spotify: Stream music and podcasts | Product Hunt

og:title: Stage: Review, fix and sign off working prototypes and products | Product Hunt
og:description: Publish a working prototype from Figma, Claude, Cursor or GitHub. Designers, PMs and engineers pin comments on the exact spot. Stage gets Claude to fix them in v2. Design, then product, sign off, and Stage files the Linear or Jira ticket. Reviewers are free

title: Standfast: Know if your Mac's GitHub Actions runners will get work | Product Hunt
og:title: Standfast: Know if your Mac's GitHub Actions runners will get work | Product Hunt
og:description: A free macOS menu bar app for self-hosted GitHub Actions runners. It asks launchd whether each runner is alive and GitHub whether it still counts on it, and never mixes up the two answers.

title: Stardrift for iOS: The AI travel assistant in your pocket | Product Hunt
og:title: Stardrift for iOS: The AI travel assistant in your pocket | Product Hunt
og:description: Stardrift helps you plan your dream trip, day-by-day. There's so much stress involved in planning a trip: where should you go? How do you make the most of limited time, and avoid missing out on activities? Stardrift helps you build up a wishlist of places to go. Using what it knows about you, it helps you create a day-by-day plan and surface nearby recommendations you otherwise would have missed. And when you're on the go, it acts as your assistant, answering questions and sending alerts.

title: Starkomand: Run your AI coding agents on an infinite canvas. | Product Hunt
og:title: Starkomand: Run your AI coding agents on an infinite canvas. | Product Hunt
og:description: Starkomand lets you run several AI coding agents at once on an infinite canvas. Use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any CLI agent with the plans you already pay for. - Auto picks the best model for each task - Pass work from one agent to another in one click - Talk to any agent with your voice - Quick recaps of what each agent did and what it needs from you - Diagrams and browser previews right beside each agent - Close your laptop and they keep working And more. No account, no subscription.

title: statusbar: a statusbar for any terminal | Product Hunt
og:title: statusbar: a statusbar for any terminal | Product Hunt
og:description: A status bar for any terminal.

title: StayCharted: Train AI on your own categories | Product Hunt
og:title: StayCharted: Train AI on your own categories | Product Hunt
og:description: Upload rows or photos your team has already sorted. StayCharted learns your categories and fills in the rest: support tickets, expense lines, survey answers, product photos. No prompts, no code. Answers it is unsure of come back to you to review. Start free.

title: StayLokal: Private file tools that run on your device. | Product Hunt
og:title: StayLokal: Private file tools that run on your device. | Product Hunt
og:description: StayLokal is a local-first file utility desk for PDFs, images, video, audio, and more.

title: Stella: Your emotional wellness AI. A friend to figure it out with. | Product Hunt
og:title: Stella: Your emotional wellness AI. A friend to figure it out with. | Product Hunt
og:description: Stella is your emotional wellness AI: a friend to figure it out with. Tell Stella what happened. Even the part you're still figuring out. Speak or text about what stayed with you. Explore another perspective, find words for a conversation or choose a small step when you're ready. Talk it through by voice in the iOS app, or by text in iMessage with Text Stella. Free to download; a subscription is required to keep using it. Stella is not therapy and is not a substitute for professional care.

title: StepFun: Scale-up intelligence possibilities for everyone | Product Hunt
og:title: StepFun: Scale-up intelligence possibilities for everyone | Product Hunt
og:description: StepFun is a frontier AI platform building powerful, actionable intelligence with the Step series of models.

title: Strac Comply: Get SOC 2 without the sales call | Product Hunt
og:title: Strac Comply: Get SOC 2 without the sales call | Product Hunt
og:description: 1. Self-serve compliance automation. Sign up, connect AWS, Google Workspace, Okta, GitHub and Slack, and 100+ tests run continuously for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS and more. 2. No per-framework fees 3. 14-day free trial, no credit card 4. Built by a data-security company, so it also finds the AI apps and agents in your workspace and maps them to the customer data they can reach 5. Run it from the dashboard or Claude Code via MCP 6. Platform $4,995/yr. Audit, vCISO and pen test tiers above

title: Strawberry: The self-driving browser | Product Hunt
og:title: Strawberry: The self-driving browser | Product Hunt
og:description: A browser that brings intuitive AI automation to your daily workflows. Strawberry helps you research, source data and automate repetitive tasks - from data entry to meeting follow-ups.

title: StudyQuest: Turn your notes into games | Product Hunt
og:title: StudyQuest: Turn your notes into games | Product Hunt
og:description: Turn PDFs, slides, images, or pasted notes into AI-generated questions, then learn through 40+ games. Battle bosses, race friends, or practice solo using your own material. Teachers can review a question set once, share it for independent play, or host it live with the class. Free plan available.

title: SunSed: Build Apps that Last | Product Hunt
og:title: SunSed: Build Apps that Last | Product Hunt
og:description: The AI-native app platform. Instead of forcing AI to write thousands of lines of fragile code from scratch, SunSed provides an AI-native framework of sealed, battle-tested components. That means the AI builds entire production apps with extreme token efficiency, zero build errors, and none of the code rot that plagues traditional AI generators. Every subscription includes managed hosting, your own database, transactional email, user authentication, file storage, and automatic backups.

title: SuperCMO AI: Open-source skills that turn your Claude into an AI CMO | Product Hunt
og:title: SuperCMO AI: Open-source skills that turn your Claude into an AI CMO | Product Hunt
og:description: Open-source agent skills that turn Claude Code, Cursor or Codex into an AI CMO. Give your agent your website and it learns your brand. It studies your competitors' ads, ranks what you should test next, writes the copy for each platform, and makes the ads (UGC videos, product ads, cartoon ads, image ads, product photos and more). It checks in with you at every step, and nothing expensive renders until you approve. Bring your own model keys, or pay per use with ours. Apache-2.0.

title: SupoClip: Open-source AI clipper: long videos into viral shorts | Product Hunt
og:title: SupoClip: Open-source AI clipper: long videos into viral shorts | Product Hunt
og:description: SupoClip turns long videos into vertical, captioned shorts. Paste a YouTube link or upload a file: AI transcribes it, picks the strongest 15–60s moments and scores each for virality, then crops 9:16 around the speaker and burns in word-synced captions and a hook title. Trim, split, merge and export for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. No watermarks. Open source (AGPL-3.0): self-host it free, or use the web app, iPhone app, REST API or MCP server.

title: SurgePix: AI visuals. Edit every layer. Agent-callable. | Product Hunt
og:title: SurgePix: AI visuals. Edit every layer. Agent-callable.  | Product Hunt
og:description: Most AI image tools stop at one-shot generation. SurgePix keeps going: edit any layer, swap text, repaint a region, and stay on-brand with your brand kit. Or skip the UI — open-source agent skills let Claude Code & Cursor generate and edit visuals for you.

title: Switch Lab: Hear and type on keyboard switches before you buy them | Product Hunt
og:title: Switch Lab: Hear and type on keyboard switches before you buy them | Product Hunt
og:description: Buying mechanical keyboard switches is a guessing game. Specs and YouTube videos don't tell you how a switch will sound and feel on your own desk. Switch Lab lets you press 100 switches with real recorded sounds, put them on a 3D keyboard, and swap between them instantly to compare. Filter by type, weight and sound, then test your pick with typing practice and mini games (typing marathon, drum stems, metro typing). No install, works on phone and desktop.

title: Syllaby AI Avatar 2.0: Create Your Own Avatar In Seconds | Product Hunt
og:title: Syllaby AI Avatar 2.0: Create Your Own Avatar In Seconds | Product Hunt
og:description: Turn a script or simple idea into a complete presenter-led video with a realistic AI avatar, natural voice, B-roll and subtitles—without hiring actors,

title: T-Scriptor: Be in the lecture. T-Scriptor takes the notes. | Product Hunt
og:title: T-Scriptor: Be in the lecture. T-Scriptor takes the notes. | Product Hunt
og:description: T-Scriptor transcribes your lectures on your mac, So the audio never leaves it. After class it writes the notes: key concepts, what's due and the papers your professor mentioned. Before the exam it pulls the whole course together. The Mac app's live and you can download it on https://t-scriptor.app, the Iphone app is in Beta.

title: Table Canon: TTRPG | DnD campaign memory: Automated notes, searchable history, prep ideas for GMs | Product Hunt
og:title: Table Canon: TTRPG | DnD campaign memory: Automated notes, searchable history, prep ideas for GMs | Product Hunt
og:description: Focus on the session, not note taking. Simplify your prep time with a searchable memory-bank of what happened at your table. Table Canon turns uploaded game-night audio into a recap, outline, entity dossiers, searchable index, and prep ideas for tabletop RPG game masters. Memory evolves each session. No sign up required to get started, 6 hours of audio upload free! Message me that you saw the launch on Product Hunt and I’ll credit your account with an extra 10 hours.

title: tabsh: Work with agents with an IDE in your browser tab | Product Hunt
og:title: tabsh: Work with agents with an IDE in your browser tab | Product Hunt
og:description: Most ADEs bring the browser into the IDE. tabsh takes the opposite approach: bring coding sessions to your browser, where your work already happens. It's a small Rust daemon that puts all your sessions across projects on one Kanban board/list, with status updates via agent hooks. Use real terminals or chat panels with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI, OpenCode, and more. Free, MIT-licensed, macOS/Linux.

title: Taim: Capture it. Taim files, schedules & syncs it with your AI. | Product Hunt
og:title: Taim: Capture it. Taim files, schedules & syncs it with your AI. | Product Hunt
og:description: Taim is your thought-capture assistant. Speak your mind and it all falls into place: thoughts land in the right thread automatically, and to-dos become tasks, reminders, and calendar events. Connect via MCP, and every agent you use instantly has your context.

title: Takes for Mac: Record talking-head videos. Claude Code does the edit. | Product Hunt
og:title: Takes for Mac: Record talking-head videos. Claude Code does the edit. | Product Hunt
og:description: A free, open-source Mac app for talking-head videos. A teleprompter that follows your voice, one-button recording of camera and screen, and every take in plain folders. Claude Code, on your own Claude plan, cuts the edit, makes the vertical version and drafts the posts. Leave notes on the frame; it turns them into rules and remembers them.

title: Takweem AI: The AI calendar that makes room for your most important work | Product Hunt
og:title: Takweem AI: The AI calendar that makes room for your most important work | Product Hunt
og:description: Takweem is an AI-first calendar. Ask in plain language, or by voice, to find time, move meetings or protect focus. You see every change before it counts: requests that only touch your own time are applied at once with Undo, and anything involving other people waits for your approval. It adapts when plans change, holds a weekly focus goal, and offers team availability and booking links where AI picks the best time. Integrates with Google Calendar — Outlook coming soon.

title: TapNoise: A tiny desktop pet that reacts to every key you press | Product Hunt
og:title: TapNoise: A tiny desktop pet that reacts to every key you press | Product Hunt
og:description: Meet Tappy, a little keycap who lives on your Mac's desktop. Tappy sweats when you type fast, gets dizzy when you slap your MacBook, eats when the charger goes in and naps when you're away. Coding with Claude Code, Codex or Cursor? Tappy chimes when your agent is done and sweats until you knock twice on your MacBook to answer. Plus 20 keyboard sounds, a lift alarm for café tables and Clean Mode for wiping the keys. Pay once, no subscription.

title: Teachoo: AI that helps you learn anything and everything. | Product Hunt
og:title: Teachoo: AI that helps you learn anything and everything. | Product Hunt
og:description: Teachoo helps students work through homework one question at a time. Type a problem or upload a photo, then work toward the answer with guided questions, feedback and hints. Need more help? Ask for a bigger hint or an explanation of the step. Free to use. Try a problem you haven’t solved in years.

title: Teclo: Mechanical keyboard sounds and a keycap pet for your Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: Teclo: Mechanical keyboard sounds and a keycap pet for your Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: Teclo sits in your Mac menu bar and plays a mechanical keyboard sound for every key you press, in any app. A keycap pet reacts as you type and powers up when you keep the pace. 10 sound packs. USD 4.99 once, for life, with a 7-day free trial.

title: Tend: Personal AI for businesses and entrepreneurs. | Product Hunt
og:title: Tend: Personal AI for businesses and entrepreneurs. | Product Hunt
og:description: Tend is a personal AI agent you text. No new app: it lives in iMessage or SMS and works inside your own accounts: Gmail, calendar, Shopify, QuickBooks, HubSpot. It replies to email in your voice, books tables, fills your cart, makes phone calls, finds leads and builds your website. The difference: nothing is sent, bought or changed without your yes, and what it learns about you sits in a Brain you can read and correct. It also texts you first with reminders, price watches and flight updates.

title: Termaxa: See what an AI agent's command would destroy before it runs | Product Hunt
og:title: Termaxa: See what an AI agent's command would destroy before it runs | Product Hunt
og:description: A gate in the hook path of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Copilot. It shows what a command would delete, backs it up first, and asks or refuses by your policy. Start in observe mode: nothing blocked, a report of what it would have caught. Open source, Rust.

title: Termi Protocol: Watch your AI coding agents build, live in 3D | Product Hunt
og:title: Termi Protocol: Watch your AI coding agents build, live in 3D | Product Hunt
og:description: The Termi Protocol is a 3D simulation of AI agent workflows. Give your coding agents a face, a desk and a living room. Watch them read, write and run commands live in 3D, like a game. You run the agents; we visualize the process.

title: Tesla Roadster: The quickest car in the world ever made | Product Hunt
og:title: Tesla Roadster: The quickest car in the world ever made | Product Hunt
og:description: The quickest car in the world, with record-setting acceleration, range and performance. As an all-electric supercar, Roadster maximizes the potential of aerodynamic engineering—with record-setting performance and efficiency. ... A lightweight, removable Glass Roof stores in the trunk for an open-air, convertible driving experience.

title: Tetriz Engg Intelligence + Connectors: Connect coding sessions to PRs, issues, quality, and ROI | Product Hunt
og:title: Tetriz Engg Intelligence + Connectors: Connect coding sessions to PRs, issues, quality, and ROI | Product Hunt
