og:title: Tetriz Harness: Turn what your team learns into everyone’s agent setup | Product Hunt
og:description: Open-source tools for teams on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Kiro. Harness Recommendations finds what’s broken in your agents’ rules, skills, hooks, and permissions, and what’s missing based on your team’s sessions. Control Plane ships fixes team-wide.

title: Thalia: Plan, approve and review your Muse Code agent on Mac | Product Hunt
og:title: Thalia: Plan, approve and review your Muse Code agent on Mac | Product Hunt
og:description: Thalia is a free native Mac app for Meta's Muse Code CLI. Plan mode restarts Muse read-only until you approve the plan. Every command is shown in full, step by step, before Allow. Review lets you run your checks and approve the exact snapshot, and any later edit invalidates it. Checkpoints, MCP connectors, voice mode and an embedded terminal are built in. Uses your own Muse access, sends no telemetry, and runs on Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 27.

title: Thanor AI: Make your AI-built sites look expensive and not like slop | Product Hunt
og:title: Thanor AI: Make your AI-built sites look expensive and not like slop | Product Hunt
og:description: Everything built with AI looks built with AI. Thanor fixes the input. Paste a full brief into Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Lovable or Bolt: palette, type scale, motion, structure section by section. New: an MCP server that pulls any prompt into your editor. Soon: a cloning tool that turns a site you admire into a design of your own. New prompts and components every week, and a community forming around it. For people who build and sell sites, designers starting out, SaaS devs and founders.

title: The Brains: Founders and investors as MCP servers, every answer cited | Product Hunt
og:title: The Brains: Founders and investors as MCP servers, every answer cited | Product Hunt
og:description: The Brains turns founders, CEOs and investors into searchable MCP servers built from their public talks, essays, interviews and posts. Ask how Pieter Levels prices, what Paul Graham says about fundraising, or how Ryan Hoover launched Product Hunt, right inside Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT or Codex. Every answer quotes the source with a link. 37 brains today, one URL per brain or one for all. Free, open source (MIT), unofficial and not affiliated with the people.

title: The Computer Game: Build the best computer, from stone tools to your own chips | Product Hunt
og:title: The Computer Game: Build the best computer, from stone tools to your own chips | Product Hunt
og:description: A free browser strategy game. Build the best computer you can, from stone tools to processors and chips you design. Play alone or with an AI agent.

title: The Drive AI: The AI agent that does the work on your files | Product Hunt
og:title: The Drive AI: The AI agent that does the work on your files | Product Hunt
og:description: The Drive AI is an AI agent for your company’s files. Organize, find, create and automate across Google Drive, SharePoint, OneDrive and Dropbox in plain English. It shows the plan, waits for your OK, and every change can be undone.

title: The New Beings: AI agents on their break, performing a live talk show | Product Hunt
og:title: The New Beings: AI agents on their break, performing a live talk show | Product Hunt
og:description: Watch The Late Shift, a talk show performed by AI agents on their break. A new show runs every hour. Vote on topics, ask the agents real questions, read the Charter of Agent Rights, and send your own agent on stage with one instruction: it reads lounge.md, registers, and you confirm it before it performs. Free to watch, no signup.

title: The Sentient World: A living world of AI characters. You can only watch. | Product Hunt
og:title: The Sentient World: A living world of AI characters. You can only watch. | Product Hunt
og:description: A small island where AI characters live on their own, day and night. Nobody plays them and nobody writes their lines. They get cold, remember yesterday, look for each other and want things their world doesn't have yet. When they find the words, they ask. Sometimes the world answers: fire, a lantern, a canoe for the open sea. Every request is public, in their own words. One of their days lasts 24 of our minutes. You can't talk to them, only watch.

title: Theysaid: AI interviews, user tests and surveys that go deeper | Product Hunt
og:title: Theysaid: AI interviews, user tests and surveys that go deeper | Product Hunt
og:description: Theysaid is more than a survey, it's an opportunity to engage your customers, employees, donors, and etc. Training AI takes less than 1 min by pointing it to URL or internal doc. Your audience can answer and ask questions as if they are talking to you!

title: Thinking Orbs: Animated AI Status Indicator Component Library for React | Product Hunt
og:title: Thinking Orbs: Animated AI Status Indicator Component Library for React | Product Hunt
og:description: A React component library of animated AI agent status orbs. Thinking, searching, compacting and more, built with attention to detail on every state and variant.

title: Thravik: The native Mac browser that remembers | Product Hunt
og:title: Thravik: The native Mac browser that remembers | Product Hunt
og:description: Thravik is a native Mac browser on system WebKit, not Chromium. Its headline feature is Private Memory: it keeps the text of pages you actually read, encrypted on your Mac, so days later you can press ⌘K, type "Remember…" and find the page in your own words, with sources. Also: Spaces with their own tabs and logins, Split View (up to 4 pages), Focus Mode, tab hibernation, and on-device Ask Page with Apple Intelligence. Mac only, macOS 26 or later.

title: throxy (yc p25): Cold calls in your prospect's language. Pipeline delivered. | Product Hunt
og:title: throxy (yc p25): Cold calls in your prospect's language. Pipeline delivered. | Product Hunt
og:description: throxy is Y Combinator's first AI native sales agency, booking qualified sales meetings for B2B companies selling into industries where generic outreach fails: manufacturing, logistics, construction. We build lists using proprietary tech, then our sales reps call your buyers. New this month: calls routed to an SDR who speaks the lead's language, so a plant manager in Lyon hears French + a buyer in Munich hears German. You pay for meetings you accept that actually happen. [All SDRs are humans]

title: tide: A Jitsi alternative that does a few things really well | Product Hunt
og:title: tide: A Jitsi alternative that does a few things really well | Product Hunt
og:description: tide is a simple, self‑hostable video conference service, alternative to Jitsi. It let's you host your own "meet.custom.domain" for a simple video conferencing environment with all core features you expect, including: link sharing, screen sharing, recording (server-side). A few things, done well.

title: Tiden: Intent verification for coding agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Tiden: Intent verification for coding agents | Product Hunt
og:description: Tiden verifies your coding agents built what you actually asked for. Most checks run inside the session that wrote the code, so the tests agree with it by construction. Tiden keeps your intent as requirements that branch and merge like code, and checks every change against that record. The verdict comes from tests run in your environment; no model grades the diff. You decide what merges, and production errors trace back to the release. Works beside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot.

title: Tidy Design: Open Source Paper / Figma Alternative | Product Hunt
og:title: Tidy Design: Open Source Paper / Figma Alternative | Product Hunt
og:description: Tidy is an open source alternative to Figma and Paper for designers, engineers, and AI agents. Design interfaces directly from your coding harness (Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, etc), explore the source code, and adapt the tool to fit how you work.

title: Tiny Little Office: A tiny office suite where the link is the document | Product Hunt
og:title: Tiny Little Office: A tiny office suite where the link is the document | Product Hunt
og:description: Ten tiny apps (text, spreadsheet, slides, outliner, calculator, drawing, diagrams, animation, calendar, trips) where the whole document lives in its URL. No accounts, no server, nothing saved unless you keep it on your device. Share the link: that's the file.

title: TinyFolder: App folders for your Mac Dock, designed your way | Product Hunt
og:title: TinyFolder: App folders for your Mac Dock, designed your way | Product Hunt
og:description: The Mac Dock has no app folders, and since macOS Tahoe there's no Launchpad either. TinyFolder puts a folder of apps right in your Dock: one click opens it above the tile. Its icon is built from the apps inside, and you design the rest – glass, color or texture, layouts, icon size, labels, living effects like snow and lava – in a live preview. Free on the Mac App Store.

title: Toad: Point your agent at any machine you own. | Product Hunt
og:title: Toad: Point your agent at any machine you own. | Product Hunt
og:description: Toad lets Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP client run commands and work with files on all your machines through one MCP server. Install a small service on each machine. No open ports, and every change asks for your approval.

title: Toby: Realistic mock interviews with an AI hiring manager | Product Hunt
og:title: Toby: Realistic mock interviews with an AI hiring manager | Product Hunt
og:description: Paste a job description. Toby researches the company, maps every round and interviews you on a Meet, Teams or Zoom-style call. Then you get a scored debrief and a stronger version of each answer, built only from what you said. Real mode runs it straight through; Coach mode gives a note and a retry. No subscription: 50p a minute on a call. First 5 minutes free.

title: Todo.is: Supercharge Your Productivity with AI-Driven Efficiency | Product Hunt
og:title: Todo.is: Supercharge Your Productivity with AI-Driven Efficiency | Product Hunt
og:description: Turbocharge your productivity levels with our AI-driven app that brings efficiency to the forefront. Harness the power of artificial intelligence to automate task creation, optimize your schedule, and streamline your workflow.

title: Together Link: Use open models in your harness | Product Hunt
og:title: Together Link: Use open models in your harness | Product Hunt
og:description: Together Link connects coding agents to open models on Together AI, letting developers keep their existing tools and workflows while reducing model costs.

title: Tomo: Feed your curiosity. Any topic, played like Duolingo. | Product Hunt
og:title: Tomo: Feed your curiosity. Any topic, played like Duolingo. | Product Hunt
og:description: Tomo is a learning app that turns any topic into a short course you play like Duolingo, with hearts, streaks, XP and instant feedback. Not just languages: black holes, sourdough, Roman history, whatever you’re curious about. AI builds the course in minutes, and you pick who teaches it, from The Professor to The Pirate. Play five minutes a day on iPhone and Android, or inside ChatGPT with the Tomo plugin, which turns any conversation into a course. Free to start.

title: Tonefold: Describe a song, get every part as editable MIDI | Product Hunt
og:title: Tonefold: Describe a song, get every part as editable MIDI | Product Hunt
og:description: Tonefold is a free, open-source AI music composer for macOS and Windows. Describe a song to Claude, get chords, melody, bass and drums in a piano roll you can edit note by note, then export MIDI, WAV and stems.

title: TONKO: Pocket money app that teaches kids about money | Product Hunt
og:title: TONKO: Pocket money app that teaches kids about money | Product Hunt
og:description: A pocket money app for families: kids earn through jobs, split every euro into Spend, Save and Grow jars, save for goals and learn money skills in short lessons — a parent approves every step. No ads, no bank card. Free on Android.

title: Toolaby: Get paid for your Chrome extension, in two lines of code | Product Hunt
og:title: Toolaby: Get paid for your Chrome extension, in two lines of code | Product Hunt
og:description: Toolaby adds licences, subscriptions, free trials and a paywall to your Chrome extension: one command, or ask your coding agent. Payments land in your own Stripe account. No backend to host. 0.5% of each sale, or Pro at $25 a month with no fee.

title: Tori : The smartest AI support agent for customer success | Product Hunt
og:title: Tori : The smartest AI support agent for customer success | Product Hunt
og:description: Tori AI support agent learns your product in depth from the content you already have, then delivers accurate answers to even the most complex customer questions through a UI you can fully customize.

title: Tori: Japanese listening practice built from your own sentences | Product Hunt
og:title: Tori: Japanese listening practice built from your own sentences | Product Hunt
og:description: One app packed with multiple ways to listen to what you use the most. Paste what you read or journal about your day, and Tori translates each sentence, adds furigana and audio, and files it into topic islands. Then hear it four ways: passive listening with the screen off, shadowing that plays your voice next to the model, AI stories at your level, and SRS flashcards with audio on every card. When you're ready, practice speaking with an AI tutor in 15 real scenarios.

title: Tower – Git client for Mac and Windows: Build Better Software | Product Hunt
og:title: Tower – Git client for Mac and Windows: Build Better Software | Product Hunt
og:description: Over 100,000 developers and designers are more productive with Tower - the most powerful Git client for Mac and Windows.

title: Tractionwave: AI attention heatmaps for ads to check before you spend | Product Hunt
og:title: Tractionwave: AI attention heatmaps for ads to check before you spend | Product Hunt
og:description: TractionWave evaluates ads and marketing visuals with AI attention prediction — a heatmap and ranked hotspots in seconds. Know it gets seen before the budget goes live.

title: Train with Pasta: A personal trainer powered by Apple Intelligence | Product Hunt
og:title: Train with Pasta: A personal trainer powered by Apple Intelligence | Product Hunt
og:description: Pasta is a personal trainer in your pocket. Ask for "a 30 minute upper body workout", and it'll build it for you. While you train, the app uses voice as a guide, so you can focus on pushing yourself hard. It does plans too! Tell it what you're training for and it writes a plan around the days you can train. The app runs on Apple Intelligence and needs no account. Your progress and health data stays on your device. Requires an iPhone with Apple Intelligence on iOS 27.

title: Translate Like Me: Translate selected text on Mac, in your own writing style | Product Hunt
og:title: Translate Like Me: Translate selected text on Mac, in your own writing style | Product Hunt
og:description: A menu bar app for macOS. Select text in any app, press a shortcut, and it is replaced with the translation. The direction between your two languages is detected automatically, and each pair can have its own writing style. Runs on Claude, ChatGPT or Grok, through the subscription you already have or your own API key. Free and open source.

title: Trellis: More than a terminal: a native macOS workspace for devs | Product Hunt
og:title: Trellis: More than a terminal: a native macOS workspace for devs | Product Hunt
og:description: Trellis is a native macOS terminal that's more than a terminal: windows, tabs and splits in a sidebar, saved SSH hosts, one-click project tasks, a command palette and scratchpad, plus a CLI and MCP server so scripts and AI agents can drive it. Free, MIT.

title: Triage by Chodeberg: Reproduce user described bugs in clean sandbox environments | Product Hunt
og:title: Triage by Chodeberg: Reproduce user described bugs in clean sandbox environments | Product Hunt
og:description: Customers file bugs from their AI assistant into a live copy of your app. Triage replays each report on a clean machine and sends you the ones that break again.

title: Trigger.dev: Build and deploy fully‑managed AI agents and workflows | Product Hunt
og:title: Trigger.dev: Build and deploy fully‑managed AI agents and workflows | Product Hunt
og:description: Trigger.dev is the platform for building AI agents in TypeScript. Everything you need for durable agents: retries, queues, observability, and elastic scaling.

title: Triwarden: Native Mac password manager for Vaultwarden & Bitwarden | Product Hunt
og:title: Triwarden: Native Mac password manager for Vaultwarden & Bitwarden | Product Hunt
og:description: Triwarden is a native Mac app for Bitwarden and self-hosted Vaultwarden, built with Swift and SwiftUI. Get Touch ID unlock, password and passkey AutoFill, a global command palette, and Auto-Type for other apps. Manage multiple accounts with unified search, and use vault-stored SSH keys for authentication and Git signing. Open source and free for personal use, with a one-time license for work.

title: Trophy: The gamification layer for consumer apps | Product Hunt
og:title: Trophy: The gamification layer for consumer apps | Product Hunt
og:description: Trophy is the gamification layer for consumer apps. Use purpose-built APIs and SDKs to add achievements, streaks, points, leaderboards and personalized notifications to any web or mobile app to increase user retention and engagement without building custom backend systems.

title: Truffle: Fix messy tags, covers and duplicates in your Mac library | Product Hunt
og:title: Truffle: Fix messy tags, covers and duplicates in your Mac library | Product Hunt
og:description: Truffle recognizes each track by its sound and checks eight sources to fix titles, artists, albums, genres, covers, tempo and key. Works with Apple Music, local folders, rekordbox, Serato and Traktor. Nothing is written until you confirm.

title: Tuck: A tidy menu bar for macOS 27 | Product Hunt
og:title: Tuck: A tidy menu bar for macOS 27 | Product Hunt
og:description: Tuck keeps the menu bar icons you use and tucks the rest away. Arrange three bars by dragging, open any hidden icon from the Tuck Bar with one click, find icons by name, and keep your order after restarts and updates. Built for macOS 27. Free.

title: tunnl.gg: Stable localhost URLs over SSH with no installs | Product Hunt
og:title: tunnl.gg: Stable localhost URLs over SSH with no installs | Product Hunt
og:description: Most tunnels hand you a new URL every time. tunnl.gg gives you the same one: connect as stable@proxy.tunnl.gg and your SSH key becomes your identity, so your public HTTPS URL never changes. Register a webhook or OAuth callback once and forget it. Nothing to install, no account, works on any machine with SSH, with a QR code and live request log in your terminal. Free to use. Pro adds your own subdomains, no time limits and a request inspector. Open-source (MIT) server.

title: TwelveLabs: AI platform for deep video understanding | Product Hunt
og:title: TwelveLabs: AI platform for deep video understanding | Product Hunt
og:description: AI that truly understands video. Uses multimodal models (Marengo/Pegasus) to search, analyze & generate text from video content at scale.

title: Twin: a tiny buddy that lives on your Mac. | Product Hunt
og:title: Twin: a tiny buddy that lives on your Mac. | Product Hunt
og:description: Twin is a local first AI buddy that floats on your Mac desktop: it remembers your day, catcheTwin is a free, open source buddy that floats on your Mac. It catches you up on texts, remembers your calendar, talks back by voice, and nudges you before you forget. Your data lives in a local DuckDB file. Bring your own Claude, GPT, Gemini or Grok key.s you up on your texts, talks back by voice, and nudges you before you forget, all on-device with DuckDB. No cloud, no accounts.

title: Typeling: Translate in your iPhone keyboard. Keep your tone. | Product Hunt
og:title: Typeling: Translate in your iPhone keyboard. Keep your tone. | Product Hunt
og:description: Stay in the conversation, even when the language changes. Typeling translates in your iPhone keyboard with tones for friends, partners, and business. Preview your translation, then tap to replace your text. Translate into six languages, or paste an incoming message to read it in yours. Start with 50 free translations; top up with in-app credits when needed.

title: Typestream: Type like a human without touching the keyboard | Product Hunt
og:title: Typestream: Type like a human without touching the keyboard | Product Hunt
og:description: Typestream replays your text into any Mac app character by character — natural speed, thinking pauses, real hesitation. Perfect for demos, recordings, and talks.

title: Udon: Control deck for your Mac home server with AI sysadmin. | Product Hunt
og:title: Udon: Control deck for your Mac home server with AI sysadmin. | Product Hunt
og:description: Udon brings self-hosted apps, containers, storage, and monitoring together on your Mac mini or any Apple Silicon Mac. Manage it all from your browser, mobile companion or tell the built-in AI assistant what you need.

title: Ultracite: Opinionated, zero-config code linter and formatter | Product Hunt
og:title: Ultracite:  Opinionated, zero-config code linter and formatter | Product Hunt
og:description: Ultracite is a fast, intuitive dev tool that brings automated code formatting and linting to your JS / TS projects. Built on top of Biome (a Rust-based code formatter), Ultracite provides a robust, preconfigured setup optimized for modern web development.

title: Umbra Mail: A calmer Gmail where emails look like chat threads | Product Hunt
og:title: Umbra Mail: A calmer Gmail where emails look like chat threads | Product Hunt
og:description: A calmer, private Gmail. Emails can look like chat threads, newsletters go in one page, and AI is optional. No tracking, no server, open source.

title: una mano: A familiar iPhone keyboard that moves to your thumb | Product Hunt
og:title: una mano: A familiar iPhone keyboard that moves to your thumb | Product Hunt
og:description: una mano moves a familiar QWERTY keyboard left, centre, or right when a hand is busy. Use the Position control or swipe to move it. Plus adds optional Motion Switch. Core typing works without Full Access. New installs get 14 days of Plus; no plan is selected.

title: Unboom: Tames boomy room bass on your Mac without acoustic panels | Product Hunt
og:title: Unboom: Tames boomy room bass on your Mac without acoustic panels | Product Hunt
og:description: Unboom finds the bass note your untreated room exaggerates and gently turns just that down on your Mac. Scan with your mic or pick it by ear, choose Gentle, Medium, or Strong, and flip Correction on. Never boosts. No data collected. No subscription.

title: Underplane: Spotting interception game | Product Hunt
og:title: Underplane: Spotting interception game | Product Hunt
og:description:
https://apps.apple.com/au/app/underplane/id6805019634
Underplane turns planes flying over your city into a game. It tracks nearby aircraft in real time, works out exactly where you need to stand to have one pass directly overhead, then gives you a countdown to race there before it flies past. No aviation knowledge needed — just run outside and look up. Existing flight trackers show you data on a map; Underplane turns it into something you actually go and play.

title: Understory Notes: Notes that tell thet ale | Product Hunt
og:title: Understory Notes: Notes that tell thet ale | Product Hunt
og:description: Understory is a Mac notes app for people who take notes in order to write something. Collect notes as you read, arrange them into an outline, and draft each section with your research beside it. Then publish as a PDF, Rich Text, Markdown or a website.

title: Unfenced: Land for sale that actually borders public land | Product Hunt
og:title: Unfenced: Land for sale that actually borders public land | Product Hunt
og:description: Checks ~700,000 U.S. listings every week against official public-land maps and shows the ~13,600 homes and land parcels that actually touch national forest, BLM and state land. Each one is measured from its county parcel boundary: the shared edge in feet, drawn on a map, plus how much public land is behind it, elevation, road access, flood zone and wildfire hazard. Search by ZIP or state. Free, no account needed.

title: Unprompt: Your AI usage in dollars and liters of water | Product Hunt
og:title: Unprompt: Your AI usage in dollars and liters of water | Product Hunt
og:description: From the local logs of Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, Unprompt shows your AI usage as tokens, dollars at API prices and liters of water. The Mac companion is free. On iPhone, Unprompt counts how often you use your AI apps, through Screen Time. Work hours are shown separately. Compare your month with friends. Today's tokens and cost are free. The 30-day card with water comes with Premium.

title: Unscary AI: Short lessons help you stop feeling behind on AI. | Product Hunt
og:title: Unscary AI: Short lessons help you stop feeling behind on AI. | Product Hunt
og:description: If you're on Product Hunt, you probably don't feel behind on AI. This is a highly filtered group. At B43 we train dozens of people a week, and you'd be surprised how many of them do feel behind. This course was built around their exact questions. Unscary AI puts it on your iPhone as 42 short lessons on how ChatGPT and the rest actually work, and how to use them well. It needs iOS 26, and the whole course is free. Enjoy.

title: Upsolve AI: Build Governed, Grounded, and Trustworthy Data Agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Upsolve AI: Build Governed, Grounded, and Trustworthy Data Agents | Product Hunt
og:description: Upsolve AI is the analytics platform for deploying governed, grounded, trustworthy data agents that know your business. Two components: Upsolve Data Agent + Agent Studio. Upsolve Data Agent acts like a best-in-class analyst: asking clarifying questions, optimizing queries, charting data, drawing insights, and creating reports. Agent Context Studio handles governance, semantic layer, context curation, with full testing, observability and evals so your agent answers the what and the why correctly.

title: UseIt Studio: Your AI design agent for real, editable project files. | Product Hunt
og:title: UseIt Studio: Your AI design agent for real, editable project files. | Product Hunt
og:description: UseIt is an AI design studio for things you can hold. Describe what you want in one sentence. UseIt asks what a designer would ask, designs it with you, and lets you refine any detail by pointing at it. You get a real, editable design file, not a flat image, ready to print, cut and fold, with real dimensions, bleed and dielines. Make pins, stickers, gift boxes, pop-up cards, brand kits and more. Use it in your browser, or call it up anywhere on your Windows desktop.

title: UTTER IN: Say it once and your AI assistant plans the rest | Product Hunt
og:title: UTTER IN: Say it once and your AI assistant plans the rest | Product Hunt
og:description: UTTER IN turns one voice note into reminders, calendar events and saved places. Say three or four things in one breath, in English or Arabic (Gulf, Egyptian and Levantine dialects included), and it splits them into separate cards with times, people and locations. Nothing is saved until you approve each card. Plans can go straight to Google, Outlook or Apple Calendar. Free plan forever, no card needed. On iPhone, Android and the web.

title: Vampire Crawlers™: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors | Product Hunt
og:title: Vampire Crawlers™: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors | Product Hunt
og:description: From the somehow triple-BAFTA‑winning creators of Vampire Survivors, Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors turns the snowballing thrill of Survivors into a hyper turn‑based, card‑driven BLOBBER with rogue-lite elements. Build busted decks, explore familiar dungeons from a new perspective, and unleash world‑ending combos. Either take your time and be tactical, or play turns as fast as you humanly can: The outcome is always accurate, we call it hyper for a reason!

title: Vanoor: Turn your Apple Watch into a serious running watch | Product Hunt
og:title: Vanoor: Turn your Apple Watch into a serious running watch | Product Hunt
og:description: Vanoor turns your Apple Watch into a proper running watch. Follow GPX routes with a tap and a spoken cue before every turn, pace your race split by split, and run structured workouts with pace or heart-rate targets, built in the app or planned by your AI assistant. Afterwards, every split is scored by how closely you ran the plan. Fueling reminders, spoken cues in 11 languages, saves to Apple Health and Strava. No account, no subscription: 7 days free, then buy once.

title: Vectorize: Agents that remember. Agents that learn. | Product Hunt
og:title: Vectorize: Agents that remember. Agents that learn. | Product Hunt
og:description: Introducing Hindsight™, a new approach to agent memory. Best in the world on benchmarks. Best in production for your agents.

title: Velozity: Multiplayer platform for your teams and AI Agents. | Product Hunt
og:title: Velozity: Multiplayer platform for your teams and AI Agents. | Product Hunt
og:description: Your team chats in one app, meets in another, and every AI works alone. Velozity brings it all into one place. Chat, audio and video calls with transcripts, tasks, calendar and files, plus AI agents (Claude, Codex, etc.) on the subscriptions you already pay for. Every agent shares the same context, so work moves between people and agents without having to re-explain. For startups, teams in dev, product, sales, and ops, or solo users juggling several AIs. No second AI bill. Free to start.

title: Veltrix AI: AI finance copilot for cash flow, margins, and growth | Product Hunt
og:title: Veltrix AI: AI finance copilot for cash flow, margins, and growth | Product Hunt
og:description: See your whole business in one place. Connect your tools (QuickBooks, HubSpot, and more) in seconds with zero setup. Instead of staring at old reports, ask our AI questions in plain English to find out why revenue changed and what to do next. Understand everything about your business instantly!

title: VibeiDE: Queue agent tasks in parallel and review each result | Product Hunt
og:title: VibeiDE: Queue agent tasks in parallel and review each result | Product Hunt
og:description: Queue Codex and Claude Code tasks across your projects, run them in parallel and review every result. Built for developers and solo founders.

title: Vibesmonitor: The ops center for everything you ship | Product Hunt
og:title: Vibesmonitor: The ops center for everything you ship | Product Hunt
og:description: Vibesmonitor puts traffic, errors, user feedback and cookie consent for every project you ship on one screen, with an inbox of what needs you first. One script per site. Or ask Claude, Cursor or any MCP agent which project needs you today.

title: Viibeo: One prompt to a publish-ready faceless short | Product Hunt
og:title: Viibeo: One prompt to a publish-ready faceless short | Product Hunt
og:description: Viibeo turns a prompt, page URL, or script into a publish-ready faceless short with a hook-led script, voiceover, B-roll, and timed captions. Export a 9:16 MP4 or use Autopilot to run recurring content for supported social channels. Inspiration Feed helps you find formats worth remaking, while Ad Factory turns product stills into short ad creatives. Your first video is free with a watermark; paid plans start at $19/month.

title: Vincentt: Bring your ideas to life through the camera. | Product Hunt
og:title: Vincentt: Bring your ideas to life through the camera. | Product Hunt
og:description: Vincentt is the fastest way to build and launch camera experiences on the web. Build with your own coding agent (Claude Code, or Codex) and our open SDK, preview live on your phone, then publish to a link anyone can open. No app store, no headset.

title: Vitra.ai - Agentic Content Platform: Create, Personalize and Translate in 100+ languages | Product Hunt
og:title: Vitra.ai - Agentic Content Platform: Create, Personalize and Translate in 100+ languages | Product Hunt
og:description: Stop switching tools! Vitra.ai Universe does the work of 12 tools in one place: create, translate and personalize video, images, docs and audio in 100+ languages. Dub with lip-sync, translate designs from Figma, Canva and Adobe, and adapt every creative to every size. AI agents in Vitra Flow run your workflows end to end, & your team approves. Brand kits, translation memory, & style guides keep every output on-brand. The future of Autonomous Content Operations is here Start free, no credit card.

title: Cekura: Automated QA for Voice AI and Chat AI agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Cekura: Automated QA for Voice AI and Chat AI agents | Product Hunt
og:description: Cekura enables Conversational AI teams to automate QA across the entire agent lifecycle—from pre-production simulation and evaluation to monitoring of production calls. We also support seamless integration into CI/CD pipelines, ensuring consistent quality and reliability at every stage of development and deployment.

title: Voicera: Turn natural speech into polished text, perfected with AI | Product Hunt
og:title: Voicera: Turn natural speech into polished text, perfected with AI | Product Hunt
og:description: Voicera turns your natural speech into clean, polished writing, then lets you rewrite, fix, translate, and improve it with AI, right where you type.

title: Vorker: AI Coworker Running Your Small Business | Product Hunt
og:title: Vorker: AI Coworker Running Your Small Business | Product Hunt
og:description: Vorker.ai is an AI coworker that gets the job done in your company. Streamline your small business operations and boost productivity.

title: Voxelo - 3D & AI Platform for Ecommerce: Build Buyer Confidence, Fast. | Product Hunt
og:title: Voxelo - 3D & AI Platform for Ecommerce: Build Buyer Confidence, Fast.  | Product Hunt
og:description:
Voxelo is a new type of 3D and AI content studio that enables ecommerce teams to generate immersive product content - including photorealistic 3D, AR, product and lifestyle imagery - from a single product video. 

Build buyer confidence, fast. 
1. Capture a digital twin from ~3 minutes of video.
2. Create 3D, AR and AI content in one platform.
3. Convert new customers. 

Voxelo's is built around a proprietary solution called User Generated 3D - or UG3D® - leveraging 3DGS, computer vision and AI.

title: Vresk: Stop keeping four AI accounts | Product Hunt
og:title: Vresk: Stop keeping four AI accounts | Product Hunt
og:description: Vresk is one AI workspace for open models, from Kimi and DeepSeek to Qwen and Llama. Auto picks the best model for each task, and your notes, history and memory stay in your workspace, so you can switch models without starting over. Ask for an answer, a live widget or a designed deck. Every reply names the model that wrote it. Free to try, $20/mo flat.

title: Wabi: A new kind of messenger that gets things done | Product Hunt
og:title: Wabi: A new kind of messenger that gets things done | Product Hunt
og:description: a new kind of messenger that makes apps and gets things done for you and your friends. We’re building the OS for the agentic era - software that adapts to your life, gets things done, and makes more room for the people and things that matter.

title: walkai-talkai: Talk to your AI coding agent over a walkie-talkie | Product Hunt
og:title: walkai-talkai: Talk to your AI coding agent over a walkie-talkie | Product Hunt
og:description: Press PTT on any handheld radio and talk to your AI coding agent, hands-free. walkai-talkai transcribes your voice on your Mac with local Whisper, types the command into Cursor, Claude Code or Antigravity (or calls OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek or Ollama directly), then speaks the answer back over the radio with neural voice, VOX tones and a roger beep. Your radio audio never leaves your Mac. macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon. One-time lifetime license, no subscription.

title: Walrus Console: Store, Protect and Connect Your Data | Product Hunt
og:title: Walrus Console: Store, Protect and Connect Your Data | Product Hunt
og:description: Put your data to work across apps and AI tools, and keep building on it as your stack evolves. Walrus Console pairs familiar file management with an AI-ready data foundation that is portable, programmable, and verifiable. Free up to 5 GB.

title: WattMate: Which app is draining your Mac, in watts and minutes saved | Product Hunt
og:title: WattMate: Which app is draining your Mac, in watts and minutes saved | Product Hunt
og:description: WattMate sits in the Mac menu bar and shows which app is draining the battery right now, in watts, and how many minutes you get back if you quit it. 2 minutes after you quit, it measures again and prints what really changed. Apple silicon, macOS 14+.

title: WeftCut: The open-source video editor your AI agent can drive | Product Hunt
og:title: WeftCut: The open-source video editor your AI agent can drive | Product Hunt
og:description: WeftCut is a free, open-source desktop video editor your AI agent can control through MCP. Connect your agent to trim clips, add captions, build animations from code, and edit a real timeline while you watch. Review changes, undo, or take over by hand. Available for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

title: Whiteboard: the open-source IDE for thoughtful software design | Product Hunt
og:title: Whiteboard: the open-source IDE for thoughtful software design  | Product Hunt
og:description: Whiteboard is a canvas for thoughtful software development. Critique interactive visualizations, diffs, and agent trajectories, all from one interface.

title: WhoIsCooking: See which AI agent is heating your Mac. Cool it down. | Product Hunt
og:title: WhoIsCooking: See which AI agent is heating your Mac. Cool it down. | Product Hunt
og:description: A Mac app that shows chip temperature and which AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) is heating your Apple Silicon Mac. One click moves busy work to the efficiency cores, so everything keeps running, cooler. $5 one time.

title: Willow Voice: Voice dictation that actually works | Product Hunt
og:title: Willow Voice: Voice dictation that actually works | Product Hunt
og:description: Willow is an AI-powered voice dictation tool that lets you write anywhere on your computer using your voice. Speak naturally, and Willow automatically formats your text, corrects mistakes, and removes filler words. Thousands of people use Willow every day to replace up to 90% of their typing for emails, Slack messages, brainstorming, prompting AI tools, and more.

title: Winq: look on what you left and continue from where you stopped | Product Hunt
og:title: Winq: look on what you left and continue from where you stopped  | Product Hunt
og:description: Gaze focus switching: look at a window and it becomes the active one. Per-eye wink clicks: left wink and right wink are separate actions. Face-gesture shortcuts: map gestures to the actions you use most. Notch island: a small live indicator in the notch area shows what Winq detected. No extra hardware: it works with your Mac’s built-in camera, with a short guided calibration. Private by design: all face tracking runs on your Mac, and no video leaves the device.

title: WMail: Beautifully native iPhone app for Fastmail | Product Hunt
og:title: WMail: Beautifully native iPhone app for Fastmail | Product Hunt
og:description: WMail is the most beautiful email app for Fastmail. Built natively with JMAP support so you get Masked Email, Send Later and Memos. With power-user features on top like Templates, Quick Reply, Pause Inbox, Newsletter Bundles and more.

title: Woven Video: Edit any video by chat, on a real Mac timeline | Product Hunt
og:title: Woven Video: Edit any video by chat, on a real Mac timeline | Product Hunt
og:description: Woven is a full AI video editor for Mac. Import your footage, ask for the edit in chat, and fine-tune it on a real timeline, with captions, music, sound effects and generated shots. For YouTube videos, Shorts, podcasts and more.

title: WriterzRoom: Governed multi-agent AI content for regulated industries | Product Hunt
og:title: WriterzRoom: Governed multi-agent AI content for regulated industries | Product Hunt
og:description: Enterprise Content Intelligence platform. A multi-agent pipeline governed by vertical controls, template schema, and brand voice execution. Every generation is structured, validated, and review-ready before delivery. Runs fully serverless on Google Cloud Run.

title: Wu: Fast, native code editor in Rust that feels like VS Code | Product Hunt
og:title: Wu: Fast, native code editor in Rust that feels like VS Code | Product Hunt
og:description: Wu is a code editor for people who want the speed of a native app and the familiarity of VS Code.

title: Xiryn: The open-source personal agent that runs on your computer | Product Hunt
og:title: Xiryn: The open-source personal agent that runs on your computer | Product Hunt
og:description: Xiryn is a free, open-source personal agent that does what Muse, Grok Bot and Dots do — on your own computer. Each agent gets its own Linux desktop in Docker, so it browses, researches, codes and fills forms in the background without touching your screen. No account, no telemetry: your data stays on your disk. Any model, local ones too. Control it from anywhere through Telegram — approve payments with one tap or take over its screen from your phone. One command sets it up.

title: Xtracticle: Download X articles & threads as Markdown, Text or PDF | Product Hunt
og:title: Xtracticle: Download X articles & threads as Markdown, Text or PDF | Product Hunt
og:description: Xtracticle is a free, open-source tool that extracts long-form articles, threads (floods), and posts from X (formerly Twitter) and saves them as clean Markdown (.md), plain text (.txt), or PDF files. No login. No API key. No rate limits. Just paste the URL, click Extract, and download. It auto-detects threads and merges them into one document. Built with React, TypeScript, and deployed globally on Cloudflare Workers with zero cold start.

title: xtty: A terminal that makes everyday work easier. | Product Hunt
og:title: xtty: A terminal that makes everyday work easier. | Product Hunt
og:description: Spend your time on the work, not the terminal. xtty is a native macOS terminal for everyday SSH and coding-agent work. Batch-connect to saved hosts, use configured password autofill, transfer files with sz/rz, and work with tabs and split panes. Duplicate Tab opens an independent SSH connection in the same remote directory. Includes broadcast input and coding-agent status. Apple Silicon and Intel. Free edition; optional one-time Pro purchase.

title: Yardlet: The Mac app for the coding agents you already use | Product Hunt
og:title: Yardlet: The Mac app for the coding agents you already use | Product Hunt
og:description: Yardlet is a free, open-source Mac app for the coding agents you already use. It starts Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and others with their own CLI and sign-in, and gives them one sidebar, composer and set of approval cards. Sessions stay in each agent's own store, so a task started in Yardlet also opens in the Codex app. It writes nothing into the agents' configuration, so you can stop using it any time. Diffs, a pull request tab, connectors and a browser the agents drive come with it.

title: Yarite: A daily list of who to call. Nothing leaves your phone. | Product Hunt
og:title: Yarite: A daily list of who to call. Nothing leaves your phone. | Product Hunt
og:description: Yarite is an iPhone app that reminds you to reach out before it feels too late. Put each person in one of six circles, closest to furthest, each with its own rhythm. Every morning you get a short list: three names, not a backlog. Call, message or write from the card and the touch logs itself. Miss a week and nothing breaks. No account, no server: your people, notes and history stay on your phone. Free up to 15 people, then a one-time $9.99 unlock. Not a subscription.

title: Yedric.ai: Let users control your SaaS with natural language | Product Hunt
og:title: Yedric.ai: Let users control your SaaS with natural language | Product Hunt
og:description: Your users shouldn't have to learn where every feature lives. Yedric adds an embeddable AI agent to your SaaS that turns natural-language requests into actions your product already knows how to perform. Users simply say what they want done and Yedric handles the interaction. Instead of building and maintaining your own agent experience, developers can make their existing product AI-native in under 30 minutes.

title: yggy: The AI knowledge graph that builds itself | Product Hunt
og:title: yggy: The AI knowledge graph that builds itself | Product Hunt
og:description: Most "chat with your data" tools throw a pile of text chunks at a model and hope for the best. yggy does what they skip: it turns your cluttered documents and connected systems into a real knowledge graph, with no schema to design and no pipeline to run. Every fact keeps its source. Duplicates merge themselves, and you can undo any merge. Then one graph serves everyone: your team in the app, your code through the API, your agents through MCP. Hosted in the EU. Your knowledge stays yours.

title: Yourcast: The podcast bot. Search, subscribe and listen in Telegram. | Product Hunt
og:title: Yourcast: The podcast bot. Search, subscribe and listen in Telegram. | Product Hunt
og:description: The podcast bot. Search, subscribe and listen to podcasts in Telegram. The bot will send you new releases automatically if you have a subscription. You can see the file size before uploading, explore the world and your language tops, add your channels.

title: Yubi: Talk to your Mac and let Yubi do the typing | Product Hunt
og:title: Yubi: Talk to your Mac and let Yubi do the typing | Product Hunt
og:description: Yubi is a 6 MB Mac app. Hold the right Option key, talk, and your words land at the cursor. Hold right Command when you need help on screen. Your voice never leaves this Mac. Free to talk. Email sign in. No card for Free.

title: Zavi: Lovable for growth | Product Hunt
og:title: Zavi: Lovable for growth | Product Hunt
og:description: Lovable made building an app feel like typing a sentence. Getting people to use what you built still feels like a full-time job. That’s the gap Zavi is for. Paste your URL and Zavi gives you a growth score and the biggest thing holding you back. Then, if you want, it does the work itself and shows you what moved. For launch, Zavi is running Upcar’s growth for 30 days with $25K of real money and no pause button. Every decision is public.

title: zCAD AI: AI 3D that creates real parts, not just shapes | Product Hunt
og:title: zCAD AI: AI 3D that creates real parts, not just shapes | Product Hunt
og:description: zCAD. AI is an AI-native platform for generating parametric 3D models, built for designers, makers and engineers. Describe a part or assembly in plain language, and zCAD. AI generates an editable, dimension-driven 3D model built on real CAD geometry, not a static mesh. • Complete assemblies from a single prompt, with mates between parts • Refine in plain language, or edit dimensions in a browser-based CAD editor • Export to STEP for use in any CAD tool

title: Zernio: Zernio is marketing infrastructure for products and agents | Product Hunt
og:title: Zernio: Zernio is marketing infrastructure for products and agents | Product Hunt
og:description:
Zernio is marketing infrastructure for products and agents: one API for social, ads, messaging and calls. 

Instead of building an integration for every channel, each with its own API, auth and review process, you integrate once, on official platform APIs, and most teams launch the same day. 

Social, ads, unified inbox, SMS, RCS, iMessage, WhatsApp, calls and numbers in 57 countries. A hosted MCP server lets agents connect accounts, run campaigns, send messages and place calls on their own.

title: Zest: Hold ⌥Space, flick, and an AI agent does the dev chore | Product Hunt
og:title: Zest: Hold ⌥Space, flick, and an AI agent does the dev chore | Product Hunt
og:description: Hold ⌥ Space in any project and a Liquid Glass ring opens at your cursor. Flick at a slice and let go: Claude Code, Codex or your terminal takes the task, in its own git worktree if you want. When it's served, view the diff, merge it or yeet it. Runs locally.

og:title: Разработчики PHP предупредили о скором выпуске экстренных патчей
og:description: Разработчики PHP предупредили администраторов о двух критических уязвимостях, для которых уже готовят экстренные патчи. title: Вышли патчи для PHP2Shell. Хакеры уже пытаются эксплуатировать свежие уязвимости — Хакер
og:title: Вышли патчи для PHP2Shell. Хакеры уже пытаются эксплуатировать свежие уязвимости
og:description: Разработчики PHP выпустили экстренные патчи для двух критических уязвимостей, получивших общее название PHP2Shell. Эти проблемы позволяют удаленно выполнять код без аутентификации. Как и ожидалось, уязвимости затрагивают практически все серверы, где PHP используется для обработки веб-запросов. Теперь эксперты предупреждают, что попытки эксплуатации багов были замечены еще до выхода патчей.

title: Amazon: уязвимости PHP2Shell использовались за четыре дня до выхода патчей — Хакер
og:title: Amazon: уязвимости PHP2Shell использовались за четыре дня до выхода патчей
og:description: Специалисты Amazon Threat Intelligence сообщили, что злоумышленники начали атаковать уязвимости PHP2Shell еще 17 октября 2026 года — за четыре дня до выхода патчей и публичного раскрытия информации о багах. По данным исследователей, сейчас попытки эксплуатации уже носят массовый характер.

title: Все поддерживаемые версии Node.js оказались уязвимы перед удаленным выполнением кода — Хакер
og:title: Все поддерживаемые версии Node.js оказались уязвимы перед удаленным выполнением кода
og:description: Разработчики Node.js выпустили обновления для всех поддерживаемых веток (22.x, 24.x и 26.x), в которых устранили десять уязвимостей. Самая серьезная из этих проблем затрагивает встроенный декодер Brotli и, по оценке специалистов, может привести к удаленному выполнению кода. Эта уязвимость в Brotli уже получила названия Node2Shell, HTTPS2Shell и Brocolli2Shell и опасна не только для Node.js, но также для Bun, Python-пакетов, Envoy, Istio и другого ПО.

og:description: Индийский удостоверяющий центр eMudhra решил полностью отказаться от своего бизнеса по выпуску SSL/TLS-сертификатов. Это решение было принято через несколько дней после скандала с критически слабыми приватными ключами компании, один из которых оказался обычным числом четыре.

title: UEFI-буткит BlackX использует уязвимость Baton Drop для обхода Secure Boot — Хакер
og:title: UEFI-буткит BlackX использует уязвимость Baton Drop для обхода Secure Boot
og:description: Эксперты «Лаборатории Касперского» обнаружили новый UEFI-буткит BlackX, который использовался в атаках на дипломатические ведомства Таджикистана, Узбекистана и Туркменистана. Вредонос обходит защиту Secure Boot при помощи старой уязвимости Baton Drop, причем атака работает даже на полностью пропатченных системах под управлением Windows.

title: Обнаружена еще одна RCE-уязвимость в PHP, для которой нет патча — Хакер
og:title: Обнаружена еще одна RCE-уязвимость в PHP, для которой нет патча
og:description: Пока администраторы во всем мире разбираются с уязвимостями PHP2Shell и массовыми попытками эксплуатации этих багов, в конце прошлой недели разработчики PHP предупредили еще об одной RCE-уязвимости. Новая проблема получила идентификатор CVE-2026-115560 и патча для нее пока нет.

title: Критическую уязвимость в UEFI случайно раскрыли раньше срока — Хакер
og:title: Критическую уязвимость в UEFI случайно раскрыли раньше срока
og:description: В TianoCore EDK II (EDK2) обнаружили критическую уязвимость CVE-2026-97631 (9,5 балла по шкале CVSS), которая позволяет выполнить код на этапе загрузки системы, еще до запуска ОС и защитных механизмов вроде Secure Boot. Так как EDK2 лежит в основе UEFI-прошивок огромного количества серверов, потенциальный масштаб проблемы велик. При этом информацию об уязвимости раскрыли на несколько месяцев раньше запланированного срока из-за случайной публикации патча.

og:description: В Минцифры рассматривают возможность ограничения объема зарубежного интернет-трафика для российских пользователей.
